```typescript
    regions[1].id,
    OrderStatus.PAID,
    PaymentStatus.PAID
  );

  // Actualizează status-uri pentru OrderVendor în order5
  const order5Vendors = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
    where: { orderId: order5.id },
  });

  // Marchează un OrderVendor ca SHIPPED
  if (order5Vendors.length > 0) {
    await prisma.orderVendor.update({
      where: { id: order5Vendors[0].id },
      data: { status: OrderVendorStatus.SHIPPED },
    });
  }

  console.log('✅ 5 comenzi demo create');
}

/**
 * Helper: creează o comandă B2C
 */
async function createOrderB2C(
  customer: { id: string },
  items: Array<{ product: { id: string; name: string; price: Prisma.Decimal }; quantity: number }>,
  shippingRegionId: string,
  orderStatus: OrderStatus,
  paymentStatus: PaymentStatus
) {
  // Grupează itemii pe producător
  const itemsByProducer = new Map<string, typeof items>();
  
  for (const item of items) {
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: item.product.id },
      include: { producer: true },
    });

    if (!product) continue;

    const producerId = product.producerId;
    if (!itemsByProducer.has(producerId)) {
      itemsByProducer.set(producerId, []);
    }
    itemsByProducer.get(producerId)!.push(item);
  }

  // Calculează totaluri
  let totalAmount = 0;
  const vendorData: Array<{
    producerId: string;
    subtotal: number;
    commissionAmount: number;
    payoutAmount: number;
    items: typeof items;
  }> = [];

  for (const [producerId, producerItems] of itemsByProducer.entries()) {
    const subtotal = producerItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const commissionRate = 0.12; // 12% pentru B2C
    const commissionAmount = subtotal * commissionRate;
    const payoutAmount = subtotal - commissionAmount;
    totalAmount += subtotal;

    vendorData.push({
      producerId,
      subtotal,
      commissionAmount,
      payoutAmount,
      items: producerItems,
    });
  }

  const totalCommission = vendorData.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.commissionAmount, 0);

  // Creează Order
  const order = await prisma.order.create({
    data: {
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerType: OrderCustomerType.B2C,
      status: orderStatus,
      paymentStatus,
      totalAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(totalAmount),
      totalCommission: new Prisma.Decimal(totalCommission),
      shippingFullName: 'Demo Customer',
      shippingPhone: '0712345678',
      shippingAddressLine1: 'Str. Demo, Nr. 1',
      shippingCity: 'Cluj-Napoca',
      shippingPostalCode: '400000',
      shippingRegionId,
    },
  });

  // Creează OrderVendor și OrderItem pentru fiecare producător
  for (const vendor of vendorData) {
    const orderVendor = await prisma.orderVendor.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        status: orderStatus === OrderStatus.COMPLETED 
          ? OrderVendorStatus.DELIVERED 
          : orderStatus === OrderStatus.PAID 
          ? OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED 
          : OrderVendorStatus.PENDING,
        subtotal: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.12),
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.commissionAmount),
        payoutAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.payoutAmount),
      },
    });

    // Creează OrderItem pentru fiecare item
    for (const item of vendor.items) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: item.product.id },
      });

      if (!product) continue;

      await prisma.orderItem.create({
        data: {
          orderVendorId: orderVendor.id,
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice: product.price,
          totalPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity),
          productNameSnapshot: product.name,
          productImageUrlSnapshot: null, // Poate fi adăugat dacă există imagini
        },
      });
    }

    // Creează Commission
    await prisma.commission.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        baseAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.08), // 8% marketplace commission
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal * 0.08),
        status: orderStatus === OrderStatus.COMPLETED 
          ? CommissionStatus.ISSUED 
          : CommissionStatus.PENDING,
      },
    });
  }

  return order;
}

/**
 * Helper: creează o comandă B2B
 */
async function createOrderB2B(
  customer: { id: string },
  items: Array<{ product: { id: string; name: string; price: Prisma.Decimal }; quantity: number }>,
  shippingRegionId: string,
  orderStatus: OrderStatus,
  paymentStatus: PaymentStatus,
  companyData: {
    companyName: string;
    companyCui: string;
    companyRegNo: string;
    companyAddress: string;
  }
) {
  // Grupează itemii pe producător
  const itemsByProducer = new Map<string, typeof items>();
  
  for (const item of items) {
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: item.product.id },
      include: { producer: true },
    });

    if (!product) continue;

    const producerId = product.producerId;
    if (!itemsByProducer.has(producerId)) {
      itemsByProducer.set(producerId, []);
    }
    itemsByProducer.get(producerId)!.push(item);
  }

  // Calculează totaluri (B2B = 6% commission)
  let totalAmount = 0;
  const vendorData: Array<{
    producerId: string;
    subtotal: number;
    commissionAmount: number;
    payoutAmount: number;
    items: typeof items;
  }> = [];

  for (const [producerId, producerItems] of itemsByProducer.entries()) {
    const subtotal = producerItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const commissionRate = 0.06; // 6% pentru B2B
    const commissionAmount = subtotal * commissionRate;
    const payoutAmount = subtotal - commissionAmount;
    totalAmount += subtotal;

    vendorData.push({
      producerId,
      subtotal,
      commissionAmount,
      payoutAmount,
      items: producerItems,
    });
  }

  const totalCommission = vendorData.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.commissionAmount, 0);

  // Creează Order
  const order = await prisma.order.create({
    data: {
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerType: OrderCustomerType.B2B,
      status: orderStatus,
      paymentStatus,
      totalAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(totalAmount),
      totalCommission: new Prisma.Decimal(totalCommission),
      shippingFullName: companyData.companyName,
      shippingPhone: '0712345678',
      shippingAddressLine1: companyData.companyAddress,
      shippingCity: 'București',
      shippingPostalCode: '010000',
      shippingRegionId,
      companyName: companyData.companyName,
      companyCui: companyData.companyCui,
      companyRegNo: companyData.companyRegNo,
      companyAddress: companyData.companyAddress,
    },
  });

  // Creează OrderVendor și OrderItem pentru fiecare producător
  for (const vendor of vendorData) {
    const orderVendor = await prisma.orderVendor.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        status: OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED,
        subtotal: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.06),
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.commissionAmount),
        payoutAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.payoutAmount),
      },
    });

    // Creează OrderItem pentru fiecare item
    for (const item of vendor.items) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: item.product.id },
      });

      if (!product) continue;

      await prisma.orderItem.create({
        data: {
          orderVendorId: orderVendor.id,
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice: product.price,
          totalPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity),
          productNameSnapshot: product.name,
          productImageUrlSnapshot: null, // Poate fi adăugat dacă există imagini
        },
      });
    }

    // Creează Commission
    await prisma.commission.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        baseAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.08), // 8% marketplace commission
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal * 0.08),
        status: CommissionStatus.PENDING,
      },
    });
  }

  return order;
}

/**

  console.log('🌱 Început seed database...\n');
```

```typescript
const prisma = new PrismaClient();

/**

 */
async function clearDatabase() {
  console.log('🗑️  Ștergere date existente...');
  
  // Ordinea este importantă din cauza foreign keys
  await prisma.orderItem.deleteMany();
  await prisma.orderVendor.deleteMany();
  await prisma.commission.deleteMany();
  await prisma.customerInvoice.deleteMany();
  await prisma.producerInvoice.deleteMany();
  await prisma.order.deleteMany();
  await prisma.cartItem.deleteMany();
  await prisma.cart.deleteMany();
  await prisma.product.deleteMany();
  await prisma.producer.deleteMany();
  await prisma.user.deleteMany();
  await prisma.region.deleteMany();
  
  console.log('✅ Date șterse');
}

async function createProductsForProducer(
  producerId: string,
  regionId: string,
  productsData: Array<{
    name: string;
    description: string;
    price: number;
    stock: number;
    isTraditional: boolean;
    unit?: string | null;
    imageUrl?: string | null;
    category?: string | null;
    isBio?: boolean;
  }>
) {
  const products = await Promise.all(
    productsData.map(product =>
      prisma.product.create({
        data: {
          producerId,
          name: product.name,
          description: product.description,
          price: new Prisma.Decimal(product.price),
          stock: product.stock,
          isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
          regionId: product.isTraditional ? regionId : null,
          unit: product.unit ?? null,
          imageUrl: product.imageUrl ?? null,
          category: product.category ?? null,
          isBio: product.isBio ?? false,
          status: ProductStatus.APPROVED, // Produsele seed sunt aprobate automat
        },
      })
    )
  );

  return products;
}

/**
 * Helper: creează o comandă B2C
 */
async function createOrderB2C(
  customer: { id: string },
  items: Array<{ product: { id: string; name: string; price: Prisma.Decimal }; quantity: number }>,
  shippingRegionId: string,
  orderStatus: OrderStatus,
  paymentStatus: PaymentStatus
) {
  // Grupează itemii pe producător
  const itemsByProducer = new Map<string, typeof items>();
  
  for (const item of items) {
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: item.product.id },
      include: { producer: true },
    });

    if (!product) continue;

    const producerId = product.producerId;
    if (!itemsByProducer.has(producerId)) {
      itemsByProducer.set(producerId, []);
    }
    itemsByProducer.get(producerId)!.push(item);
  }

  // Calculează totaluri
  let totalAmount = 0;
  const vendorData: Array<{
    producerId: string;
    subtotal: number;
    commissionAmount: number;
    payoutAmount: number;
    items: typeof items;
  }> = [];

  for (const [producerId, producerItems] of itemsByProducer.entries()) {
    const subtotal = producerItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const commissionRate = 0.12; // 12% pentru B2C
    const commissionAmount = subtotal * commissionRate;
    const payoutAmount = subtotal - commissionAmount;
    totalAmount += subtotal;

    vendorData.push({
      producerId,
      subtotal,
      commissionAmount,
      payoutAmount,
      items: producerItems,
    });
  }

  const totalCommission = vendorData.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.commissionAmount, 0);

  // Creează Order
  const order = await prisma.order.create({
    data: {
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerType: OrderCustomerType.B2C,
      status: orderStatus,
      paymentStatus,
      totalAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(totalAmount),
      totalCommission: new Prisma.Decimal(totalCommission),
      shippingFullName: 'Demo Customer',
      shippingPhone: '0712345678',
      shippingAddressLine1: 'Str. Demo, Nr. 1',
      shippingCity: 'Cluj-Napoca',
      shippingPostalCode: '400000',
      shippingRegionId,
    },
  });

  // Creează OrderVendor și OrderItem pentru fiecare producător
  for (const vendor of vendorData) {
    const orderVendor = await prisma.orderVendor.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        status: orderStatus === OrderStatus.COMPLETED 
          ? OrderVendorStatus.DELIVERED 
          : orderStatus === OrderStatus.PAID 
          ? OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED 
          : OrderVendorStatus.PENDING,
        subtotal: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.12),
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.commissionAmount),
        payoutAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.payoutAmount),
      },
    });

    // Creează OrderItem pentru fiecare item
    for (const item of vendor.items) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: item.product.id },
      });

      if (!product) continue;

      await prisma.orderItem.create({
        data: {
          orderVendorId: orderVendor.id,
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice: product.price,
          totalPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity),
          productNameSnapshot: product.name,
          productImageUrlSnapshot: product.imageUrl || null,
        },
      });
    }

    // Creează Commission
    await prisma.commission.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        baseAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.08), // 8% marketplace commission
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal * 0.08),
        status: orderStatus === OrderStatus.COMPLETED 
          ? CommissionStatus.ISSUED 
          : CommissionStatus.PENDING,
      },
    });
  }

  return order;
}

/**
 * Helper: creează o comandă B2B
 */
async function createOrderB2B(
  customer: { id: string },
  items: Array<{ product: { id: string; name: string; price: Prisma.Decimal }; quantity: number }>,
  shippingRegionId: string,
  orderStatus: OrderStatus,
  paymentStatus: PaymentStatus,
  companyData: {
    companyName: string;
    companyCui: string;
    companyRegNo: string;
    companyAddress: string;
  }
) {
  // Grupează itemii pe producător
  const itemsByProducer = new Map<string, typeof items>();
  
  for (const item of items) {
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: item.product.id },
      include: { producer: true },
    });

    if (!product) continue;

    const producerId = product.producerId;
    if (!itemsByProducer.has(producerId)) {
      itemsByProducer.set(producerId, []);
    }
    itemsByProducer.get(producerId)!.push(item);
  }

  // Calculează totaluri (B2B = 6% commission)
  let totalAmount = 0;
  const vendorData: Array<{
    producerId: string;
    subtotal: number;
    commissionAmount: number;
    payoutAmount: number;
    items: typeof items;
  }> = [];

  for (const [producerId, producerItems] of itemsByProducer.entries()) {
    const subtotal = producerItems.reduce(
      (sum, item) => sum + item.product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity,
      0
    );
    const commissionRate = 0.06; // 6% pentru B2B
    const commissionAmount = subtotal * commissionRate;
    const payoutAmount = subtotal - commissionAmount;
    totalAmount += subtotal;

    vendorData.push({
      producerId,
      subtotal,
      commissionAmount,
      payoutAmount,
      items: producerItems,
    });
  }

  const totalCommission = vendorData.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.commissionAmount, 0);

  // Creează Order
  const order = await prisma.order.create({
    data: {
      customerId: customer.id,
      customerType: OrderCustomerType.B2B,
      status: orderStatus,
      paymentStatus,
      totalAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(totalAmount),
      totalCommission: new Prisma.Decimal(totalCommission),
      shippingFullName: companyData.companyName,
      shippingPhone: '0712345678',
      shippingAddressLine1: companyData.companyAddress,
      shippingCity: 'București',
      shippingPostalCode: '010000',
      shippingRegionId,
      companyName: companyData.companyName,
      companyCui: companyData.companyCui,
      companyRegNo: companyData.companyRegNo,
      companyAddress: companyData.companyAddress,
    },
  });

  // Creează OrderVendor și OrderItem pentru fiecare producător
  for (const vendor of vendorData) {
    const orderVendor = await prisma.orderVendor.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        status: OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED,
        subtotal: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.06),
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.commissionAmount),
        payoutAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.payoutAmount),
      },
    });

    // Creează OrderItem pentru fiecare item
    for (const item of vendor.items) {
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: item.product.id },
      });

      if (!product) continue;

      await prisma.orderItem.create({
        data: {
          orderVendorId: orderVendor.id,
          productId: product.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unitPrice: product.price,
          totalPrice: new Prisma.Decimal(product.price.toNumber() * item.quantity),
          productNameSnapshot: product.name,
          productImageUrlSnapshot: product.imageUrl || null,
        },
      });
    }

    // Creează Commission
    await prisma.commission.create({
      data: {
        orderId: order.id,
        producerId: vendor.producerId,
        baseAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal),
        commissionRate: new Prisma.Decimal(0.08), // 8% marketplace commission
        commissionAmount: new Prisma.Decimal(vendor.subtotal * 0.08),
        status: CommissionStatus.PENDING,
      },
    });
  }

  return order;
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Rute pentru Logistics Portal
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /logistics/dashboard - dashboard logistics
 * - GET /logistics/deliveries - livrări
 * - GET /logistics/stats - statistici logistics
 * - GET /logistics/commissions - comisioane logistics
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole, OrderVendorStatus } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * GET /logistics/dashboard
 * Dashboard pentru logistics users
 */
router.get('/dashboard', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // Pentru logistics, ar trebui să vedem toate comenzile în curs de livrare
    const [pendingDeliveries, inTransit, completed] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.orderVendor.count({
        where: { status: OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED },
      }),
      prisma.orderVendor.count({
        where: { status: OrderVendorStatus.SHIPPED },
      }),
      prisma.orderVendor.count({
        where: { status: OrderVendorStatus.DELIVERED },
      }),
    ]);

    res.json({
      pendingDeliveries,
      inTransit,
      completed,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get logistics dashboard error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea dashboard-ului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /logistics/deliveries
 * Listă livrările
 */
router.get('/deliveries', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { status } = req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (status && Object.values(OrderVendorStatus).includes(status as OrderVendorStatus)) {
      where.status = status;
    } else {
      // Implicit, doar comenzile în curs de livrare
      where.status = {
        in: [OrderVendorStatus.ACCEPTED, OrderVendorStatus.PREPARING, OrderVendorStatus.SHIPPED],
      };
    }

    const deliveries = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            shippingFullName: true,
            shippingAddressLine1: true,
            shippingCity: true,
            shippingPhone: true,
          },
        },
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        },
        items: {
          include: {
            product: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json(deliveries);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get deliveries error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea livrărilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /logistics/stats
 * Statistici logistics
 */
router.get('/stats', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const stats = await prisma.orderVendor.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
      _sum: {
        subtotal: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({
      byStatus: stats.reduce((acc, item) => {
        acc[item.status] = {
          count: item._count.id,
          total: item._sum.subtotal?.toString() || '0',
        };
        return acc;
      }, {} as Record<string, { count: number; total: string }>),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get logistics stats error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea statisticilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /logistics/commissions
 * Comisioane logistics (similar cu commissions pentru admin)
 */
router.get('/commissions', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const commissions = await prisma.commission.findMany({
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            totalAmount: true,
          },
        },
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json(commissions);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get logistics commissions error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea comisioanelor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /logistics/shipments
 * Listă toate livrările (shipments) cu tracking
 */
router.get('/shipments', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { status, trackingNumber } = req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (status && Object.values(OrderVendorStatus).includes(status as OrderVendorStatus)) {
      where.status = status;
    }
    if (trackingNumber && typeof trackingNumber === 'string') {
      where.trackingNumber = { contains: trackingNumber };
    }

    const shipments = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            shippingFullName: true,
            shippingAddressLine1: true,
            shippingAddressLine2: true,
            shippingCity: true,
            shippingPostalCode: true,
            shippingPhone: true,
            shippingRegion: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        },
        items: {
          include: {
            product: {
              select: {
                id: true,
                name: true,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json({ shipments });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get shipments error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea livrărilor' });
  }
});

export default router;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend Sync Status Configuration
 * 
 * Acest fișier controlează ce funcționalități sunt conectate live la backend
 * și ce funcționalități sunt încă în fallback mode.
 * 
 * Folosește acest status pentru:
 * - Afișarea fallback-urilor când endpoint-ul nu e încă live
 * - Prevenirea crash-urilor
 * - Testarea incrementală a funcționalităților
 * 
 * IMPORTANT: Setează `true` doar când endpoint-ul este complet funcțional și testat.
 */

export const BackendSyncStatus = {
  // Client Profile & Addresses
  clientProfile: true, // ✅ GET /clients/me, PATCH /clients/me - Implementat în backend
  clientAddresses: true, // ✅ GET /clients/addresses, POST/PATCH/DELETE /clients/addresses/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Cart & Checkout
  cart: true, // ✅ POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PATCH/PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id - Implementat în backend
  checkout: true, // ✅ POST /orders/checkout - Implementat în backend

  // Client Orders
  clientOrders: true, // ✅ GET /orders, GET /orders/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Portal
  producerProducts: true, // ✅ GET /producers/products, POST/PATCH/DELETE /producers/products/:id - Implementat în backend
  producerOrders: true, // ✅ GET /producers/orders, GET /producers/orders/:id, PATCH /producers/orders/:id/status - Implementat în backend

  // Favorites
  favorites: true, // ✅ GET /clients/favorites, POST /clients/favorites, DELETE /clients/favorites/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Subscription Baskets
  subscriptions: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions, POST /clients/subscriptions, PATCH /clients/subscriptions/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Silent Alerts
  alerts: true, // ✅ GET /clients/alert-preferences, PATCH /clients/alert-preferences - Implementat în backend

  // Business Portal
  businessDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /business/* - Implementat în backend

  // Logistics Portal
  logisticsDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Portal
  investorDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /investor/* - Implementat în backend
  investorMetrics: true, // ✅ GET /investor/metrics - Implementat în backend

  // Notifications System
  notifications: true, // ✅ GET /notifications/* - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Marketing & Monetization
  producerMarketing: false, // ⚠️ GET /producers/featured - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Client Subscriptions (Public)
  subscriptionsClient: false, // ⚠️ GET /subscriptions/public/plans - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Client Subscriptions (Active)
  subscriptionsClientActive: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions - Implementat în backend (deja activat ca 'subscriptions')

  // Producer Subscriptions (Tiers)
  subscriptionsProducer: false, // ⚠️ GET /producers/subscriptions - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Farmero Points & Rewards
  farmeroPoints: false, // ⚠️ GET /farmero-points/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Parties & Contracts
  partiesAndContracts: false, // ⚠️ GET /contracts - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Fees & Statements
  feesAndStatements: false, // ⚠️ GET /fees/*, GET /statements - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Donations
  donations: false, // ⚠️ GET /donations/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Documents & Contracts
  documents: true, // ✅ GET /documents/* - Implementat în backend

  // Subscriptions (Client & Producer) - deja activat ca 'subscriptions' mai sus
  // subscriptions: true, // ✅ Duplicat - deja activat mai sus

  // Promotions & Marketing
  promotions: true, // ✅ GET /producer/promotions/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Metrics (Anonymized) - duplicat cu investorMetrics
  // investorMetrics: false, // ⚠️ Duplicat - deja definit mai sus

  // Shipments & AWB
  shipments: false, // ⚠️ GET /logistics/shipments - Necesită verificare endpoint specific
} as const

export type BackendSyncFeature = keyof typeof BackendSyncStatus

/**
 * Check if a feature is enabled
 */
export function isBackendSyncEnabled(feature: BackendSyncFeature): boolean {
  return BackendSyncStatus[feature] === true
}

/**
 * Get all enabled features
 */
export function getEnabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === true)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

/**
 * Get all disabled features
 */
export function getDisabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === false)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}
```

Adăugând endpoint-ul pentru producători featured:


```typescript
/**
 * CRUD pentru producători
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Prisma, ProducerStatus, ProducerType, UserRole } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import {
  sendProducerApprovalEmail,
  sendProducerRejectionEmail,
} from '../email/email.service';

const router = Router();

// Schema pentru înregistrare producător nou (self-registration)
const producerRegisterSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, 'Numele trebuie să aibă minim 2 caractere'),
  registrationNumber: z.string().min(3, 'Număr de înregistrare invalid'), // CUI
  type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType),
  mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().optional().nullable(),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional().nullable(),
  // Note: Add fields for documents, address, contact when needed
  // documents: z.array(z.string()).optional(), // URLs către documente
  // address: z.string().optional(),
  // phone: z.string().optional(),
  // email: z.string().email().optional(),
});

// Schema pentru creare producător de către admin
const producerCreateSchema = z.object({
  userId: z.string().uuid(),
  name: z.string().min(2, 'Numele trebuie să aibă minim 2 caractere'),
  registrationNumber: z.string().min(3, 'Număr de înregistrare invalid'),
  type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType),
  mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().optional().nullable(),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional().nullable(),
});

const producerUpdateSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string().min(2).optional(),
    registrationNumber: z.string().min(3).optional(),
    type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType).optional(),
    mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().nullable().optional(),
    description: z.string().max(1000).nullable().optional(),
    status: z.nativeEnum(ProducerStatus).optional(),
  })
  .refine((data) => Object.keys(data).length > 0, {
    message: 'Trebuie furnizat cel puțin un câmp pentru actualizare',
  });

/**
 * POST /api/producers/register
 * Înregistrare producător nou (self-registration)
 * User-ul trebuie să fie deja autentificat și să aibă rol PRODUCER
 */
router.post('/register', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // Verifică că user-ul are rol PRODUCER
    if (req.user.role !== UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Doar utilizatorii cu rol PRODUCER pot înregistra un profil de producător' });
    }

    const data = producerRegisterSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Verifică dacă user-ul are deja un profil de producător
    const existingProducer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
    });

    if (existingProducer) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Aveți deja un profil de producător' });
    }

    // Creează profilul de producător cu status PENDING_VERIFICATION
    const producer = await prisma.producer.create({
      data: {
        userId: req.user.userId,
        name: data.name,
        registrationNumber: data.registrationNumber,
        type: data.type,
        mainRegionId: data.mainRegionId ?? null,
        description: data.description ?? null,
        status: ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION, // Status inițial: PENDING
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: true,
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      producer,
      message: 'Profilul de producător a fost creat cu succes. Așteptați aprobarea administratorului.',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Register producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la înregistrarea producătorului' });
  }
});

// Exportăm funcțiile admin într-un router separat
const adminRouter = Router();

// GET /api/admin/producers - doar ADMIN, cu filtre opționale
adminRouter.get(
  '/producers',
  requireAuth,
  requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN),
  async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { status, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {};
    if (status) {
      if (!Object.values(ProducerStatus).includes(status as ProducerStatus)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Status invalid' });
      }
      where.status = status as ProducerStatus;
    }
    if (regionId) {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId as string;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
            role: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
        mainRegion: true,
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json({ producers });
  }
);

/**
 * GET /api/producers/me
 * Obține profilul producătorului curent
 * Necesită rol PRODUCER
 */
router.get('/me', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profil producător negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({ producer });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get producer me error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea profilului' });
  }
});

/**
 * PATCH /api/producers/me
 * Actualizează profilul producătorului curent
 * Necesită rol PRODUCER
 * Nu poate schimba status-ul (doar admin poate)
 */
router.patch('/me', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = producerUpdateSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Găsește profilul producătorului
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profil producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Producătorul nu poate schimba status-ul sau userId-ul
    const updateData: Prisma.ProducerUpdateInput = {
      ...data,
    };
    delete updateData.status; // Nu permite schimbarea status-ului

    // Dacă producătorul aprobat modifică datele, revine în PENDING_VERIFICATION
    if (producer.status === ProducerStatus.APPROVED && Object.keys(updateData).length > 0) {
      updateData.status = ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION;
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: producer.id },
      data: updateData,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.json({
      producer: updatedProducer,
      message: updatedProducer.status === ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION
        ? 'Profilul a fost actualizat. Așteptați re-aprobarea administratorului.'
        : 'Profilul a fost actualizat cu succes.',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Update producer me error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea profilului' });
  }
});

// POST /producers - doar ADMIN
router.post(
  '/',
  requireAuth,
  requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN),
  async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      const data = producerCreateSchema.parse(req.body);

      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: data.userId },
      });

      if (!user) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'User inexistent' });
      }

      if (user.role !== UserRole.PRODUCER) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'User-ul trebuie să aibă rol PRODUCER' });
      }

      const existingProducer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { userId: data.userId },
      });

      if (existingProducer) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Acest user are deja profil de producător' });
      }

      const producer = await prisma.producer.create({
        data: {
          userId: data.userId,
          name: data.name,
          registrationNumber: data.registrationNumber,
          type: data.type,
          mainRegionId: data.mainRegionId ?? null,
          description: data.description ?? null,
          status: ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION,
        },
        include: {
          mainRegion: true,
        },
      });

      res.status(201).json({ producer });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
      }
      console.error('Create producer error:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la crearea producătorului' });
    }
  }
);

/**
 * PATCH /api/admin/producers/:id/approve
 * Aprobă un producător (doar ADMIN)
 */
adminRouter.patch('/producers/:id/approve', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      data: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Trimite email de aprobare
    sendProducerApprovalEmail({
      id: updatedProducer.id,
      name: updatedProducer.name,
      user: updatedProducer.user,
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.error('Error sending producer approval email:', err);
    });

    res.json({
      producer: updatedProducer,
      message: 'Producătorul a fost aprobat cu succes',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Approve producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la aprobarea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * PATCH /api/admin/producers/:id/reject
 * Respinge un producător (doar ADMIN)
 */
// Schema pentru respingere producător (cu motiv opțional)
const producerRejectSchema = z.object({
  reason: z.string().max(500).optional(),
});

adminRouter.patch('/producers/:id/reject', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { reason } = producerRejectSchema.parse(req.body);

    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      data: {
        status: ProducerStatus.REJECTED,
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Trimite email de respingere
    sendProducerRejectionEmail(
      {
        id: updatedProducer.id,
        name: updatedProducer.name,
        user: updatedProducer.user,
      },
      reason
    ).catch((err) => {
      console.error('Error sending producer rejection email:', err);
    });

    res.json({
      producer: updatedProducer,
      message: 'Producătorul a fost respins',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Date invalide',
        details: error.issues,
      });
    }
    console.error('Reject producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la respingerea producătorului' });
  }
});

// PUT /producers/:id - update (ADMIN orice, PRODUCER doar propriul profil)
// DEPRECATED: folosește PATCH /api/producers/me pentru producător
router.put('/:id', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = producerUpdateSchema.parse(req.body);
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    const isAdmin = req.user.role === UserRole.ADMIN;
    const isOwner = producer.userId === req.user.userId;

    if (!isAdmin && !isOwner) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Acces interzis' });
    }

    const updateData: Prisma.ProducerUpdateInput = {
      ...data,
    };

    if (!isAdmin) {
      // Producătorul nu își poate schimba singur status-ul sau userId-ul
      delete updateData.status;
    }

    if (data.status && isAdmin) {
      updateData.status = data.status;
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      data: updateData,
      include: {
        mainRegion: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ producer: updatedProducer });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Update producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /producers/featured
 * Returnează producătorii featured (recomandați)
 */
router.get('/featured', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    // Producătorii featured sunt cei aprobați cu cele mai multe produse aprobate
    const featuredProducers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        _count: {
          select: {
            products: {
              where: {
                status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        products: {
          _count: 'desc',
        },
      },
      take: 10, // Top 10 producători
    });

    res.json({ producers: featuredProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get featured producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor featured' });
  }
});

export default router;
export { adminRouter };
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend Sync Status Configuration
 * 
 * Acest fișier controlează ce funcționalități sunt conectate live la backend
 * și ce funcționalități sunt încă în fallback mode.
 * 
 * Folosește acest status pentru:
 * - Afișarea fallback-urilor când endpoint-ul nu e încă live
 * - Prevenirea crash-urilor
 * - Testarea incrementală a funcționalităților
 * 
 * IMPORTANT: Setează `true` doar când endpoint-ul este complet funcțional și testat.
 */

export const BackendSyncStatus = {
  // Client Profile & Addresses
  clientProfile: true, // ✅ GET /clients/me, PATCH /clients/me - Implementat în backend
  clientAddresses: true, // ✅ GET /clients/addresses, POST/PATCH/DELETE /clients/addresses/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Cart & Checkout
  cart: true, // ✅ POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PATCH/PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id - Implementat în backend
  checkout: true, // ✅ POST /orders/checkout - Implementat în backend

  // Client Orders
  clientOrders: true, // ✅ GET /orders, GET /orders/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Portal
  producerProducts: true, // ✅ GET /producers/products, POST/PATCH/DELETE /producers/products/:id - Implementat în backend
  producerOrders: true, // ✅ GET /producers/orders, GET /producers/orders/:id, PATCH /producers/orders/:id/status - Implementat în backend

  // Favorites
  favorites: true, // ✅ GET /clients/favorites, POST /clients/favorites, DELETE /clients/favorites/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Subscription Baskets
  subscriptions: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions, POST /clients/subscriptions, PATCH /clients/subscriptions/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Silent Alerts
  alerts: true, // ✅ GET /clients/alert-preferences, PATCH /clients/alert-preferences - Implementat în backend

  // Business Portal
  businessDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /business/* - Implementat în backend

  // Logistics Portal
  logisticsDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Portal
  investorDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /investor/* - Implementat în backend
  investorMetrics: true, // ✅ GET /investor/metrics - Implementat în backend

  // Notifications System
  notifications: true, // ✅ GET /notifications/* - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Marketing & Monetization
  producerMarketing: true, // ✅ GET /producers/featured - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Public)
  subscriptionsClient: false, // ⚠️ GET /subscriptions/public/plans - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Client Subscriptions (Active)
  subscriptionsClientActive: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions - Implementat în backend (deja activat ca 'subscriptions')

  // Producer Subscriptions (Tiers)
  subscriptionsProducer: false, // ⚠️ GET /producers/subscriptions - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Farmero Points & Rewards
  farmeroPoints: false, // ⚠️ GET /farmero-points/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Parties & Contracts
  partiesAndContracts: false, // ⚠️ GET /contracts - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Fees & Statements
  feesAndStatements: false, // ⚠️ GET /fees/*, GET /statements - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Donations
  donations: false, // ⚠️ GET /donations/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Documents & Contracts
  documents: true, // ✅ GET /documents/* - Implementat în backend

  // Subscriptions (Client & Producer) - deja activat ca 'subscriptions' mai sus
  // subscriptions: true, // ✅ Duplicat - deja activat mai sus

  // Promotions & Marketing
  promotions: true, // ✅ GET /producer/promotions/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Metrics (Anonymized) - duplicat cu investorMetrics
  // investorMetrics: false, // ⚠️ Duplicat - deja definit mai sus

  // Shipments & AWB
  shipments: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/shipments - Implementat în backend
} as const

export type BackendSyncFeature = keyof typeof BackendSyncStatus

/**
 * Check if a feature is enabled
 */
export function isBackendSyncEnabled(feature: BackendSyncFeature): boolean {
  return BackendSyncStatus[feature] === true
}

/**
 * Get all enabled features
 */
export function getEnabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === true)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

/**
 * Get all disabled features
 */
export function getDisabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === false)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Rute publice pentru Subscription Plans
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /subscriptions/public/plans - listă planurile de abonament disponibile
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { ProductStatus } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * GET /subscriptions/public/plans
 * Returnează planurile de abonament disponibile (produse cu abonament activ)
 */
router.get('/plans', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    // Găsește produsele care au abonamente active
    const productsWithSubscriptions = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        subscriptions: {
          where: {
            isActive: true,
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            frequency: true,
            quantity: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        subscriptions: {
          _count: 'desc',
        },
      },
      take: 50, // Top 50 produse cu abonamente
    });

    // Formatează planurile
    const plans = productsWithSubscriptions
      .filter((product) => product.subscriptions.length > 0)
      .map((product) => ({
        productId: product.id,
        productName: product.name,
        productDescription: product.description,
        productPrice: product.price.toString(),
        productImageUrl: product.imageUrl,
        producer: product.producer,
        availableFrequencies: ['weekly', 'biweekly', 'monthly'] as const,
        subscriptionCount: product.subscriptions.length,
      }));

    res.json({ plans });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get subscription plans error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea planurilor de abonament' });
  }
});

export default router;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for /products to public products endpoint
app.use('/products', publicRoutes);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for /products to public products endpoint
app.use('/products', publicRoutes);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend Sync Status Configuration
 * 
 * Acest fișier controlează ce funcționalități sunt conectate live la backend
 * și ce funcționalități sunt încă în fallback mode.
 * 
 * Folosește acest status pentru:
 * - Afișarea fallback-urilor când endpoint-ul nu e încă live
 * - Prevenirea crash-urilor
 * - Testarea incrementală a funcționalităților
 * 
 * IMPORTANT: Setează `true` doar când endpoint-ul este complet funcțional și testat.
 */

export const BackendSyncStatus = {
  // Client Profile & Addresses
  clientProfile: true, // ✅ GET /clients/me, PATCH /clients/me - Implementat în backend
  clientAddresses: true, // ✅ GET /clients/addresses, POST/PATCH/DELETE /clients/addresses/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Cart & Checkout
  cart: true, // ✅ POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PATCH/PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id - Implementat în backend
  checkout: true, // ✅ POST /orders/checkout - Implementat în backend

  // Client Orders
  clientOrders: true, // ✅ GET /orders, GET /orders/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Portal
  producerProducts: true, // ✅ GET /producers/products, POST/PATCH/DELETE /producers/products/:id - Implementat în backend
  producerOrders: true, // ✅ GET /producers/orders, GET /producers/orders/:id, PATCH /producers/orders/:id/status - Implementat în backend

  // Favorites
  favorites: true, // ✅ GET /clients/favorites, POST /clients/favorites, DELETE /clients/favorites/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Subscription Baskets
  subscriptions: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions, POST /clients/subscriptions, PATCH /clients/subscriptions/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Silent Alerts
  alerts: true, // ✅ GET /clients/alert-preferences, PATCH /clients/alert-preferences - Implementat în backend

  // Business Portal
  businessDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /business/* - Implementat în backend

  // Logistics Portal
  logisticsDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Portal
  investorDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /investor/* - Implementat în backend
  investorMetrics: true, // ✅ GET /investor/metrics - Implementat în backend

  // Notifications System
  notifications: true, // ✅ GET /notifications/* - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Marketing & Monetization
  producerMarketing: true, // ✅ GET /producers/featured - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Public)
  subscriptionsClient: true, // ✅ GET /subscriptions/public/plans - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Active)
  subscriptionsClientActive: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions - Implementat în backend (deja activat ca 'subscriptions')

  // Producer Subscriptions (Tiers)
  subscriptionsProducer: false, // ⚠️ GET /producers/subscriptions - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Farmero Points & Rewards
  farmeroPoints: false, // ⚠️ GET /farmero-points/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Parties & Contracts
  partiesAndContracts: false, // ⚠️ GET /contracts - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Fees & Statements
  feesAndStatements: false, // ⚠️ GET /fees/*, GET /statements - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Donations
  donations: false, // ⚠️ GET /donations/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Documents & Contracts
  documents: true, // ✅ GET /documents/* - Implementat în backend

  // Subscriptions (Client & Producer) - deja activat ca 'subscriptions' mai sus
  // subscriptions: true, // ✅ Duplicat - deja activat mai sus

  // Promotions & Marketing
  promotions: true, // ✅ GET /producer/promotions/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Metrics (Anonymized) - duplicat cu investorMetrics
  // investorMetrics: false, // ⚠️ Duplicat - deja definit mai sus

  // Shipments & AWB
  shipments: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/shipments - Implementat în backend
} as const

export type BackendSyncFeature = keyof typeof BackendSyncStatus

/**
 * Check if a feature is enabled
 */
export function isBackendSyncEnabled(feature: BackendSyncFeature): boolean {
  return BackendSyncStatus[feature] === true
}

/**
 * Get all enabled features
 */
export function getEnabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === true)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

/**
 * Get all disabled features
 */
export function getDisabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === false)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * CRUD pentru producători
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { Prisma, ProducerStatus, ProducerType, UserRole, ProductStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import {
  sendProducerApprovalEmail,
  sendProducerRejectionEmail,
} from '../email/email.service';

const router = Router();

// Schema pentru înregistrare producător nou (self-registration)
const producerRegisterSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, 'Numele trebuie să aibă minim 2 caractere'),
  registrationNumber: z.string().min(3, 'Număr de înregistrare invalid'), // CUI
  type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType),
  mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().optional().nullable(),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional().nullable(),
  // Note: Add fields for documents, address, contact when needed
  // documents: z.array(z.string()).optional(), // URLs către documente
  // address: z.string().optional(),
  // phone: z.string().optional(),
  // email: z.string().email().optional(),
});

// Schema pentru creare producător de către admin
const producerCreateSchema = z.object({
  userId: z.string().uuid(),
  name: z.string().min(2, 'Numele trebuie să aibă minim 2 caractere'),
  registrationNumber: z.string().min(3, 'Număr de înregistrare invalid'),
  type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType),
  mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().optional().nullable(),
  description: z.string().max(1000).optional().nullable(),
});

const producerUpdateSchema = z
  .object({
    name: z.string().min(2).optional(),
    registrationNumber: z.string().min(3).optional(),
    type: z.nativeEnum(ProducerType).optional(),
    mainRegionId: z.string().uuid().nullable().optional(),
    description: z.string().max(1000).nullable().optional(),
    status: z.nativeEnum(ProducerStatus).optional(),
  })
  .refine((data) => Object.keys(data).length > 0, {
    message: 'Trebuie furnizat cel puțin un câmp pentru actualizare',
  });

/**
 * POST /api/producers/register
 * Înregistrare producător nou (self-registration)
 * User-ul trebuie să fie deja autentificat și să aibă rol PRODUCER
 */
router.post('/register', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // Verifică că user-ul are rol PRODUCER
    if (req.user.role !== UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Doar utilizatorii cu rol PRODUCER pot înregistra un profil de producător' });
    }

    const data = producerRegisterSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Verifică dacă user-ul are deja un profil de producător
    const existingProducer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
    });

    if (existingProducer) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Aveți deja un profil de producător' });
    }

    // Creează profilul de producător cu status PENDING_VERIFICATION
    const producer = await prisma.producer.create({
      data: {
        userId: req.user.userId,
        name: data.name,
        registrationNumber: data.registrationNumber,
        type: data.type,
        mainRegionId: data.mainRegionId ?? null,
        description: data.description ?? null,
        status: ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION, // Status inițial: PENDING
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: true,
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      producer,
      message: 'Profilul de producător a fost creat cu succes. Așteptați aprobarea administratorului.',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Register producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la înregistrarea producătorului' });
  }
});

// Exportăm funcțiile admin într-un router separat
const adminRouter = Router();

// GET /api/admin/producers - doar ADMIN, cu filtre opționale
adminRouter.get(
  '/producers',
  requireAuth,
  requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN),
  async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { status, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {};
    if (status) {
      if (!Object.values(ProducerStatus).includes(status as ProducerStatus)) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Status invalid' });
      }
      where.status = status as ProducerStatus;
    }
    if (regionId) {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId as string;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({

      include: {

          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
            role: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
        mainRegion: true,
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    res.json({ producers });
  }
);

/**

 */

  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({

        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profil producător negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({ producer });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get producer me error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea profilului' });
  }
});

/**
 * PATCH /api/producers/me
 * Actualizează profilul producătorului curent
 * Necesită rol PRODUCER
 * Nu poate schimba status-ul (doar admin poate)
 */
router.patch('/me', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = producerUpdateSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Găsește profilul producătorului
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profil producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Producătorul nu poate schimba status-ul sau userId-ul
    const updateData: Prisma.ProducerUpdateInput = {
      ...data,
    };
    delete updateData.status; // Nu permite schimbarea status-ului

    // Dacă producătorul aprobat modifică datele, revine în PENDING_VERIFICATION
    if (producer.status === ProducerStatus.APPROVED && Object.keys(updateData).length > 0) {
      updateData.status = ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION;
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: producer.id },
      data: updateData,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
            type: true,
          },
        },
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            email: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.json({
      producer: updatedProducer,
      message: updatedProducer.status === ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION
        ? 'Profilul a fost actualizat. Așteptați re-aprobarea administratorului.'
        : 'Profilul a fost actualizat cu succes.',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Update producer me error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea profilului' });
  }
});

// POST /producers - doar ADMIN

          status: ProducerStatus.PENDING_VERIFICATION,
```
