```typescript
// PUT /producers/:id - update (ADMIN orice, PRODUCER doar propriul profil)
// DEPRECATED: folosește PATCH /api/producers/me pentru producător
router.put('/:id', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = producerUpdateSchema.parse(req.body);
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    const isAdmin = req.user.role === UserRole.ADMIN;
    const isOwner = producer.userId === req.user.userId;

    if (!isAdmin && !isOwner) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Acces interzis' });
    }

    const updateData: Prisma.ProducerUpdateInput = {
      ...data,
    };

    if (!isAdmin) {
      // Producătorul nu își poate schimba singur status-ul sau userId-ul
      delete updateData.status;
    }

    if (data.status && isAdmin) {
      updateData.status = data.status;
    }

    const updatedProducer = await prisma.producer.update({
      where: { id: req.params.id },
      data: updateData,
      include: {
        mainRegion: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ producer: updatedProducer });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Update producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /producers/featured
 * Returnează producătorii featured (recomandați)
 */
router.get('/featured', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    // Producătorii featured sunt cei aprobați cu cele mai multe produse aprobate
    const featuredProducers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
        _count: {
          select: {
            products: {
              where: {
                status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        products: {
          _count: 'desc',
        },
      },
      take: 10, // Top 10 producători
    });

    res.json({ producers: featuredProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get featured producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor featured' });
  }
});

export default router;
export { adminRouter };
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);

// Direct route for /products (frontend compatibility)
// Import the handler from public routes
import { Request, Response } from 'express';
const getPublicProducts = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  // Import the handler dynamically to avoid circular dependencies
  const { default: publicRouter } = await import('./modules/public/public.routes');
  // Create a temporary router to extract the handler
  const tempRouter = require('express').Router();
  tempRouter.get('/products', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const { Prisma, ProductStatus, ProducerStatus } = await import('@prisma/client');
    
    try {
      const { search, q, category, categoryId, regionId, priceMin, priceMax, sort, page = '1', limit = '12' } = req.query;

      const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10) || 1;
      const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit as string, 10) || 12, 100);
      const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

      const where: any = {
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
        producer: {
          status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
        },
      };

      const searchQuery = (search && typeof search === 'string') ? search : (q && typeof q === 'string' ? q : null);
      if (searchQuery) {
        where.OR = [
          { name: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
          { description: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
        ];
      }

      if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
        where.OR = [
          { regionId: regionId },
          { producer: { mainRegionId: regionId } },
        ];
      }

      if (priceMin && typeof priceMin === 'string') {
        const priceMinNum = parseFloat(priceMin);
        if (!isNaN(priceMinNum)) {
          where.price = { ...where.price, gte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMinNum) };
        }
      }

      if (priceMax && typeof priceMax === 'string') {
        const priceMaxNum = parseFloat(priceMax);
        if (!isNaN(priceMaxNum)) {
          where.price = { ...where.price, lte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMaxNum) };
        }
      }

      let orderBy: any = { createdAt: 'desc' };
      if (sort && typeof sort === 'string') {
        switch (sort) {
          case 'price_asc': orderBy = { price: 'asc' }; break;
          case 'price_desc': orderBy = { price: 'desc' }; break;
          case 'name_asc': orderBy = { name: 'asc' }; break;
          case 'name_desc': orderBy = { name: 'desc' }; break;
          case 'newest': orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' }; break;
          case 'oldest': orderBy = { createdAt: 'asc' }; break;
        }
      }

      const total = await prisma.product.count({ where });
      const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
        where,
        include: {
          producer: {
            select: { id: true, name: true, status: true },
          },
          traditionalRegion: {
            select: { id: true, name: true, code: true },
          },
        },
        orderBy,
        skip,
        take: limitNum,
      });

      function generateSlug(name: string): string {
        return name.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
      }

      const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.name),
        description: product.description,
        price: Number(product.price),
        unit: product.unit || null,
        imageUrl: product.imageUrl || null,
        producer: {
          id: product.producer.id,
          name: product.producer.name,
          slug: generateSlug(product.producer.name),
        },
        category: product.category || null,
        isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
        isBio: product.isBio || false,
        stock: product.stock,
      }));

      res.json({
        data: formattedProducts,
        pagination: {
          page: pageNum,
          limit: limitNum,
          total,
          totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
        },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Get products error:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea produselor' });
    }
  };
  
  return tempRouter(req, res, () => {});
};

app.get('/products', getPublicProducts);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });

    res.json({ regions: [] });
```

```typescript
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));

  }
});
```

```typescript
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - create a separate router that mounts at root
const productsRouter = Router();
productsRouter.get('/', async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
  // Forward to the public routes handler by changing the path
  req.url = '/api/public/products';
  req.path = '/api/public/products';
  return publicRoutes(req, res, next);
});
app.use('/products', productsRouter);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

Extrăgând handler-ul într-o funcție separată:


```typescript
/**
 * Rute publice pentru marketplace
 * 
 * Endpoints publice (fără autentificare) pentru:
 * - Listare produse aprobate
 * - Detalii produs
 * - Listare producători aprobați
 * - Detalii producător
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma, ProductStatus, ProducerStatus, RegionType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Helper: generează slug din nume
 */
function generateSlug(name: string): string {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '') // Remove diacritics
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește produs după slug sau id
 */
async function findProductBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
    },
    include: {
      producer: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          status: true,
        },
      },
      traditionalRegion: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  return products.find((p) => generateSlug(p.name) === slugOrId);
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește producător după slug sau id
 */
async function findProducerBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
    where: {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    },
    include: {
      mainRegion: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  return producers.find((p) => generateSlug(p.name) === slugOrId);
}

/**
 * Handler pentru GET /products - exportat pentru reutilizare
 */
export async function getProductsHandler(req: Request, res: Response) {
  try {
    const { search, q, category, categoryId, regionId, priceMin, priceMax, sort, page = '1', limit = '12' } = req.query;

    const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10) || 1;
    const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit as string, 10) || 12, 100); // Max 100 per page, default 12
    const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

    const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      // Doar produse de la producători aprobați
      producer: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    // Suportă atât 'search' cât și 'q' pentru compatibilitate
    const searchQuery = (search && typeof search === 'string') ? search : (q && typeof q === 'string' ? q : null);
    if (searchQuery) {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { name: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
            { description: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar acceptăm parametrii pentru compatibilitate)
    // Note: Category filter will be implemented when category is added to Product schema
    if ((category && typeof category === 'string') || (categoryId && typeof categoryId === 'string')) {
      // Pentru moment, ignorăm filtrul (categoria nu există în schema)
      // Când categoria va fi adăugată, va trebui să adăugăm:
      // if (categoryId) where.categoryId = categoryId;
      // sau
      // if (category) where.category = { slug: category };
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    // Poate filtra după regiunea tradițională a produsului SAU regiunea producătorului
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { regionId: regionId }, // Regiune tradițională a produsului
            { producer: { mainRegionId: regionId } }, // Regiunea producătorului
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după preț minim
    if (priceMin && typeof priceMin === 'string') {
      const priceMinNum = parseFloat(priceMin);
      if (!isNaN(priceMinNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { gte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMinNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după preț maxim
    if (priceMax && typeof priceMax === 'string') {
      const priceMaxNum = parseFloat(priceMax);
      if (!isNaN(priceMaxNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { lte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMaxNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar păstrăm pentru viitor)
    // if (category && typeof category === 'string') {
    //   where.category = category;
    // }

    // Sortare
    let orderBy: Prisma.ProductOrderByWithRelationInput = { createdAt: 'desc' }; // default: newest
    if (sort && typeof sort === 'string') {
      switch (sort) {
        case 'price_asc':
          orderBy = { price: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'price_desc':
          orderBy = { price: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'name_asc':
          orderBy = { name: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'name_desc':
          orderBy = { name: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'newest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'oldest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'asc' };
          break;
        default:
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
      }
    }

    // Obține totalul pentru paginare
    const total = await prisma.product.count({ where });

    // Obține produsele
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy,
      skip,
      take: limitNum,
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      description: product.description,
      price: Number(product.price),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: product.producer.id,
        name: product.producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.producer.name),
      },
      category: product.category || null,
      isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
      isBio: product.isBio || false,
      stock: product.stock,
    }));

    res.json({
      data: formattedProducts,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public products error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({
      data: [],
      pagination: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 12,
        total: 0,
        totalPages: 0,
      },
    });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/products/:slug
 * Detalii produs după slug sau id
 */
router.get('/products/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const product = await findProductBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    if (product.status !== ProductStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Verifică că producătorul este aprobat
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: product.producerId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        description: true,
        status: true,
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer || producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({
      product: {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.name),
        price: product.price.toString(),
        unit: product.unit || null,
        image: product.imageUrl || null,
        description: product.description,
        stock: product.stock,
        isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
        isBio: product.isBio || false,
        producer: {
          id: producer.id,
          name: producer.name,
          slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
          description: producer.description,
          region: producer.mainRegion
            ? {
                id: producer.mainRegion.id,
                name: producer.mainRegion.name,
                code: producer.mainRegion.code,
              }
            : null,
        },
        region: product.traditionalRegion
          ? {
              id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
              name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
              code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public product error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea produsului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers
 * Listează producătorii APPROVED cu filtre
 */
router.get('/producers', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { q, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    if (q && typeof q === 'string') {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
        { description: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul
    const formattedProducers = producers.map((producer) => ({
      id: producer.id,
      slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      name: producer.name,
      description: producer.description,
      type: producer.type,
      region: producer.mainRegion
        ? {
            id: producer.mainRegion.id,
            name: producer.mainRegion.name,
            code: producer.mainRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({ producers: formattedProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers/:slug
 * Detalii producător după slug sau id + produse active
 */
router.get('/producers/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const producer = await findProducerBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });

    if (producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });

    // Obține produsele aprobate ale producătorului
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    // Formatează produsele conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      price: product.price.toString(),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      image: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        name: producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      },
      region: product.traditionalRegion
        ? {
            id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
            name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
            code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
        name: producer.name,
        description: producer.description,
        type: producer.type,
        // Nu expunem registrationNumber (dată sensibilă)
        region: producer.mainRegion
          ? {
              id: producer.mainRegion.id,
              name: producer.mainRegion.name,
              code: producer.mainRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
        products: formattedProducts,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorului' });
  }
});

    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';

import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents

// Root endpoint - API information

    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {

});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)

// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)

// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes

app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes

// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154

app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);

app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

Verificând și corectând eroarea de sintaxă:


```typescript
/**
 * Rute publice pentru marketplace
 * 
 * Endpoints publice (fără autentificare) pentru:
 * - Listare produse aprobate
 * - Detalii produs
 * - Listare producători aprobați
 * - Detalii producător
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma, ProductStatus, ProducerStatus, RegionType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Helper: generează slug din nume
 */
function generateSlug(name: string): string {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '') // Remove diacritics
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește produs după slug sau id
 */
async function findProductBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
    },
    include: {
      producer: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          status: true,
        },
      },
      traditionalRegion: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  return products.find((p) => generateSlug(p.name) === slugOrId);
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește producător după slug sau id
 */
async function findProducerBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
    where: {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    },
    include: {
      mainRegion: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  return producers.find((p) => generateSlug(p.name) === slugOrId);
}

/**
 * Handler pentru GET /products - exportat pentru reutilizare
 */
export async function getProductsHandler(req: Request, res: Response) {
  try {
    const { search, q, category, categoryId, regionId, priceMin, priceMax, sort, page = '1', limit = '12' } = req.query;

    const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10) || 1;
    const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit as string, 10) || 12, 100); // Max 100 per page, default 12
    const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

    const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      // Doar produse de la producători aprobați
      producer: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    // Suportă atât 'search' cât și 'q' pentru compatibilitate
    const searchQuery = (search && typeof search === 'string') ? search : (q && typeof q === 'string' ? q : null);
    if (searchQuery) {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { name: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
            { description: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar acceptăm parametrii pentru compatibilitate)
    // Note: Category filter will be implemented when category is added to Product schema
    if ((category && typeof category === 'string') || (categoryId && typeof categoryId === 'string')) {
      // Pentru moment, ignorăm filtrul (categoria nu există în schema)
      // Când categoria va fi adăugată, va trebui să adăugăm:
      // if (categoryId) where.categoryId = categoryId;
      // sau
      // if (category) where.category = { slug: category };
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    // Poate filtra după regiunea tradițională a produsului SAU regiunea producătorului
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { regionId: regionId }, // Regiune tradițională a produsului
            { producer: { mainRegionId: regionId } }, // Regiunea producătorului
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după preț minim
    if (priceMin && typeof priceMin === 'string') {
      const priceMinNum = parseFloat(priceMin);
      if (!isNaN(priceMinNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { gte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMinNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după preț maxim
    if (priceMax && typeof priceMax === 'string') {
      const priceMaxNum = parseFloat(priceMax);
      if (!isNaN(priceMaxNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { lte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMaxNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar păstrăm pentru viitor)
    // if (category && typeof category === 'string') {
    //   where.category = category;
    // }

    // Sortare
    let orderBy: Prisma.ProductOrderByWithRelationInput = { createdAt: 'desc' }; // default: newest
    if (sort && typeof sort === 'string') {
      switch (sort) {
        case 'price_asc':
          orderBy = { price: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'price_desc':
          orderBy = { price: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'name_asc':
          orderBy = { name: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'name_desc':
          orderBy = { name: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'newest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'oldest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'asc' };
          break;
        default:
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
      }
    }

    // Obține totalul pentru paginare
    const total = await prisma.product.count({ where });

    // Obține produsele
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy,
      skip,
      take: limitNum,
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      description: product.description,
      price: Number(product.price),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: product.producer.id,
        name: product.producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.producer.name),
      },
      category: product.category || null,
      isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
      isBio: product.isBio || false,
      stock: product.stock,
    }));

    res.json({
      data: formattedProducts,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public products error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({
      data: [],
      pagination: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 12,
        total: 0,
        totalPages: 0,
      },
    });
  }
}

// Mount handler on router
router.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

/**
 * GET /api/public/products/:slug
 * Detalii produs după slug sau id
 */
router.get('/products/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const product = await findProductBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    if (product.status !== ProductStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Verifică că producătorul este aprobat
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: product.producerId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        description: true,
        status: true,
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer || producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({
      product: {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.name),
        price: product.price.toString(),
        unit: product.unit || null,
        image: product.imageUrl || null,
        description: product.description,
        stock: product.stock,
        isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
        isBio: product.isBio || false,
        producer: {
          id: producer.id,
          name: producer.name,
          slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
          description: producer.description,
          region: producer.mainRegion
            ? {
                id: producer.mainRegion.id,
                name: producer.mainRegion.name,
                code: producer.mainRegion.code,
              }
            : null,
        },
        region: product.traditionalRegion
          ? {
              id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
              name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
              code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public product error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea produsului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers
 * Listează producătorii APPROVED cu filtre
 */
router.get('/producers', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { q, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    if (q && typeof q === 'string') {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
        { description: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul
    const formattedProducers = producers.map((producer) => ({
      id: producer.id,
      slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      name: producer.name,
      description: producer.description,
      type: producer.type,
      region: producer.mainRegion
        ? {
            id: producer.mainRegion.id,
            name: producer.mainRegion.name,
            code: producer.mainRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({ producers: formattedProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers/:slug
 * Detalii producător după slug sau id + produse active
 */
router.get('/producers/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const producer = await findProducerBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    if (producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Obține produsele aprobate ale producătorului
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    // Formatează produsele conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      price: product.price.toString(),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      image: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        name: producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      },
      region: product.traditionalRegion
        ? {
            id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
            name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
            code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
        name: producer.name,
        description: producer.description,
        type: producer.type,
        // Nu expunem registrationNumber (dată sensibilă)
        region: producer.mainRegion
          ? {
              id: producer.mainRegion.id,
              name: producer.mainRegion.name,
              code: producer.mainRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
        products: formattedProducts,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/regions
 * Listează toate regiunile (pentru filtre și selecție în frontend)
 */
router.get('/regions', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { type } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.RegionWhereInput = {};

    // Filtru după tip (COUNTY sau REGION)
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      if (Object.values(RegionType).includes(type as RegionType)) {
        where.type = type as RegionType;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public regions error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

export default router;
```

Build-ul trece. Făcând commit și push pentru fix:



Am rezolvat problema cu ruta `/products`.

## Rezumat fix

### Problema
Frontend-ul făcea request la `https://api.farme.ro/products` și primea 404 cu mesajul `{"data":null,"error":"Rută negăsită"}`.

### Cauza
Când făceam `app.use('/products', publicRoutes)`, rutele din `publicRoutes` erau prefixate cu `/products`, deci `router.get('/products', ...)` devenea `/products/products` în loc de `/products`.

### Soluția
1. Am extras handler-ul `getProductsHandler` din `public.routes.ts` ca funcție exportată.
2. Am adăugat o rută directă `app.get('/products', getProductsHandler)` în `index.ts`.
3. Acum `/products` funcționează corect.

### Commit & Push
- Commit: `9be9e24` - "fix: Add direct /products route handler to fix 404 error"
- Push: Trimis la `https://github.com/farme-ro/backend.git` pe branch-ul `chore/style-sync-live`

### Despre eroarea de spațiu pe disk
Eroarea `FILE_ERROR_NO_SPACE` din Chrome este locală (browser) și nu este legată de backend. Soluții:
1. Șterge cache-ul browserului (Chrome → Settings → Privacy → Clear browsing data)
2. Șterge datele IndexedDB pentru site
3. Verifică spațiul liber pe disk

După deploy, endpoint-ul `/products` ar trebui să funcționeze corect.

```typescript
      'create_products',
      'manage_orders',
      'view_analytics',
      'basic_support',
    ],
    limits: {
      maxProducts: 20,
      maxCampaigns: 1,
    },
  },
  professional: {
    name: 'Professional',
    price: 99,
    features: [
      'create_products',
      'manage_orders',
      'view_analytics',
      'priority_support',
      'create_campaigns',
      'boost_products',
      'advanced_analytics',
    ],
    limits: {
      maxProducts: 100,
      maxCampaigns: 5,
    },
  },
  enterprise: {
    name: 'Enterprise',
    price: 299,
    features: [
      'create_products',
      'manage_orders',
      'view_analytics',
      'dedicated_support',
      'unlimited_campaigns',
      'boost_products',
      'advanced_analytics',
      'api_access',
      'custom_integrations',
    ],
    limits: {
      maxProducts: -1, // Unlimited
      maxCampaigns: -1, // Unlimited
    },
  },
} as const;

/**
 * GET /producers/subscriptions
 * Obține planul de abonament al producătorului curent
 */
router.get('/', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId: req.user.userId },
      include: {
        products: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Profil producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Determină planul bazat pe numărul de produse și status
    let currentPlan: keyof typeof PRODUCER_PLANS = 'basic';
    
    const productCount = producer.products.length;
    const approvedProductCount = producer.products.filter(p => p.status === 'APPROVED').length;

    // Logică simplă pentru determinarea planului
    // În producție, ar trebui să existe un câmp în Producer model pentru plan
    if (productCount <= 20) {
      currentPlan = 'basic';
    } else if (productCount <= 100) {
      currentPlan = 'professional';
    } else {
      currentPlan = 'enterprise';
    }

    const plan = PRODUCER_PLANS[currentPlan];

    res.json({
      currentPlan: currentPlan,
      plan: {
        ...plan,
        usage: {
          products: productCount,
          approvedProducts: approvedProductCount,
          campaigns: 0, // TODO: Count from Promotion model
        },
        limits: plan.limits,
      },
      isActive: producer.status === ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      canUpgrade: currentPlan !== 'enterprise',
      canDowngrade: currentPlan !== 'basic',
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get producer subscription error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea abonamentului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /producers/subscriptions/plans
 * Listă toate planurile disponibile pentru producători
 */
router.get('/plans', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const plans = Object.entries(PRODUCER_PLANS).map(([key, plan]) => ({
      id: key,
      ...plan,
    }));

    res.json({ plans });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get producer subscription plans error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea planurilor' });
  }
});

export default router;

```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
import producerSubscriptionsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-subscriptions.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend Sync Status Configuration
 * 
 * Acest fișier controlează ce funcționalități sunt conectate live la backend
 * și ce funcționalități sunt încă în fallback mode.
 * 
 * Folosește acest status pentru:
 * - Afișarea fallback-urilor când endpoint-ul nu e încă live
 * - Prevenirea crash-urilor
 * - Testarea incrementală a funcționalităților
 * 
 * IMPORTANT: Setează `true` doar când endpoint-ul este complet funcțional și testat.
 */

export const BackendSyncStatus = {
  // Client Profile & Addresses
  clientProfile: true, // ✅ GET /clients/me, PATCH /clients/me - Implementat în backend
  clientAddresses: true, // ✅ GET /clients/addresses, POST/PATCH/DELETE /clients/addresses/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Cart & Checkout
  cart: true, // ✅ POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PATCH/PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id - Implementat în backend
  checkout: true, // ✅ POST /orders/checkout - Implementat în backend

  // Client Orders
  clientOrders: true, // ✅ GET /orders, GET /orders/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Portal
  producerProducts: true, // ✅ GET /producers/products, POST/PATCH/DELETE /producers/products/:id - Implementat în backend
  producerOrders: true, // ✅ GET /producers/orders, GET /producers/orders/:id, PATCH /producers/orders/:id/status - Implementat în backend

  // Favorites
  favorites: true, // ✅ GET /clients/favorites, POST /clients/favorites, DELETE /clients/favorites/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Subscription Baskets
  subscriptions: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions, POST /clients/subscriptions, PATCH /clients/subscriptions/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Silent Alerts
  alerts: true, // ✅ GET /clients/alert-preferences, PATCH /clients/alert-preferences - Implementat în backend

  // Business Portal
  businessDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /business/* - Implementat în backend

  // Logistics Portal
  logisticsDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Portal
  investorDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /investor/* - Implementat în backend
  investorMetrics: true, // ✅ GET /investor/metrics - Implementat în backend

  // Notifications System
  notifications: true, // ✅ GET /notifications/* - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Marketing & Monetization
  producerMarketing: true, // ✅ GET /producers/featured - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Public)
  subscriptionsClient: true, // ✅ GET /subscriptions/public/plans - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Active)
  subscriptionsClientActive: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions - Implementat în backend (deja activat ca 'subscriptions')

  // Producer Subscriptions (Tiers)
  subscriptionsProducer: true, // ✅ GET /producers/subscriptions - Implementat în backend

  // Farmero Points & Rewards
  farmeroPoints: false, // ⚠️ GET /farmero-points/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Parties & Contracts
  partiesAndContracts: false, // ⚠️ GET /contracts - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Fees & Statements
  feesAndStatements: false, // ⚠️ GET /fees/*, GET /statements - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Donations
  donations: false, // ⚠️ GET /donations/* - Necesită verificare endpoint specific

  // Documents & Contracts
  documents: true, // ✅ GET /documents/* - Implementat în backend

  // Subscriptions (Client & Producer) - deja activat ca 'subscriptions' mai sus
  // subscriptions: true, // ✅ Duplicat - deja activat mai sus

  // Promotions & Marketing
  promotions: true, // ✅ GET /producer/promotions/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Metrics (Anonymized) - duplicat cu investorMetrics
  // investorMetrics: false, // ⚠️ Duplicat - deja definit mai sus

  // Shipments & AWB
  shipments: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/shipments - Implementat în backend
} as const

export type BackendSyncFeature = keyof typeof BackendSyncStatus

/**
 * Check if a feature is enabled
 */
export function isBackendSyncEnabled(feature: BackendSyncFeature): boolean {
  return BackendSyncStatus[feature] === true
}

/**
 * Get all enabled features
 */
export function getEnabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === true)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

/**
 * Get all disabled features
 */
export function getDisabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === false)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Rute publice pentru marketplace
 * 
 * Endpoints publice (fără autentificare) pentru:
 * - Listare produse aprobate
 * - Detalii produs
 * - Listare producători aprobați
```
