 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { Prisma, ProductStatus, ProducerStatus, RegionType } from '@prisma/client';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Helper: generează slug din nume
 */
function generateSlug(name: string): string {
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '') // Remove diacritics
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește produs după slug sau id
 */
async function findProductBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
    where: {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
    },
    include: {
      producer: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          status: true,
        },
      },
      traditionalRegion: {
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          code: true,
        },
      },
    },
  });

  return products.find((p) => generateSlug(p.name) === slugOrId);
}

/**
 * Helper: găsește producător după slug sau id
 */
async function findProducerBySlugOrId(slugOrId: string) {
  // Încearcă să găsească după id (UUID)
  if (slugOrId.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i)) {
    return await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: slugOrId },
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,

          },
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // Altfel, caută după nume (slug-ul generat)
  const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({

    },

/**
 * Handler pentru GET /products - exportat pentru reutilizare
 */
export async function getProductsHandler(req: Request, res: Response) {
  try {
    const { search, q, category, categoryId, regionId, priceMin, priceMax, sort, page = '1', limit = '12' } = req.query;

    const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10) || 1;
    const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit as string, 10) || 12, 100); // Max 100 per page, default 12
    const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

    const where: Prisma.ProductWhereInput = {
      status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      // Doar produse de la producători aprobați
      producer: {
        status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
      },
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    // Suportă atât 'search' cât și 'q' pentru compatibilitate
    const searchQuery = (search && typeof search === 'string') ? search : (q && typeof q === 'string' ? q : null);
    if (searchQuery) {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { name: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
            { description: { contains: searchQuery, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar acceptăm parametrii pentru compatibilitate)
    // Note: Category filter will be implemented when category is added to Product schema
    if ((category && typeof category === 'string') || (categoryId && typeof categoryId === 'string')) {
      // Pentru moment, ignorăm filtrul (categoria nu există în schema)
      // Când categoria va fi adăugată, va trebui să adăugăm:
      // if (categoryId) where.categoryId = categoryId;
      // sau
      // if (category) where.category = { slug: category };
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    // Poate filtra după regiunea tradițională a produsului SAU regiunea producătorului
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
      where.AND = [
        ...existingAnd,
        {
          OR: [
            { regionId: regionId }, // Regiune tradițională a produsului
            { producer: { mainRegionId: regionId } }, // Regiunea producătorului
          ],
        },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după preț minim
    if (priceMin && typeof priceMin === 'string') {
      const priceMinNum = parseFloat(priceMin);
      if (!isNaN(priceMinNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { gte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMinNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după preț maxim
    if (priceMax && typeof priceMax === 'string') {
      const priceMaxNum = parseFloat(priceMax);
      if (!isNaN(priceMaxNum)) {
        const existingAnd = Array.isArray(where.AND) ? where.AND : (where.AND ? [where.AND] : []);
        where.AND = [
          ...existingAnd,
          { price: { lte: new Prisma.Decimal(priceMaxNum) } },
        ];
      }
    }

    // Filtru după categorie (nu există în schema, dar păstrăm pentru viitor)
    // if (category && typeof category === 'string') {
    //   where.category = category;
    // }

    // Sortare
    let orderBy: Prisma.ProductOrderByWithRelationInput = { createdAt: 'desc' }; // default: newest
    if (sort && typeof sort === 'string') {
      switch (sort) {
        case 'price_asc':
          orderBy = { price: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'price_desc':
          orderBy = { price: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'name_asc':
          orderBy = { name: 'asc' };
          break;
        case 'name_desc':
          orderBy = { name: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'newest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
          break;
        case 'oldest':
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'asc' };
          break;
        default:
          orderBy = { createdAt: 'desc' };
      }
    }

    // Optimizare: folosește Promise.all pentru query-uri paralele
    const [total, products] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.product.count({ where }),
      prisma.product.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            status: true,
          },
        },
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy,
      skip,
      take: limitNum,
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      description: product.description,
      price: Number(product.price),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: product.producer.id,
        name: product.producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.producer.name),
      },
      category: product.category || null,
      isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
      isBio: product.isBio || false,
      stock: product.stock,
    }));

    res.json({
      data: formattedProducts,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public products error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({
      data: [],
      pagination: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 12,
        total: 0,
        totalPages: 0,
      },
    });
  }
}

// Mount handler on router
router.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

/**
 * GET /api/public/products/:slug
 * Detalii produs după slug sau id
 */
router.get('/products/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const product = await findProductBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    if (product.status !== ProductStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Verifică că producătorul este aprobat
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: product.producerId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        description: true,
        status: true,
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer || producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({
      product: {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.name),
        price: product.price.toString(),
        unit: product.unit || null,
        image: product.imageUrl || null,
        description: product.description,
        stock: product.stock,
        isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
        isBio: product.isBio || false,
        producer: {
          id: producer.id,
          name: producer.name,
          slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
          description: producer.description,
          region: producer.mainRegion
            ? {
                id: producer.mainRegion.id,
                name: producer.mainRegion.name,
                code: producer.mainRegion.code,
              }
            : null,
        },
        region: product.traditionalRegion
          ? {
              id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
              name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
              code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public product error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea produsului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers
 * Listează producătorii APPROVED cu filtre
 */
router.get('/producers', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { q, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    if (q && typeof q === 'string') {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
        { description: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul
    const formattedProducers = producers.map((producer) => ({
      id: producer.id,
      slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      name: producer.name,
      description: producer.description,
      type: producer.type,
      region: producer.mainRegion
        ? {
            id: producer.mainRegion.id,
            name: producer.mainRegion.name,
            code: producer.mainRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({ producers: formattedProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers/:slug
 * Detalii producător după slug sau id + produse active
 */
router.get('/producers/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const producer = await findProducerBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    if (producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Obține produsele aprobate ale producătorului
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    // Formatează produsele conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      price: product.price.toString(),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      image: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        name: producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      },
      region: product.traditionalRegion
        ? {
            id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
            name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
            code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
        name: producer.name,
        description: producer.description,
        type: producer.type,
        // Nu expunem registrationNumber (dată sensibilă)
        region: producer.mainRegion
          ? {
              id: producer.mainRegion.id,
              name: producer.mainRegion.name,
              code: producer.mainRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
        products: formattedProducts,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/regions
 * Listează toate regiunile (pentru filtre și selecție în frontend)
 */
router.get('/regions', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { type } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.RegionWhereInput = {};

    // Filtru după tip (COUNTY sau REGION)
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      if (Object.values(RegionType).includes(type as RegionType)) {
        where.type = type as RegionType;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public regions error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

export default router;

      orderBy,
      skip,
      take: limitNum,
      }),
    ]);

    // Formatează răspunsul conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      description: product.description,
      price: Number(product.price),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      imageUrl: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: product.producer.id,
        name: product.producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.producer.name),
      },
      category: product.category || null,
      isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
      isBio: product.isBio || false,
      stock: product.stock,
    }));

    res.json({
      data: formattedProducts,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public products error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({
      data: [],
      pagination: {
        page: 1,
        limit: 12,
        total: 0,
        totalPages: 0,
      },
    });
  }
}

// Mount handler on router
router.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

/**
 * GET /api/public/products/:slug
 * Detalii produs după slug sau id
 */
router.get('/products/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const product = await findProductBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    if (product.status !== ProductStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Verifică că producătorul este aprobat
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: product.producerId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        description: true,
        status: true,
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    if (!producer || producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    res.json({
      product: {
        id: product.id,
        name: product.name,
        slug: generateSlug(product.name),
        price: product.price.toString(),
        unit: product.unit || null,
        image: product.imageUrl || null,
        description: product.description,
        stock: product.stock,
        isTraditional: product.isTraditional,
        isBio: product.isBio || false,
        producer: {
          id: producer.id,
          name: producer.name,
          slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
          description: producer.description,
          region: producer.mainRegion
            ? {
                id: producer.mainRegion.id,
                name: producer.mainRegion.name,
                code: producer.mainRegion.code,
              }
            : null,
        },
        region: product.traditionalRegion
          ? {
              id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
              name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
              code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public product error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea produsului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers
 * Listează producătorii APPROVED cu filtre
 */
router.get('/producers', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { q, regionId } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.ProducerWhereInput = {
      status: ProducerStatus.APPROVED,
    };

    // Filtru după text search (în nume sau descriere)
    if (q && typeof q === 'string') {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
        { description: { contains: q, mode: Prisma.QueryMode.insensitive } },
      ];
    }

    // Filtru după regiune
    if (regionId && typeof regionId === 'string') {
      where.mainRegionId = regionId;
    }

    const producers = await prisma.producer.findMany({
      where,
      include: {
        mainRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    // Formatează răspunsul
    const formattedProducers = producers.map((producer) => ({
      id: producer.id,
      slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      name: producer.name,
      description: producer.description,
      type: producer.type,
      region: producer.mainRegion
        ? {
            id: producer.mainRegion.id,
            name: producer.mainRegion.name,
            code: producer.mainRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({ producers: formattedProducers });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producers error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/producers/:slug
 * Detalii producător după slug sau id + produse active
 */
router.get('/producers/:slug', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const producer = await findProducerBySlugOrId(req.params.slug);

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    if (producer.status !== ProducerStatus.APPROVED) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Obține produsele aprobate ale producătorului
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        status: ProductStatus.APPROVED,
      },
      include: {
        traditionalRegion: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            code: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });

    // Formatează produsele conform cerințelor
    const formattedProducts = products.map((product) => ({
      id: product.id,
      name: product.name,
      slug: generateSlug(product.name),
      price: product.price.toString(),
      unit: product.unit || null,
      image: product.imageUrl || null,
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        name: producer.name,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
      },
      region: product.traditionalRegion
        ? {
            id: product.traditionalRegion.id,
            name: product.traditionalRegion.name,
            code: product.traditionalRegion.code,
          }
        : null,
    }));

    res.json({
      producer: {
        id: producer.id,
        slug: generateSlug(producer.name),
        name: producer.name,
        description: producer.description,
        type: producer.type,
        // Nu expunem registrationNumber (dată sensibilă)
        region: producer.mainRegion
          ? {
              id: producer.mainRegion.id,
              name: producer.mainRegion.name,
              code: producer.mainRegion.code,
            }
          : null,
        products: formattedProducts,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public producer error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea producătorului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /api/public/regions
 * Listează toate regiunile (pentru filtre și selecție în frontend)
 */
router.get('/regions', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { type } = req.query;

    const where: Prisma.RegionWhereInput = {};

    // Filtru după tip (COUNTY sau REGION)
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      if (Object.values(RegionType).includes(type as RegionType)) {
        where.type = type as RegionType;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get public regions error:', error);
    // Returnează array gol în loc de eroare (frontend-ul gestionează elegant array-uri goale)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

export default router;


```

### Eroare: "Prisma Client not generated"

```json
"postinstall": "prisma generate"
```

### Eroare: "Migration not applied"
**Soluție:** Adaugă script în `package.json`:
```json
"vercel-build": "prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && npm run build"
```

### Build-ul eșuează

Verificând configurația Docker și pregătind setup-ul local:



Configurând Docker pentru PostgreSQL local. Creând `docker-compose.yml` și configurația necesară:


```dockercompose
version: '3.8'

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: farmero-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: farmero
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: farmero_dev_password
      POSTGRES_DB: farmero_db
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U farmero"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

volumes:
  postgres_data:

```

```markdown
# 🐳 Docker Setup pentru Development Local

**Scop:** Rulează PostgreSQL local cu Docker pentru testare seed data înainte de production.

---

## 🚀 Pași Rapizi

### 1. Pornește Docker Desktop

Asigură-te că Docker Desktop rulează pe Windows.

### 2. Pornește PostgreSQL Container

```bash
# Din root-ul proiectului
docker-compose up -d
```

**Verifică că container-ul rulează:**
```bash
docker ps
```

Ar trebui să vezi `farmero-postgres` în listă.

### 3. Configurează .env pentru Local

Creează `backend/.env`:

```env
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://farmero:farmero_dev_password@localhost:5432/farmero_db"
JWT_SECRET="d9d77a75d0830e4947f8ac09e3f4675f9269cfa77b4f5f3194450988b4eb31c4f9efc30b4d9ae526161f945decefb62ad059e4a873a373ab79f554bbfcb7157e"
JWT_EXPIRES_IN="7d"
NODE_ENV="development"
PORT=3001
FRONTEND_URL="http://localhost:3000"
```

### 4. Aplică Migrațiile

```bash
cd backend
npx prisma migrate deploy
npx prisma generate
```

### 5. Rulează Seed Data

```bash
cd backend
npm run prisma:seed
```

### 6. Verifică

```bash
# Testează endpoint-ul local
curl http://localhost:3001/products
```

---

## 🛠 Comenzi Utile Docker

```bash
# Pornește container-ul
docker-compose up -d

# Oprește container-ul
docker-compose down

# Oprește și șterge volume-ul (șterge datele!)
docker-compose down -v

# Vezi logs
docker-compose logs -f postgres

# Verifică status
docker-compose ps
```

http://localhost:3001/products

- **Nu commit-a** `.env` - este deja în `.gitignore`

```typescript
/**
 * Script de testare endpoint-uri backend
 * 
 * Acest script testează endpoint-urile principale pentru a verifica că funcționează corect.
 * 
 * Usage:
 *   npm run test:endpoints
 *   sau
 *   tsx scripts/test-endpoints.ts
 * 
 * Environment variables necesare:
 *   - BACKEND_URL (default: http://localhost:3001)
 *   - TEST_EMAIL (email pentru testare)
 *   - TEST_PASSWORD (parolă pentru testare)
 */

import dotenv from 'dotenv'

dotenv.config()

const BACKEND_URL = process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3001'
const TEST_EMAIL = process.env.TEST_EMAIL || 'test@example.com'
const TEST_PASSWORD = process.env.TEST_PASSWORD || 'test123'

interface TestResult {
  name: string
  status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'skip'
  message?: string
  duration?: number
}

const results: TestResult[] = []

async function testEndpoint(
  name: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE',
  path: string,
  options: {
    body?: any
    headers?: Record<string, string>
    expectedStatus?: number
    skip?: boolean
  } = {}
): Promise<TestResult> {
  if (options.skip) {
    return { name, status: 'skip', message: 'Skipped' }
  }

  const startTime = Date.now()
  const url = `${BACKEND_URL}${path}`
  
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...options.headers,
      },
      body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
    })

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime
    const expectedStatus = options.expectedStatus || 200

    if (response.status === expectedStatus) {
      return {
        name,
        status: 'pass',
        message: `Status ${response.status} (expected ${expectedStatus})`,
        duration,
      }
    } else {
      const text = await response.text()
      return {
        name,
        status: 'fail',
        message: `Expected ${expectedStatus}, got ${response.status}. Response: ${text.substring(0, 100)}`,
        duration,
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    const duration = Date.now() - startTime
    return {
      name,
      status: 'fail',
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      duration,
    }
  }
}

async function getAuthToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`${BACKEND_URL}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: TEST_EMAIL,
        password: TEST_PASSWORD,
      }),
    })

    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json()
      return data.token || null
    }
    return null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

async function runTests() {
  console.log('🧪 Testing Backend Endpoints\n')
  console.log(`Backend URL: ${BACKEND_URL}\n`)

  // Health check
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Health Check', 'GET', '/health'))

  // Public endpoints
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /regions', 'GET', '/regions'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /api/public/products', 'GET', '/api/public/products'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /api/public/producers', 'GET', '/api/public/producers'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /products', 'GET', '/products'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /producers/featured', 'GET', '/producers/featured'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /producers/subscriptions/plans', 'GET', '/producers/subscriptions/plans'))
  results.push(await testEndpoint('GET /subscriptions/public/plans', 'GET', '/subscriptions/public/plans'))

  // Auth
  const token = await getAuthToken()
  if (token) {
    results.push({
      name: 'POST /auth/login',
      status: 'pass',
      message: 'Authentication successful',
    })

    const authHeaders = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }

    // Cart endpoints (necesită autentificare)
    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /cart', 'GET', '/cart', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200,
      })
    )

    // Orders endpoints
    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /orders', 'GET', '/orders', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200,
      })
    )

    // Client endpoints
    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /clients/me', 'GET', '/clients/me', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200,
      })
    )

    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /clients/addresses', 'GET', '/clients/addresses', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200,
      })
    )

    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /clients/favorites', 'GET', '/clients/favorites', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200,
      })
    )

    // Producer endpoints (dacă user-ul este producător)
    results.push(
      await testEndpoint('GET /api/products/mine', 'GET', '/api/products/mine', {
        headers: authHeaders,
        expectedStatus: 200, // sau 404 dacă nu e producător
      })
    )
  } else {
    results.push({
      name: 'POST /auth/login',
      status: 'fail',
      message: 'Authentication failed - skipping authenticated endpoints',
    })
  }

  // Print results
  console.log('\n📊 Test Results:\n')
  const passed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'pass').length
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fail').length
  const skipped = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'skip').length

  results.forEach((result) => {
    const icon = result.status === 'pass' ? '✅' : result.status === 'fail' ? '❌' : '⏭️'
    const duration = result.duration ? ` (${result.duration}ms)` : ''
    console.log(`${icon} ${result.name}${duration}`)
    if (result.message && result.status !== 'pass') {
      console.log(`   ${result.message}`)
    }
  })

  console.log(`\n📈 Summary: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed, ${skipped} skipped`)

  if (failed > 0) {
    process.exit(1)
  }
}

runTests().catch(console.error)


```

```typescript
/**
 * File Upload Utility
 * 
 * Handles file uploads for products, producers, and other entities.
 * Supports both local storage and cloud storage (S3, Cloudinary, etc.)
 */

import multer from 'multer';
import path from 'path';
import fs from 'fs';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';

// Ensure uploads directory exists
const uploadsDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');
if (!fs.existsSync(uploadsDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(uploadsDir, { recursive: true });
}

const productsDir = path.join(uploadsDir, 'products');
const producersDir = path.join(uploadsDir, 'producers');
const documentsDir = path.join(uploadsDir, 'documents');

[productsDir, producersDir, documentsDir].forEach((dir) => {
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  }
});

// Configure storage
const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (req, file, cb) => {
    let uploadPath = uploadsDir;
    
    if (file.fieldname === 'productImage') {
      uploadPath = productsDir;
    } else if (file.fieldname === 'producerLogo' || file.fieldname === 'producerCover') {
      uploadPath = producersDir;
    } else if (file.fieldname === 'document') {
      uploadPath = documentsDir;
    }
    
    cb(null, uploadPath);
  },
  filename: (req, file, cb) => {
    const uniqueName = `${uuidv4()}${path.extname(file.originalname)}`;
    cb(null, uniqueName);
  },
});

// File filter
const fileFilter = (req: any, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) => {
  const allowedMimes = [
    'image/jpeg',
    'image/jpg',
    'image/png',
    'image/webp',
    'image/gif',
    'application/pdf',
  ];
  
  if (allowedMimes.includes(file.mimetype)) {
    cb(null, true);
  } else {
    cb(new Error('Tip de fișier nepermis. Permise: JPEG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, PDF'));
  }
};

// Multer configuration
export const upload = multer({
  storage,
  fileFilter,
  limits: {
    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB
  },
});

// Get file URL (local or cloud)
export function getFileUrl(filename: string, type: 'product' | 'producer' | 'document'): string {
  // In production, this would return a cloud storage URL
  // For now, return local path
  const baseUrl = process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
  
  if (type === 'product') {
    return `${baseUrl}/uploads/products/${filename}`;
  } else if (type === 'producer') {
    return `${baseUrl}/uploads/producers/${filename}`;
  } else {
    return `${baseUrl}/uploads/documents/${filename}`;
  }
}

// Delete file
export function deleteFile(filename: string, type: 'product' | 'producer' | 'document'): void {
  let filePath: string;
  
  if (type === 'product') {
    filePath = path.join(productsDir, filename);
  } else if (type === 'producer') {
    filePath = path.join(producersDir, filename);
  } else {
    filePath = path.join(documentsDir, filename);
  }
  
  if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
    fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
  }
}

// Serve static files (add to Express app)
export function setupStaticFiles(app: any): void {
  app.use('/uploads', require('express').static(uploadsDir));
}

```

/**
 * Product Image Upload Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/products/:id/image - Upload product image
 * - DELETE /api/products/:id/image - Delete product image
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole, ProductStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { upload, getFileUrl, deleteFile } from '../../utils/upload';

const router = Router();

/**
 * POST /api/products/:id/image
 * Upload product image
 * PRODUCER: doar propriile produse
 * ADMIN: orice produs
 */
router.post(
  '/:id/image',
  requireAuth,
  requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER),
  upload.single('productImage'),
  async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
      if (!req.user) {
        return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
      }

      const productId = req.params.id;
      const file = req.file;

      if (!file) {
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Fișier imagine necesar' });
      }

      // Verify product exists and user has permission
      const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
        where: { id: productId },
        include: { producer: true },
      });

      if (!product) {
        // Delete uploaded file if product doesn't exist
        deleteFile(file.filename, 'product');
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
      }

      // Check permission
      if (req.user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN && product.producer.userId !== req.user.userId) {
        deleteFile(file.filename, 'product');
        return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Nu ai permisiunea să modifici acest produs' });
      }

      // Delete old image if exists
      if (product.imageUrl) {
        const oldFilename = product.imageUrl.split('/').pop();
        if (oldFilename) {
          deleteFile(oldFilename, 'product');
        }
      }

      // Get file URL
      const imageUrl = getFileUrl(file.filename, 'product');

      // Update product
      const updatedProduct = await prisma.product.update({
        where: { id: productId },
        data: {
          imageUrl,
          // If product was approved, set back to pending review
          status: product.status === ProductStatus.APPROVED 
            ? ProductStatus.PENDING_REVIEW 
            : product.status,
        },
      });

      res.json({ product: updatedProduct });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Upload product image error:', error);
      res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la upload imagine' });
    }
  }
);

/**
 * DELETE /api/products/:id/image
 * Delete product image
 * PRODUCER: doar propriile produse
 * ADMIN: orice produs
 */
router.delete('/:id/image', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.PRODUCER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const productId = req.params.id;

    // Verify product exists and user has permission
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: productId },
      include: { producer: true },
    });

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Check permission
    if (req.user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN && product.producer.userId !== req.user.userId) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Nu ai permisiunea să modifici acest produs' });
    }

    // Delete file if exists
    if (product.imageUrl) {
      const filename = product.imageUrl.split('/').pop();
      if (filename) {
        deleteFile(filename, 'product');
      }
    }

    // Update product
    const updatedProduct = await prisma.product.update({
      where: { id: productId },
      data: {
        imageUrl: null,
        // If product was approved, set back to pending review
        status: product.status === ProductStatus.APPROVED 
          ? ProductStatus.PENDING_REVIEW 
          : product.status,
      },
    });

    res.json({ product: updatedProduct });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Delete product image error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la ștergere imagine' });
  }
});

export default router;

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import productUploadRoutes from './modules/products/product-upload.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
import producerSubscriptionsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-subscriptions.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;

import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productUploadRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;

```plaintext
// Prisma schema for farme.ro marketplace
// Provider: PostgreSQL
// Documentation: https://www.prisma.io/docs

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Enum for user roles
enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  PRODUCER
  CUSTOMER
}

// Enum for producer type (company or PFA)
enum ProducerType {
  COMPANY
  PFA
}

// Enum for producer status
enum ProducerStatus {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for region type
enum RegionType {
  COUNTY
  REGION
}

// Enum for product status
enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING_REVIEW
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for order status
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enum for order vendor status (sub-order per producer)
enum OrderVendorStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  PREPARING
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

// Enum for payment status
enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
  REFUNDED
}

// Enum for cart status
enum CartStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CONVERTED
}

// Enum for order customer type
enum OrderCustomerType {
  B2C
  B2B
}

// Enum for commission status
enum CommissionStatus {
  PENDING
  ISSUED
  PAID
}

// User model - platform users
// 1-1 relation with Producer: a User with PRODUCER role can have a Producer profile
// A User can be ADMIN, PRODUCER or CUSTOMER
model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash")
  fullName     String    @map("full_name")
  role         UserRole  @default(CUSTOMER)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // 1-1 relation with Producer (only for users with PRODUCER role)
  producer Producer?
  
  // Relations for cart and orders
  carts Cart[]
  orders Order[]
  
  // Relations for client features
  shippingAddresses ShippingAddress[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  alertPreferences AlertPreferences?
  notifications Notification[]
  documents Document[]

  @@map("users")
}

// Producer model - producer profile
// 1-1 relation with User: each Producer belongs to a User with PRODUCER role
// Many-to-one relation with Region: each Producer has a main region
model Producer {
  id                String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String         @unique @map("user_id")
  name              String         // Company/brand name
  registrationNumber String        @map("registration_number") // CUI / CNP
  type              ProducerType
  mainRegionId      String?        @map("main_region_id")
  description       String?
  status            ProducerStatus @default(PENDING_VERIFICATION)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user              User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mainRegion        Region?        @relation("ProducerMainRegion", fields: [mainRegionId], references: [id])
  products          Product[]
  orderVendors      OrderVendor[]
  commissions       Commission[]
  documents         Document[]
  promotions        Promotion[]

  @@map("producers")
}

// Region model - regions/counties
// One-to-many relation with Producer (main region)
// One-to-many relation with Product (traditional region)
model Region {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  name      String      // e.g.: "Maramureș", "Cluj"
  type      RegionType
  code      String      // e.g.: "CJ", "MM"
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producersAsMainRegion Product[] @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion")
  producers            Producer[] @relation("ProducerMainRegion")
  orderShippingRegions Order[]    @relation("OrderShippingRegion")

  @@map("regions")
}

// Product model - products offered by producers
// Many-to-one relation with Producer: each product belongs to a Producer
// Many-to-one relation with Region: traditional region of the product
model Product {
  id            String        @id @default(uuid())
  producerId    String        @map("producer_id")
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock         Int           @default(0)
  unit          String?       // Unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "buc", "l")
  imageUrl      String?       @map("image_url") // Product image URL
  category      String?       // Product category (e.g. "Fruits", "Vegetables")
  isTraditional Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_traditional")
  isBio         Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_bio") // Organic product flag
  regionId      String?       @map("region_id") // Traditional region
  status        ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer      Producer      @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  traditionalRegion Region?   @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion", fields: [regionId], references: [id])
  cartItems     CartItem[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
  favorites     Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  promotions    Promotion[]

  @@map("products")
}

// Cart model - shopping cart
// A cart can be associated with a user (if logged in) or can be anonymous
// Status ACTIVE = active cart, CONVERTED = cart converted to order
model Cart {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?    @map("customer_id")
  status     CartStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer User?      @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items    CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

// CartItem model - cart items
// Each item represents a product with a specific quantity
model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String   @map("cart_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  cart    Cart    @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("cart_items")
}

// Order model - global order
// An order can contain products from multiple producers
// Created when user checks out from cart
model Order {
  id                  String           @id @default(uuid())
  customerId          String?          @map("customer_id")
  customerType        OrderCustomerType @default(B2C) @map("customer_type")
  status              OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  paymentStatus       PaymentStatus    @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  totalAmount         Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_amount")
  totalCommission     Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_commission")
  shippingFullName    String           @map("shipping_full_name")
  shippingPhone       String           @map("shipping_phone")
  shippingAddressLine1 String          @map("shipping_address_line1")
  shippingAddressLine2 String?         @map("shipping_address_line2")
  shippingCity        String           @map("shipping_city")
  shippingPostalCode  String?          @map("shipping_postal_code")
  shippingRegionId    String?          @map("shipping_region_id")
  // Company data for B2B
  companyName         String?          @map("company_name")
  companyCui          String?          @map("company_cui")
  companyRegNo        String?          @map("company_reg_no")
  companyAddress      String?          @map("company_address")
  notes               String?
  // Stripe payment
  stripeSessionId     String?          @map("stripe_session_id") // Stripe Checkout session ID
  createdAt           DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer      User?         @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  shippingRegion Region?      @relation("OrderShippingRegion", fields: [shippingRegionId], references: [id])
  vendors       OrderVendor[]
  commissions   Commission[]
  customerInvoice CustomerInvoice?

  @@map("orders")
}

// OrderVendor model - sub-order per producer
// Each producer has a separate sub-order with its own status and commission
// Splitting orders by producers allows independent management of each sub-order
model OrderVendor {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String            @map("order_id")
  producerId      String            @map("producer_id")
  status          OrderVendorStatus @default(PENDING)
  subtotal        Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  commissionRate  Decimal           @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.1200 for 12%
  commissionAmount Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  payoutAmount    Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("payout_amount")
  deliveryMethod  String?           @map("delivery_method") // e.g. "courier", "pickup"
  trackingNumber  String?           @map("tracking_number")
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order   Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items   OrderItem[]

  @@map("order_vendors")
}

// OrderItem model - order items
// Product snapshot (name, price) is saved for history
// Even if the product is modified later, the order keeps the original data
model OrderItem {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderVendorId          String   @map("order_vendor_id")
  productId              String   @map("product_id")
  quantity               Int
  unitPrice              Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("unit_price")
  totalPrice             Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_price")
  productNameSnapshot    String   @map("product_name_snapshot")
  productImageUrlSnapshot String? @map("product_image_url_snapshot")
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  orderVendor OrderVendor @relation(fields: [orderVendorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("order_items")
}

// Commission model - marketplace commission per order/producer
// Represents the commission charged by the platform for each producer in an order
model Commission {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String           @map("order_id")
  producerId      String           @map("producer_id")
  baseAmount      Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("base_amount") // Order value for that producer
  commissionRate  Decimal          @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.0800 for 8%
  commissionAmount Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  status          CommissionStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order           Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer        Producer         @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producerInvoice ProducerInvoice?

  @@map("commissions")
}

// CustomerInvoice model - invoice for customer
// Reference to the invoice generated in the external invoicing system
model CustomerInvoice {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  orderId    String    @unique @map("order_id")
  externalId String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl     String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt   DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  order      Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("customer_invoices")
}

// ProducerInvoice model - invoice for producer
// Reference to the invoice generated for the commission paid to the producer
model ProducerInvoice {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  commissionId String    @unique @map("commission_id")
  externalId   String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl       String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt     DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  commission   Commission @relation(fields: [commissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("producer_invoices")
}

// ShippingAddress model - shipping addresses for clients
model ShippingAddress {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  name      String
  phone     String
  email     String?
  city      String
  address   String
  postalCode String? @map("postal_code")
  notes     String?
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("shipping_addresses")
}

// Favorite model - favorite products for clients
model Favorite {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@map("favorites")
}

// Subscription model - product subscriptions
model Subscription {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String    @map("user_id")
  productId String    @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  frequency String    // e.g.: "weekly", "monthly"
  startDate DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate   DateTime? @map("end_date")
  isActive  Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("subscriptions")
}

// AlertPreferences model - email alert preferences
model AlertPreferences {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique @map("user_id")
  emailNewProducts Boolean @default(true) @map("email_new_products")
  emailPriceDrops  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_price_drops")
  emailStockAlerts  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_stock_alerts")
  emailOrderUpdates Boolean @default(true) @map("email_order_updates")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("alert_preferences")
}

// Notification model - notifications for users
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  type      String   // e.g.: "order", "product", "system"
  title     String
  message   String
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("notifications")
}

// Document model - documents and contracts
model Document {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String?   @map("user_id")
  producerId  String?   @map("producer_id")
  type        String    // e.g.: "contract", "invoice", "certificate"
  title       String
  description String?
  fileUrl     String    @map("file_url")
  mimeType    String?   @map("mime_type")
  size        Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user     User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  producer Producer? @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("documents")
}

// Promotion model - promotions and campaigns for producers
model Promotion {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  producerId   String    @map("producer_id")
  productId    String?   @map("product_id")
  title        String
  description  String?
  discountType String    @map("discount_type") // e.g.: "percentage", "fixed"
  discountValue Decimal   @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("discount_value")
  startDate    DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate      DateTime  @map("end_date")
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("promotions")
}

// Review model - product reviews and ratings
model Review {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String   @map("product_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order   Order?  @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([productId, userId])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ProducerReview model - producer reviews and ratings
model ProducerReview {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  producerId        String   @map("producer_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order    Order?   @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([producerId, userId])
  @@map("producer_reviews")
}
