```plaintext
// Prisma schema for farme.ro marketplace
// Provider: PostgreSQL
// Documentation: https://www.prisma.io/docs

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Enum for user roles
enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  PRODUCER
  CUSTOMER
}

// Enum for producer type (company or PFA)
enum ProducerType {
  COMPANY
  PFA
}

// Enum for producer status
enum ProducerStatus {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for region type
enum RegionType {
  COUNTY
  REGION
}

// Enum for product status
enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING_REVIEW
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for order status
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enum for order vendor status (sub-order per producer)
enum OrderVendorStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  PREPARING
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

// Enum for payment status
enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
  REFUNDED
}

// Enum for cart status
enum CartStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CONVERTED
}

// Enum for order customer type
enum OrderCustomerType {
  B2C
  B2B
}

// Enum for commission status
enum CommissionStatus {
  PENDING
  ISSUED
  PAID
}

// User model - platform users
// 1-1 relation with Producer: a User with PRODUCER role can have a Producer profile
// A User can be ADMIN, PRODUCER or CUSTOMER
model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash")
  fullName     String    @map("full_name")
  role         UserRole  @default(CUSTOMER)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // 1-1 relation with Producer (only for users with PRODUCER role)
  producer Producer?
  
  // Relations for cart and orders
  carts Cart[]
  orders Order[]
  
  // Relations for client features
  shippingAddresses ShippingAddress[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  alertPreferences AlertPreferences?
  notifications Notification[]
  documents Document[]
  reviews Review[]
  producerReviews ProducerReview[]

  @@map("users")
}

// Producer model - producer profile
// 1-1 relation with User: each Producer belongs to a User with PRODUCER role
// Many-to-one relation with Region: each Producer has a main region
model Producer {
  id                String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String         @unique @map("user_id")
  name              String         // Company/brand name
  registrationNumber String        @map("registration_number") // CUI / CNP
  type              ProducerType
  mainRegionId      String?        @map("main_region_id")
  description       String?
  status            ProducerStatus @default(PENDING_VERIFICATION)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user              User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mainRegion        Region?        @relation("ProducerMainRegion", fields: [mainRegionId], references: [id])
  products          Product[]
  orderVendors      OrderVendor[]
  commissions       Commission[]
  documents         Document[]
  promotions        Promotion[]

  @@map("producers")
}

// Region model - regions/counties
// One-to-many relation with Producer (main region)
// One-to-many relation with Product (traditional region)
model Region {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  name      String      // e.g.: "Maramureș", "Cluj"
  type      RegionType
  code      String      // e.g.: "CJ", "MM"
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producersAsMainRegion Product[] @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion")
  producers            Producer[] @relation("ProducerMainRegion")
  orderShippingRegions Order[]    @relation("OrderShippingRegion")

  @@map("regions")
}

// Product model - products offered by producers
// Many-to-one relation with Producer: each product belongs to a Producer
// Many-to-one relation with Region: traditional region of the product
model Product {
  id            String        @id @default(uuid())
  producerId    String        @map("producer_id")
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock         Int           @default(0)
  unit          String?       // Unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "buc", "l")
  imageUrl      String?       @map("image_url") // Product image URL
  category      String?       // Product category (e.g. "Fruits", "Vegetables")
  isTraditional Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_traditional")
  isBio         Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_bio") // Organic product flag
  regionId      String?       @map("region_id") // Traditional region
  status        ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer      Producer      @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  traditionalRegion Region?   @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion", fields: [regionId], references: [id])
  cartItems     CartItem[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
  favorites     Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  promotions    Promotion[]

  @@map("products")
}

// Cart model - shopping cart
// A cart can be associated with a user (if logged in) or can be anonymous
// Status ACTIVE = active cart, CONVERTED = cart converted to order
model Cart {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?    @map("customer_id")
  status     CartStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer User?      @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items    CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

// CartItem model - cart items
// Each item represents a product with a specific quantity
model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String   @map("cart_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  cart    Cart    @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("cart_items")
}

// Order model - global order
// An order can contain products from multiple producers
// Created when user checks out from cart
model Order {
  id                  String           @id @default(uuid())
  customerId          String?          @map("customer_id")
  customerType        OrderCustomerType @default(B2C) @map("customer_type")
  status              OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  paymentStatus       PaymentStatus    @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  totalAmount         Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_amount")
  totalCommission     Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_commission")
  shippingFullName    String           @map("shipping_full_name")
  shippingPhone       String           @map("shipping_phone")
  shippingAddressLine1 String          @map("shipping_address_line1")
  shippingAddressLine2 String?         @map("shipping_address_line2")
  shippingCity        String           @map("shipping_city")
  shippingPostalCode  String?          @map("shipping_postal_code")
  shippingRegionId    String?          @map("shipping_region_id")
  // Company data for B2B
  companyName         String?          @map("company_name")
  companyCui          String?          @map("company_cui")
  companyRegNo        String?          @map("company_reg_no")
  companyAddress      String?          @map("company_address")
  notes               String?
  // Stripe payment
  stripeSessionId     String?          @map("stripe_session_id") // Stripe Checkout session ID
  createdAt           DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer      User?         @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  shippingRegion Region?      @relation("OrderShippingRegion", fields: [shippingRegionId], references: [id])
  vendors       OrderVendor[]
  commissions   Commission[]
  customerInvoice CustomerInvoice?

  @@map("orders")
}

// OrderVendor model - sub-order per producer
// Each producer has a separate sub-order with its own status and commission
// Splitting orders by producers allows independent management of each sub-order
model OrderVendor {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String            @map("order_id")
  producerId      String            @map("producer_id")
  status          OrderVendorStatus @default(PENDING)
  subtotal        Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  commissionRate  Decimal           @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.1200 for 12%
  commissionAmount Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  payoutAmount    Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("payout_amount")
  deliveryMethod  String?           @map("delivery_method") // e.g. "courier", "pickup"
  trackingNumber  String?           @map("tracking_number")
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order   Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items   OrderItem[]

  @@map("order_vendors")
}

// OrderItem model - order items
// Product snapshot (name, price) is saved for history
// Even if the product is modified later, the order keeps the original data
model OrderItem {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderVendorId          String   @map("order_vendor_id")
  productId              String   @map("product_id")
  quantity               Int
  unitPrice              Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("unit_price")
  totalPrice             Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_price")
  productNameSnapshot    String   @map("product_name_snapshot")
  productImageUrlSnapshot String? @map("product_image_url_snapshot")
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  orderVendor OrderVendor @relation(fields: [orderVendorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("order_items")
}

// Commission model - marketplace commission per order/producer
// Represents the commission charged by the platform for each producer in an order
model Commission {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String           @map("order_id")
  producerId      String           @map("producer_id")
  baseAmount      Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("base_amount") // Order value for that producer
  commissionRate  Decimal          @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.0800 for 8%
  commissionAmount Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  status          CommissionStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order           Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer        Producer         @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producerInvoice ProducerInvoice?

  @@map("commissions")
}

// CustomerInvoice model - invoice for customer
// Reference to the invoice generated in the external invoicing system
model CustomerInvoice {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  orderId    String    @unique @map("order_id")
  externalId String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl     String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt   DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  order      Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("customer_invoices")
}

// ProducerInvoice model - invoice for producer
// Reference to the invoice generated for the commission paid to the producer
model ProducerInvoice {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  commissionId String    @unique @map("commission_id")
  externalId   String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl       String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt     DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  commission   Commission @relation(fields: [commissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("producer_invoices")
}

// ShippingAddress model - shipping addresses for clients
model ShippingAddress {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  name      String
  phone     String
  email     String?
  city      String
  address   String
  postalCode String? @map("postal_code")
  notes     String?
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("shipping_addresses")
}

// Favorite model - favorite products for clients
model Favorite {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@map("favorites")
}

// Subscription model - product subscriptions
model Subscription {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String    @map("user_id")
  productId String    @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  frequency String    // e.g.: "weekly", "monthly"
  startDate DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate   DateTime? @map("end_date")
  isActive  Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("subscriptions")
}

// AlertPreferences model - email alert preferences
model AlertPreferences {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique @map("user_id")
  emailNewProducts Boolean @default(true) @map("email_new_products")
  emailPriceDrops  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_price_drops")
  emailStockAlerts  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_stock_alerts")
  emailOrderUpdates Boolean @default(true) @map("email_order_updates")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("alert_preferences")
}

// Notification model - notifications for users
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  type      String   // e.g.: "order", "product", "system"
  title     String
  message   String
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("notifications")
}

// Document model - documents and contracts
model Document {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String?   @map("user_id")
  producerId  String?   @map("producer_id")
  type        String    // e.g.: "contract", "invoice", "certificate"
  title       String
  description String?
  fileUrl     String    @map("file_url")
  mimeType    String?   @map("mime_type")
  size        Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user     User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  producer Producer? @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("documents")
}

// Promotion model - promotions and campaigns for producers
model Promotion {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  producerId   String    @map("producer_id")
  productId    String?   @map("product_id")
  title        String
  description  String?
  discountType String    @map("discount_type") // e.g.: "percentage", "fixed"
  discountValue Decimal   @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("discount_value")
  startDate    DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate      DateTime  @map("end_date")
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("promotions")
}

// Review model - product reviews and ratings
model Review {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String   @map("product_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order   Order?  @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([productId, userId])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ProducerReview model - producer reviews and ratings
model ProducerReview {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  producerId        String   @map("producer_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order    Order?   @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([producerId, userId])
  @@map("producer_reviews")
}
```

```plaintext
// Prisma schema for farme.ro marketplace
// Provider: PostgreSQL
// Documentation: https://www.prisma.io/docs

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Enum for user roles
enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  PRODUCER
  CUSTOMER
}

// Enum for producer type (company or PFA)
enum ProducerType {
  COMPANY
  PFA
}

// Enum for producer status
enum ProducerStatus {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for region type
enum RegionType {
  COUNTY
  REGION
}

// Enum for product status
enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING_REVIEW
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for order status
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enum for order vendor status (sub-order per producer)
enum OrderVendorStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  PREPARING
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

// Enum for payment status
enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
  REFUNDED
}

// Enum for cart status
enum CartStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CONVERTED
}

// Enum for order customer type
enum OrderCustomerType {
  B2C
  B2B
}

// Enum for commission status
enum CommissionStatus {
  PENDING
  ISSUED
  PAID
}

// User model - platform users
// 1-1 relation with Producer: a User with PRODUCER role can have a Producer profile
// A User can be ADMIN, PRODUCER or CUSTOMER
model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash")
  fullName     String    @map("full_name")
  role         UserRole  @default(CUSTOMER)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // 1-1 relation with Producer (only for users with PRODUCER role)
  producer Producer?
  
  // Relations for cart and orders
  carts Cart[]
  orders Order[]
  
  // Relations for client features
  shippingAddresses ShippingAddress[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  alertPreferences AlertPreferences?
  notifications Notification[]
  documents Document[]
  reviews Review[]
  producerReviews ProducerReview[]

  @@map("users")
}

// Producer model - producer profile
// 1-1 relation with User: each Producer belongs to a User with PRODUCER role
// Many-to-one relation with Region: each Producer has a main region
model Producer {
  id                String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String         @unique @map("user_id")
  name              String         // Company/brand name
  registrationNumber String        @map("registration_number") // CUI / CNP
  type              ProducerType
  mainRegionId      String?        @map("main_region_id")
  description       String?
  status            ProducerStatus @default(PENDING_VERIFICATION)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user              User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mainRegion        Region?        @relation("ProducerMainRegion", fields: [mainRegionId], references: [id])
  products          Product[]
  orderVendors      OrderVendor[]
  commissions       Commission[]
  documents         Document[]
  promotions        Promotion[]
  reviews           Review[]
  producerReviews   ProducerReview[]

  @@map("producers")
}

// Region model - regions/counties
// One-to-many relation with Producer (main region)
// One-to-many relation with Product (traditional region)
model Region {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  name      String      // e.g.: "Maramureș", "Cluj"
  type      RegionType
  code      String      // e.g.: "CJ", "MM"
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producersAsMainRegion Product[] @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion")
  producers            Producer[] @relation("ProducerMainRegion")
  orderShippingRegions Order[]    @relation("OrderShippingRegion")

  @@map("regions")
}

// Product model - products offered by producers
// Many-to-one relation with Producer: each product belongs to a Producer
// Many-to-one relation with Region: traditional region of the product
model Product {
  id            String        @id @default(uuid())
  producerId    String        @map("producer_id")
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock         Int           @default(0)
  unit          String?       // Unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "buc", "l")
  imageUrl      String?       @map("image_url") // Product image URL
  category      String?       // Product category (e.g. "Fruits", "Vegetables")
  isTraditional Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_traditional")
  isBio         Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_bio") // Organic product flag
  regionId      String?       @map("region_id") // Traditional region
  status        ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer      Producer      @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  traditionalRegion Region?   @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion", fields: [regionId], references: [id])
  cartItems     CartItem[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
  favorites     Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  promotions    Promotion[]

  @@map("products")
}

// Cart model - shopping cart
// A cart can be associated with a user (if logged in) or can be anonymous
// Status ACTIVE = active cart, CONVERTED = cart converted to order
model Cart {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?    @map("customer_id")
  status     CartStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer User?      @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items    CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

// CartItem model - cart items
// Each item represents a product with a specific quantity
model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String   @map("cart_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  cart    Cart    @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("cart_items")
}

// Order model - global order
// An order can contain products from multiple producers
// Created when user checks out from cart
model Order {
  id                  String           @id @default(uuid())
  customerId          String?          @map("customer_id")
  customerType        OrderCustomerType @default(B2C) @map("customer_type")
  status              OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  paymentStatus       PaymentStatus    @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  totalAmount         Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_amount")
  totalCommission     Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_commission")
  shippingFullName    String           @map("shipping_full_name")
  shippingPhone       String           @map("shipping_phone")
  shippingAddressLine1 String          @map("shipping_address_line1")
  shippingAddressLine2 String?         @map("shipping_address_line2")
  shippingCity        String           @map("shipping_city")
  shippingPostalCode  String?          @map("shipping_postal_code")
  shippingRegionId    String?          @map("shipping_region_id")
  // Company data for B2B
  companyName         String?          @map("company_name")
  companyCui          String?          @map("company_cui")
  companyRegNo        String?          @map("company_reg_no")
  companyAddress      String?          @map("company_address")
  notes               String?
  // Stripe payment
  stripeSessionId     String?          @map("stripe_session_id") // Stripe Checkout session ID
  createdAt           DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer      User?         @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  shippingRegion Region?      @relation("OrderShippingRegion", fields: [shippingRegionId], references: [id])
  vendors       OrderVendor[]
  commissions   Commission[]
  customerInvoice CustomerInvoice?

  @@map("orders")
}

// OrderVendor model - sub-order per producer
// Each producer has a separate sub-order with its own status and commission
// Splitting orders by producers allows independent management of each sub-order
model OrderVendor {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String            @map("order_id")
  producerId      String            @map("producer_id")
  status          OrderVendorStatus @default(PENDING)
  subtotal        Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  commissionRate  Decimal           @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.1200 for 12%
  commissionAmount Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  payoutAmount    Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("payout_amount")
  deliveryMethod  String?           @map("delivery_method") // e.g. "courier", "pickup"
  trackingNumber  String?           @map("tracking_number")
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order   Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items   OrderItem[]

  @@map("order_vendors")
}

// OrderItem model - order items
// Product snapshot (name, price) is saved for history
// Even if the product is modified later, the order keeps the original data
model OrderItem {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderVendorId          String   @map("order_vendor_id")
  productId              String   @map("product_id")
  quantity               Int
  unitPrice              Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("unit_price")
  totalPrice             Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_price")
  productNameSnapshot    String   @map("product_name_snapshot")
  productImageUrlSnapshot String? @map("product_image_url_snapshot")
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  orderVendor OrderVendor @relation(fields: [orderVendorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("order_items")
}

// Commission model - marketplace commission per order/producer
// Represents the commission charged by the platform for each producer in an order
model Commission {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String           @map("order_id")
  producerId      String           @map("producer_id")
  baseAmount      Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("base_amount") // Order value for that producer
  commissionRate  Decimal          @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.0800 for 8%
  commissionAmount Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  status          CommissionStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order           Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer        Producer         @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producerInvoice ProducerInvoice?

  @@map("commissions")
}

// CustomerInvoice model - invoice for customer
// Reference to the invoice generated in the external invoicing system
model CustomerInvoice {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  orderId    String    @unique @map("order_id")
  externalId String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl     String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt   DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  order      Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("customer_invoices")
}

// ProducerInvoice model - invoice for producer
// Reference to the invoice generated for the commission paid to the producer
model ProducerInvoice {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  commissionId String    @unique @map("commission_id")
  externalId   String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl       String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt     DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  commission   Commission @relation(fields: [commissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("producer_invoices")
}

// ShippingAddress model - shipping addresses for clients
model ShippingAddress {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  name      String
  phone     String
  email     String?
  city      String
  address   String
  postalCode String? @map("postal_code")
  notes     String?
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("shipping_addresses")
}

// Favorite model - favorite products for clients
model Favorite {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@map("favorites")
}

// Subscription model - product subscriptions
model Subscription {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String    @map("user_id")
  productId String    @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  frequency String    // e.g.: "weekly", "monthly"
  startDate DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate   DateTime? @map("end_date")
  isActive  Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("subscriptions")
}

// AlertPreferences model - email alert preferences
model AlertPreferences {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique @map("user_id")
  emailNewProducts Boolean @default(true) @map("email_new_products")
  emailPriceDrops  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_price_drops")
  emailStockAlerts  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_stock_alerts")
  emailOrderUpdates Boolean @default(true) @map("email_order_updates")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("alert_preferences")
}

// Notification model - notifications for users
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  type      String   // e.g.: "order", "product", "system"
  title     String
  message   String
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("notifications")
}

// Document model - documents and contracts
model Document {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String?   @map("user_id")
  producerId  String?   @map("producer_id")
  type        String    // e.g.: "contract", "invoice", "certificate"
  title       String
  description String?
  fileUrl     String    @map("file_url")
  mimeType    String?   @map("mime_type")
  size        Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user     User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  producer Producer? @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("documents")
}

// Promotion model - promotions and campaigns for producers
model Promotion {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  producerId   String    @map("producer_id")
  productId    String?   @map("product_id")
  title        String
  description  String?
  discountType String    @map("discount_type") // e.g.: "percentage", "fixed"
  discountValue Decimal   @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("discount_value")
  startDate    DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate      DateTime  @map("end_date")
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("promotions")
}

// Review model - product reviews and ratings
model Review {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String   @map("product_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order   Order?  @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([productId, userId])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ProducerReview model - producer reviews and ratings
model ProducerReview {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  producerId        String   @map("producer_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order    Order?   @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([producerId, userId])
  @@map("producer_reviews")
}
```

```plaintext
// Prisma schema for farme.ro marketplace
// Provider: PostgreSQL
// Documentation: https://www.prisma.io/docs

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Enum for user roles
enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  PRODUCER
  CUSTOMER
}

// Enum for producer type (company or PFA)
enum ProducerType {
  COMPANY
  PFA
}

// Enum for producer status
enum ProducerStatus {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for region type
enum RegionType {
  COUNTY
  REGION
}

// Enum for product status
enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING_REVIEW
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for order status
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enum for order vendor status (sub-order per producer)
enum OrderVendorStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  PREPARING
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

// Enum for payment status
enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
  REFUNDED
}

// Enum for cart status
enum CartStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CONVERTED
}

// Enum for order customer type
enum OrderCustomerType {
  B2C
  B2B
}

// Enum for commission status
enum CommissionStatus {
  PENDING
  ISSUED
  PAID
}

// User model - platform users
// 1-1 relation with Producer: a User with PRODUCER role can have a Producer profile
// A User can be ADMIN, PRODUCER or CUSTOMER
model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash")
  fullName     String    @map("full_name")
  role         UserRole  @default(CUSTOMER)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // 1-1 relation with Producer (only for users with PRODUCER role)
  producer Producer?
  
  // Relations for cart and orders
  carts Cart[]
  orders Order[]
  
  // Relations for client features
  shippingAddresses ShippingAddress[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  alertPreferences AlertPreferences?
  notifications Notification[]
  documents Document[]
  reviews Review[]
  producerReviews ProducerReview[]

  @@map("users")
}

// Producer model - producer profile
// 1-1 relation with User: each Producer belongs to a User with PRODUCER role
// Many-to-one relation with Region: each Producer has a main region
model Producer {
  id                String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String         @unique @map("user_id")
  name              String         // Company/brand name
  registrationNumber String        @map("registration_number") // CUI / CNP
  type              ProducerType
  mainRegionId      String?        @map("main_region_id")
  description       String?
  status            ProducerStatus @default(PENDING_VERIFICATION)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user              User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mainRegion        Region?        @relation("ProducerMainRegion", fields: [mainRegionId], references: [id])
  products          Product[]
  orderVendors      OrderVendor[]
  commissions       Commission[]
  documents         Document[]
  promotions        Promotion[]
  reviews           Review[]
  producerReviews   ProducerReview[]

  @@map("producers")
}

// Region model - regions/counties
// One-to-many relation with Producer (main region)
// One-to-many relation with Product (traditional region)
model Region {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  name      String      // e.g.: "Maramureș", "Cluj"
  type      RegionType
  code      String      // e.g.: "CJ", "MM"
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producersAsMainRegion Product[] @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion")
  producers            Producer[] @relation("ProducerMainRegion")
  orderShippingRegions Order[]    @relation("OrderShippingRegion")

  @@map("regions")
}

// Product model - products offered by producers
// Many-to-one relation with Producer: each product belongs to a Producer
// Many-to-one relation with Region: traditional region of the product
model Product {
  id            String        @id @default(uuid())
  producerId    String        @map("producer_id")
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock         Int           @default(0)
  unit          String?       // Unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "buc", "l")
  imageUrl      String?       @map("image_url") // Product image URL
  category      String?       // Product category (e.g. "Fruits", "Vegetables")
  isTraditional Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_traditional")
  isBio         Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_bio") // Organic product flag
  regionId      String?       @map("region_id") // Traditional region
  status        ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer      Producer      @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  traditionalRegion Region?   @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion", fields: [regionId], references: [id])
  cartItems     CartItem[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
  favorites     Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  promotions    Promotion[]
  reviews       Review[]

  @@map("products")
}

// Cart model - shopping cart
// A cart can be associated with a user (if logged in) or can be anonymous
// Status ACTIVE = active cart, CONVERTED = cart converted to order
model Cart {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?    @map("customer_id")
  status     CartStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer User?      @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items    CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

// CartItem model - cart items
// Each item represents a product with a specific quantity
model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String   @map("cart_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  cart    Cart    @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("cart_items")
}

// Order model - global order
// An order can contain products from multiple producers
// Created when user checks out from cart
model Order {
  id                  String           @id @default(uuid())
  customerId          String?          @map("customer_id")
  customerType        OrderCustomerType @default(B2C) @map("customer_type")
  status              OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  paymentStatus       PaymentStatus    @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  totalAmount         Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_amount")
  totalCommission     Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_commission")
  shippingFullName    String           @map("shipping_full_name")
  shippingPhone       String           @map("shipping_phone")
  shippingAddressLine1 String          @map("shipping_address_line1")
  shippingAddressLine2 String?         @map("shipping_address_line2")
  shippingCity        String           @map("shipping_city")
  shippingPostalCode  String?          @map("shipping_postal_code")
  shippingRegionId    String?          @map("shipping_region_id")
  // Company data for B2B
  companyName         String?          @map("company_name")
  companyCui          String?          @map("company_cui")
  companyRegNo        String?          @map("company_reg_no")
  companyAddress      String?          @map("company_address")
  notes               String?
  // Stripe payment
  stripeSessionId     String?          @map("stripe_session_id") // Stripe Checkout session ID
  createdAt           DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer      User?         @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  shippingRegion Region?      @relation("OrderShippingRegion", fields: [shippingRegionId], references: [id])
  vendors       OrderVendor[]
  commissions   Commission[]
  customerInvoice CustomerInvoice?

  @@map("orders")
}

// OrderVendor model - sub-order per producer
// Each producer has a separate sub-order with its own status and commission
// Splitting orders by producers allows independent management of each sub-order
model OrderVendor {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String            @map("order_id")
  producerId      String            @map("producer_id")
  status          OrderVendorStatus @default(PENDING)
  subtotal        Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  commissionRate  Decimal           @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.1200 for 12%
  commissionAmount Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  payoutAmount    Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("payout_amount")
  deliveryMethod  String?           @map("delivery_method") // e.g. "courier", "pickup"
  trackingNumber  String?           @map("tracking_number")
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order   Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items   OrderItem[]

  @@map("order_vendors")
}

// OrderItem model - order items
// Product snapshot (name, price) is saved for history
// Even if the product is modified later, the order keeps the original data
model OrderItem {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderVendorId          String   @map("order_vendor_id")
  productId              String   @map("product_id")
  quantity               Int
  unitPrice              Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("unit_price")
  totalPrice             Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_price")
  productNameSnapshot    String   @map("product_name_snapshot")
  productImageUrlSnapshot String? @map("product_image_url_snapshot")
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  orderVendor OrderVendor @relation(fields: [orderVendorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("order_items")
}

// Commission model - marketplace commission per order/producer
// Represents the commission charged by the platform for each producer in an order
model Commission {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String           @map("order_id")
  producerId      String           @map("producer_id")
  baseAmount      Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("base_amount") // Order value for that producer
  commissionRate  Decimal          @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.0800 for 8%
  commissionAmount Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  status          CommissionStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order           Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer        Producer         @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producerInvoice ProducerInvoice?

  @@map("commissions")
}

// CustomerInvoice model - invoice for customer
// Reference to the invoice generated in the external invoicing system
model CustomerInvoice {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  orderId    String    @unique @map("order_id")
  externalId String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl     String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt   DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  order      Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("customer_invoices")
}

// ProducerInvoice model - invoice for producer
// Reference to the invoice generated for the commission paid to the producer
model ProducerInvoice {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  commissionId String    @unique @map("commission_id")
  externalId   String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl       String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt     DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  commission   Commission @relation(fields: [commissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("producer_invoices")
}

// ShippingAddress model - shipping addresses for clients
model ShippingAddress {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  name      String
  phone     String
  email     String?
  city      String
  address   String
  postalCode String? @map("postal_code")
  notes     String?
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("shipping_addresses")
}

// Favorite model - favorite products for clients
model Favorite {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@map("favorites")
}

// Subscription model - product subscriptions
model Subscription {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String    @map("user_id")
  productId String    @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  frequency String    // e.g.: "weekly", "monthly"
  startDate DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate   DateTime? @map("end_date")
  isActive  Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("subscriptions")
}

// AlertPreferences model - email alert preferences
model AlertPreferences {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique @map("user_id")
  emailNewProducts Boolean @default(true) @map("email_new_products")
  emailPriceDrops  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_price_drops")
  emailStockAlerts  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_stock_alerts")
  emailOrderUpdates Boolean @default(true) @map("email_order_updates")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("alert_preferences")
}

// Notification model - notifications for users
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  type      String   // e.g.: "order", "product", "system"
  title     String
  message   String
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("notifications")
}

// Document model - documents and contracts
model Document {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String?   @map("user_id")
  producerId  String?   @map("producer_id")
  type        String    // e.g.: "contract", "invoice", "certificate"
  title       String
  description String?
  fileUrl     String    @map("file_url")
  mimeType    String?   @map("mime_type")
  size        Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user     User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  producer Producer? @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("documents")
}

// Promotion model - promotions and campaigns for producers
model Promotion {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  producerId   String    @map("producer_id")
  productId    String?   @map("product_id")
  title        String
  description  String?
  discountType String    @map("discount_type") // e.g.: "percentage", "fixed"
  discountValue Decimal   @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("discount_value")
  startDate    DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate      DateTime  @map("end_date")
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("promotions")
}

// Review model - product reviews and ratings
model Review {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String   @map("product_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order   Order?  @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([productId, userId])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ProducerReview model - producer reviews and ratings
model ProducerReview {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  producerId        String   @map("producer_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order    Order?   @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([producerId, userId])
  @@map("producer_reviews")
}
```

Adăugând relațiile Order și creând endpoint-urile pentru review-uri:


```plaintext
  vendors      OrderVendor[]
```

```typescript
/**
 * Review Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /reviews/product/:productId - Get reviews for a product
 * - POST /reviews/product/:productId - Create product review
 * - PATCH /reviews/:id - Update review
 * - DELETE /reviews/:id - Delete review
 * - GET /reviews/producer/:producerId - Get reviews for a producer
 * - POST /reviews/producer/:producerId - Create producer review
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole, OrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

const createReviewSchema = z.object({
  rating: z.number().int().min(1, 'Rating trebuie să fie între 1 și 5').max(5, 'Rating trebuie să fie între 1 și 5'),
  comment: z.string().max(1000, 'Comentariul nu poate depăși 1000 caractere').optional().nullable(),
  orderId: z.string().uuid().optional().nullable(),
});

/**
 * GET /reviews/product/:productId
 * Get reviews for a product (public)
 */
router.get('/product/:productId', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { productId } = req.params;
    const { page = '1', limit = '10' } = req.query;

    const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10);
    const limitNum = parseInt(limit as string, 10);
    const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

    const [reviews, total] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.review.findMany({
        where: {
          productId,
          isApproved: true, // Only show approved reviews
        },
        include: {
          user: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fullName: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip,
        take: limitNum,
      }),
      prisma.review.count({
        where: {
          productId,
          isApproved: true,
        },
      }),
    ]);

    // Calculate average rating
    const ratings = await prisma.review.aggregate({
      where: {
        productId,
        isApproved: true,
      },
      _avg: {
        rating: true,
      },
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({
      reviews,
      averageRating: ratings._avg.rating || 0,
      totalReviews: ratings._count.id,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get product reviews error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea review-urilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * POST /reviews/product/:productId
 * Create product review
 * Requires authentication
 */
router.post('/product/:productId', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { productId } = req.params;
    const data = createReviewSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Check if product exists
    const product = await prisma.product.findUnique({
      where: { id: productId },
    });

    if (!product) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Produs negăsit' });
    }

    // Check if user already reviewed this product
    const existingReview = await prisma.review.findUnique({
      where: {
        productId_userId: {
          productId,
          userId: req.user.userId,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existingReview) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Ai adăugat deja un review pentru acest produs' });
    }

    // Verify purchase if orderId is provided
    let isVerifiedPurchase = false;
    if (data.orderId) {
      const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
        where: {
          id: data.orderId,
          customerId: req.user.userId,
          status: OrderStatus.COMPLETED,
          vendors: {
            some: {
              items: {
                some: {
                  productId,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      });

      isVerifiedPurchase = !!order;
    }

    // Create review (needs admin approval)
    const review = await prisma.review.create({
      data: {
        productId,
        userId: req.user.userId,
        rating: data.rating,
        comment: data.comment ?? null,
        orderId: data.orderId ?? null,
        isVerifiedPurchase,
        isApproved: false, // Requires admin approval
      },
      include: {
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.status(201).json({ review });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Create product review error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la crearea review-ului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /reviews/producer/:producerId
 * Get reviews for a producer (public)
 */
router.get('/producer/:producerId', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { producerId } = req.params;
    const { page = '1', limit = '10' } = req.query;

    const pageNum = parseInt(page as string, 10);
    const limitNum = parseInt(limit as string, 10);
    const skip = (pageNum - 1) * limitNum;

    const [reviews, total] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.producerReview.findMany({
        where: {
          producerId,
          isApproved: true,
        },
        include: {
          user: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fullName: true,
            },
          },
        },
        orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
        skip,
        take: limitNum,
      }),
      prisma.producerReview.count({
        where: {
          producerId,
          isApproved: true,
        },
      }),
    ]);

    // Calculate average rating
    const ratings = await prisma.producerReview.aggregate({
      where: {
        producerId,
        isApproved: true,
      },
      _avg: {
        rating: true,
      },
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({
      reviews,
      averageRating: ratings._avg.rating || 0,
      totalReviews: ratings._count.id,
      pagination: {
        page: pageNum,
        limit: limitNum,
        total,
        totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limitNum),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get producer reviews error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea review-urilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * POST /reviews/producer/:producerId
 * Create producer review
 * Requires authentication
 */
router.post('/producer/:producerId', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { producerId } = req.params;
    const data = createReviewSchema.parse(req.body);

    // Check if producer exists
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { id: producerId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Producător negăsit' });
    }

    // Check if user already reviewed this producer
    const existingReview = await prisma.producerReview.findUnique({
      where: {
        producerId_userId: {
          producerId,
          userId: req.user.userId,
        },
      },
    });

    if (existingReview) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Ai adăugat deja un review pentru acest producător' });
    }

    // Verify purchase if orderId is provided
    let isVerifiedPurchase = false;
    if (data.orderId) {
      const order = await prisma.order.findFirst({
        where: {
          id: data.orderId,
          customerId: req.user.userId,
          status: OrderStatus.COMPLETED,
          vendors: {
            some: {
              producerId,
            },
          },
        },
      });

      isVerifiedPurchase = !!order;
    }

    // Create review (needs admin approval)
    const review = await prisma.producerReview.create({
      data: {
        producerId,
        userId: req.user.userId,
        rating: data.rating,
        comment: data.comment ?? null,
        orderId: data.orderId ?? null,
        isVerifiedPurchase,
        isApproved: false, // Requires admin approval
      },
      include: {
        user: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            fullName: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.status(201).json({ review });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Create producer review error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la crearea review-ului' });
  }
});

/**
 * PATCH /reviews/:id
 * Update review (only own review or admin)
 */
router.patch('/:id', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { id } = req.params;
    const data = createReviewSchema.partial().parse(req.body);

    // Find review
    const review = await prisma.review.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    const producerReview = review
      ? null
      : await prisma.producerReview.findUnique({
          where: { id },
        });

    const currentReview = review || producerReview;

    if (!currentReview) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Review negăsit' });
    }

    // Check permission
    if (req.user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN && currentReview.userId !== req.user.userId) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Nu ai permisiunea să modifici acest review' });
    }

    // Update review
    if (review) {
      const updated = await prisma.review.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          rating: data.rating,
          comment: data.comment,
          isApproved: false, // Reset approval on update
        },
        include: {
          user: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fullName: true,
            },
          },
        },
      });
      return res.json({ review: updated });
    } else {
      const updated = await prisma.producerReview.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          rating: data.rating,
          comment: data.comment,
          isApproved: false, // Reset approval on update
        },
        include: {
          user: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fullName: true,
            },
          },
        },
      });
      return res.json({ review: updated });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Date invalide', details: error.issues });
    }
    console.error('Update review error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea review-ului' });
  }
});

/**
 * DELETE /reviews/:id
 * Delete review (only own review or admin)
 */
router.delete('/:id', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { id } = req.params;

    // Find review
    const review = await prisma.review.findUnique({
      where: { id },
    });

    const producerReview = review
      ? null
      : await prisma.producerReview.findUnique({
          where: { id },
        });

    const currentReview = review || producerReview;

    if (!currentReview) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Review negăsit' });
    }

    // Check permission
    if (req.user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN && currentReview.userId !== req.user.userId) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Nu ai permisiunea să ștergi acest review' });
    }

    // Delete review
    if (review) {
      await prisma.review.delete({ where: { id } });
    } else {
      await prisma.producerReview.delete({ where: { id } });
    }

    res.json({ message: 'Review șters cu succes' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Delete review error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la ștergerea review-ului' });
  }
});

export default router;
```
