```plaintext
// Prisma schema for farme.ro marketplace
// Provider: PostgreSQL
// Documentation: https://www.prisma.io/docs

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// Enum for user roles
enum UserRole {
  ADMIN
  PRODUCER
  CUSTOMER
}

// Enum for producer type (company or PFA)
enum ProducerType {
  COMPANY
  PFA
}

// Enum for producer status
enum ProducerStatus {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for region type
enum RegionType {
  COUNTY
  REGION
}

// Enum for product status
enum ProductStatus {
  DRAFT
  PENDING_REVIEW
  APPROVED
  REJECTED
}

// Enum for order status
enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING
  PAID
  CANCELLED
  COMPLETED
}

// Enum for order vendor status (sub-order per producer)
enum OrderVendorStatus {
  PENDING
  ACCEPTED
  PREPARING
  SHIPPED
  DELIVERED
  CANCELLED
}

// Enum for payment status
enum PaymentStatus {
  UNPAID
  PAID
  REFUNDED
}

// Enum for cart status
enum CartStatus {
  ACTIVE
  CONVERTED
}

// Enum for order customer type
enum OrderCustomerType {
  B2C
  B2B
}

// Enum for commission status
enum CommissionStatus {
  PENDING
  ISSUED
  PAID
}

// User model - platform users
// 1-1 relation with Producer: a User with PRODUCER role can have a Producer profile
// A User can be ADMIN, PRODUCER or CUSTOMER
model User {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String    @map("password_hash")
  fullName     String    @map("full_name")
  role         UserRole  @default(CUSTOMER)
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // 1-1 relation with Producer (only for users with PRODUCER role)
  producer Producer?
  
  // Relations for cart and orders
  carts Cart[]
  orders Order[]
  
  // Relations for client features
  shippingAddresses ShippingAddress[]
  favorites Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  alertPreferences AlertPreferences?
  notifications Notification[]
  pushSubscriptions PushSubscription[]
  documents Document[]
  reviews Review[]
  producerReviews ProducerReview[]

  @@map("users")
}

// Producer model - producer profile
// 1-1 relation with User: each Producer belongs to a User with PRODUCER role
// Many-to-one relation with Region: each Producer has a main region
model Producer {
  id                String         @id @default(uuid())
  userId            String         @unique @map("user_id")
  name              String         // Company/brand name
  registrationNumber String        @map("registration_number") // CUI / CNP
  type              ProducerType
  mainRegionId      String?        @map("main_region_id")
  description       String?
  status            ProducerStatus @default(PENDING_VERIFICATION)
  createdAt         DateTime       @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime       @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user              User           @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  mainRegion        Region?        @relation("ProducerMainRegion", fields: [mainRegionId], references: [id])
  products          Product[]
  orderVendors      OrderVendor[]
  commissions       Commission[]
  documents         Document[]
  promotions        Promotion[]
  reviews           Review[]
  producerReviews   ProducerReview[]

  @@map("producers")
}

// Region model - regions/counties
// One-to-many relation with Producer (main region)
// One-to-many relation with Product (traditional region)
model Region {
  id        String      @id @default(uuid())
  name      String      // e.g.: "Maramureș", "Cluj"
  type      RegionType
  code      String      // e.g.: "CJ", "MM"
  createdAt DateTime    @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime    @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producersAsMainRegion Product[] @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion")
  producers            Producer[] @relation("ProducerMainRegion")
  orderShippingRegions Order[]    @relation("OrderShippingRegion")

  @@map("regions")
}

// Product model - products offered by producers
// Many-to-one relation with Producer: each product belongs to a Producer
// Many-to-one relation with Region: traditional region of the product
model Product {
  id            String        @id @default(uuid())
  producerId    String        @map("producer_id")
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  stock         Int           @default(0)
  unit          String?       // Unit of measure (e.g. "kg", "buc", "l")
  imageUrl      String?       @map("image_url") // Product image URL
  category      String?       // Product category (e.g. "Fruits", "Vegetables")
  isTraditional Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_traditional")
  isBio         Boolean       @default(false) @map("is_bio") // Organic product flag
  regionId      String?       @map("region_id") // Traditional region
  status        ProductStatus @default(DRAFT)
  createdAt     DateTime      @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime      @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer      Producer      @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  traditionalRegion Region?   @relation("ProductTraditionalRegion", fields: [regionId], references: [id])
  cartItems     CartItem[]
  orderItems    OrderItem[]
  favorites     Favorite[]
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  promotions    Promotion[]
  reviews       Review[]

  @@map("products")
}

// Cart model - shopping cart
// A cart can be associated with a user (if logged in) or can be anonymous
// Status ACTIVE = active cart, CONVERTED = cart converted to order
model Cart {
  id         String     @id @default(uuid())
  customerId String?    @map("customer_id")
  status     CartStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  createdAt  DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt  DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer User?      @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items    CartItem[]

  @@map("carts")
}

// CartItem model - cart items
// Each item represents a product with a specific quantity
model CartItem {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  cartId    String   @map("cart_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  cart    Cart    @relation(fields: [cartId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("cart_items")
}

// Order model - global order
// An order can contain products from multiple producers
// Created when user checks out from cart
model Order {
  id                  String           @id @default(uuid())
  customerId          String?          @map("customer_id")
  customerType        OrderCustomerType @default(B2C) @map("customer_type")
  status              OrderStatus     @default(PENDING)
  paymentStatus       PaymentStatus    @default(UNPAID) @map("payment_status")
  totalAmount         Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_amount")
  totalCommission     Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_commission")
  shippingFullName    String           @map("shipping_full_name")
  shippingPhone       String           @map("shipping_phone")
  shippingAddressLine1 String          @map("shipping_address_line1")
  shippingAddressLine2 String?         @map("shipping_address_line2")
  shippingCity        String           @map("shipping_city")
  shippingPostalCode  String?          @map("shipping_postal_code")
  shippingRegionId    String?          @map("shipping_region_id")
  // Company data for B2B
  companyName         String?          @map("company_name")
  companyCui          String?          @map("company_cui")
  companyRegNo        String?          @map("company_reg_no")
  companyAddress      String?          @map("company_address")
  notes               String?
  // Stripe payment
  stripeSessionId     String?          @map("stripe_session_id") // Stripe Checkout session ID
  createdAt           DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt           DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  customer      User?         @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  shippingRegion Region?      @relation("OrderShippingRegion", fields: [shippingRegionId], references: [id])
  vendors       OrderVendor[]
  commissions   Commission[]
  customerInvoice CustomerInvoice?
  reviews       Review[]
  producerReviews ProducerReview[]

  @@map("orders")
}

// OrderVendor model - sub-order per producer
// Each producer has a separate sub-order with its own status and commission
// Splitting orders by producers allows independent management of each sub-order
model OrderVendor {
  id              String            @id @default(uuid())
  orderId         String            @map("order_id")
  producerId      String            @map("producer_id")
  status          OrderVendorStatus @default(PENDING)
  subtotal        Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  commissionRate  Decimal           @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.1200 for 12%
  commissionAmount Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  payoutAmount    Decimal           @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("payout_amount")
  deliveryMethod  String?           @map("delivery_method") // e.g. "courier", "pickup"
  trackingNumber  String?           @map("tracking_number")
  createdAt       DateTime          @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime          @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order   Order      @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  items   OrderItem[]

  @@map("order_vendors")
}

// OrderItem model - order items
// Product snapshot (name, price) is saved for history
// Even if the product is modified later, the order keeps the original data
model OrderItem {
  id                     String   @id @default(uuid())
  orderVendorId          String   @map("order_vendor_id")
  productId              String   @map("product_id")
  quantity               Int
  unitPrice              Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("unit_price")
  totalPrice             Decimal  @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("total_price")
  productNameSnapshot    String   @map("product_name_snapshot")
  productImageUrlSnapshot String? @map("product_image_url_snapshot")
  createdAt              DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt              DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  orderVendor OrderVendor @relation(fields: [orderVendorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product     Product     @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("order_items")
}

// Commission model - marketplace commission per order/producer
// Represents the commission charged by the platform for each producer in an order
model Commission {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  orderId         String           @map("order_id")
  producerId      String           @map("producer_id")
  baseAmount      Decimal          @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("base_amount") // Order value for that producer
  commissionRate  Decimal          @db.Decimal(5, 4) @map("commission_rate") // e.g.: 0.0800 for 8%
  commissionAmount Decimal         @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("commission_amount")
  status          CommissionStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  order           Order            @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producer        Producer         @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  producerInvoice ProducerInvoice?

  @@map("commissions")
}

// CustomerInvoice model - invoice for customer
// Reference to the invoice generated in the external invoicing system
model CustomerInvoice {
  id         String    @id @default(cuid())
  orderId    String    @unique @map("order_id")
  externalId String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl     String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt   DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  order      Order     @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("customer_invoices")
}

// ProducerInvoice model - invoice for producer
// Reference to the invoice generated for the commission paid to the producer
model ProducerInvoice {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  commissionId String    @unique @map("commission_id")
  externalId   String?   @map("external_id") // ID in external system (e.g. SmartBill/Factureaza)
  pdfUrl       String?   @map("pdf_url") // Link to PDF invoice in external system
  issuedAt     DateTime? @map("issued_at") // Invoice issue date/time

  // Relations
  commission   Commission @relation(fields: [commissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("producer_invoices")
}

// ShippingAddress model - shipping addresses for clients
model ShippingAddress {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  name      String
  phone     String
  email     String?
  city      String
  address   String
  postalCode String? @map("postal_code")
  notes     String?
  isDefault Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_default")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("shipping_addresses")
}

// Favorite model - favorite products for clients
model Favorite {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  productId String   @map("product_id")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, productId])
  @@map("favorites")
}

// Subscription model - product subscriptions
model Subscription {
  id        String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String    @map("user_id")
  productId String    @map("product_id")
  quantity  Int
  frequency String    // e.g.: "weekly", "monthly"
  startDate DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate   DateTime? @map("end_date")
  isActive  Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("subscriptions")
}

// AlertPreferences model - email alert preferences
model AlertPreferences {
  id              String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId          String   @unique @map("user_id")
  emailNewProducts Boolean @default(true) @map("email_new_products")
  emailPriceDrops  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_price_drops")
  emailStockAlerts  Boolean @default(true) @map("email_stock_alerts")
  emailOrderUpdates Boolean @default(true) @map("email_order_updates")
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("alert_preferences")
}

// Notification model - notifications for users
model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  type      String   // e.g.: "order", "product", "system"
  title     String
  message   String
  isRead    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_read")
  link      String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("notifications")
}

// PushSubscription model - Web Push subscriptions
model PushSubscription {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  endpoint  String
  p256dh    String
  auth      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relații
  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, endpoint])
  @@map("push_subscriptions")
}

// Document model - documents and contracts
model Document {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String?   @map("user_id")
  producerId  String?   @map("producer_id")
  type        String    // e.g.: "contract", "invoice", "certificate"
  title       String
  description String?
  fileUrl     String    @map("file_url")
  mimeType    String?   @map("mime_type")
  size        Int?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  user     User?     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  producer Producer? @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("documents")
}

// Promotion model - promotions and campaigns for producers
model Promotion {
  id           String    @id @default(uuid())
  producerId   String    @map("producer_id")
  productId    String?   @map("product_id")
  title        String
  description  String?
  discountType String    @map("discount_type") // e.g.: "percentage", "fixed"
  discountValue Decimal   @db.Decimal(10, 2) @map("discount_value")
  startDate    DateTime  @map("start_date")
  endDate      DateTime  @map("end_date")
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true) @map("is_active")
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer  @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  product  Product?  @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map("promotions")
}

// Review model - product reviews and ratings
model Review {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  productId         String   @map("product_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  product Product @relation(fields: [productId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user    User    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order   Order?  @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([productId, userId])
  @@map("reviews")
}

// ProducerReview model - producer reviews and ratings
model ProducerReview {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  producerId        String   @map("producer_id")
  userId            String   @map("user_id")
  orderId           String?  @map("order_id")
  rating            Int      // 1-5 stars
  comment           String?
  isVerifiedPurchase Boolean @default(false) @map("is_verified_purchase")
  isApproved        Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_approved")
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  producer Producer @relation(fields: [producerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  user     User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order    Order?   @relation(fields: [orderId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([producerId, userId])
  @@map("producer_reviews")
}
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import { setupStaticFiles } from './utils/upload';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import productUploadRoutes from './modules/products/product-upload.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
import producerSubscriptionsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-subscriptions.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
import pushNotificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/push-notifications.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';
// Reviews
import reviewRoutes from './modules/reviews/review.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

// Setup monitoring (Sentry)
setupMonitoring();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Static files (uploads)
setupStaticFiles(app);

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Security headers
app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware);

// Performance monitoring
app.use(performanceMiddleware);

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// GET /health/detailed - comprehensive health check
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Detailed health check
app.get('/health/detailed', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const health = await performHealthCheck();
    const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : health.status === 'degraded' ? 200 : 503;
    res.status(statusCode).json(health);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Health check failed', error as Error);
    res.status(503).json({
      status: 'unhealthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      error: 'Health check failed',
    });
  }
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productUploadRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);
// Reviews
app.use('/reviews', reviewRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { generalRateLimiter, authRateLimiter, paymentRateLimiter } from './middleware/rateLimit';
import { logger } from './utils/logger';
import { corsConfig, allowedCorsOrigins } from './config/cors';
import { setupStaticFiles } from './utils/upload';
import authRoutes from './modules/auth/auth.routes';
import regionRoutes from './modules/regions/region.routes';
import producerRoutes, { adminRouter as producerAdminRouter } from './modules/producers/producer.routes';
import productRoutes, { adminRouter as productAdminRouter } from './modules/products/product.routes';
import productUploadRoutes from './modules/products/product-upload.routes';
import cartRoutes from './modules/cart/cart.routes';
import orderRoutes, { adminRouter as orderAdminRouter } from './modules/orders/order.routes';
import commissionRoutes from './modules/commission/commission.routes';
import publicRoutes from './modules/public/public.routes';
import paymentRoutes from './modules/payments/payment.routes';
// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
import orderAliasRoutes from './modules/orders/order-alias.routes';
import producerProductsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-products.routes';
import producerOrdersRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-orders.routes';
import producerSubscriptionsRoutes from './modules/producers/producer-subscriptions.routes';
// Client routes
import clientProfileRoutes from './modules/clients/client-profile.routes';
import favoritesRoutes from './modules/clients/favorites.routes';
import subscriptionsRoutes from './modules/clients/subscriptions.routes';
import alertsRoutes from './modules/clients/alerts.routes';
// Business routes
import businessRoutes from './modules/business/business.routes';
// Logistics routes
import logisticsRoutes from './modules/logistics/logistics.routes';
// Investor routes
import investorRoutes from './modules/investor/investor.routes';
// Notifications
import notificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/notification.routes';
import pushNotificationRoutes from './modules/notifications/push-notifications.routes';
// Documents
import documentRoutes from './modules/documents/document.routes';
// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';
// Reviews
import reviewRoutes from './modules/reviews/review.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

// Setup monitoring (Sentry)
setupMonitoring();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Static files (uploads)
setupStaticFiles(app);

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Security headers
app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware);

// Performance monitoring
app.use(performanceMiddleware);

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// GET /health/detailed - comprehensive health check
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Detailed health check
app.get('/health/detailed', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const health = await performHealthCheck();
    const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : health.status === 'degraded' ? 200 : 503;
    res.status(statusCode).json(health);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Health check failed', error as Error);
    res.status(503).json({
      status: 'unhealthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      error: 'Health check failed',
    });
  }
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productUploadRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);
app.use('/notifications/push', pushNotificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);
// Reviews
app.use('/reviews', reviewRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Analytics Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru analytics avansate
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /analytics/dashboard - Dashboard analytics (admin)
 * - GET /analytics/products - Product analytics
 * - GET /analytics/orders - Order analytics
 * - GET /analytics/users - User analytics
 * - GET /analytics/revenue - Revenue analytics
 * - GET /analytics/trends - Trends analytics
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';
import { z } from 'zod';

const router = Router();

// Schema pentru query parameters
const dateRangeSchema = z.object({
  startDate: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  endDate: z.string().datetime().optional(),
  period: z.enum(['day', 'week', 'month', 'year']).optional(),
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/dashboard
 * Dashboard analytics (admin only)
 */
router.get('/dashboard', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // Total stats
    const [
      totalUsers,
      totalProducers,
      totalProducts,
      totalOrders,
      totalRevenue,
      activeUsers,
      pendingOrders,
      completedOrders,
    ] = await Promise.all([
      prisma.user.count(),
      prisma.producer.count({ where: { status: 'APPROVED' } }),
      prisma.product.count({ where: { status: 'APPROVED' } }),
      prisma.order.count({ where: { createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate } } }),
      prisma.order.aggregate({
        where: {
          createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
        _sum: { totalAmount: true },
      }),
      prisma.user.count({
        where: {
          orders: {
            some: {
              createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
            },
          },
        },
      }),
      prisma.order.count({
        where: {
          status: { in: ['PENDING', 'PAID'] },
          createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
        },
      }),
      prisma.order.count({
        where: {
          status: 'COMPLETED',
          createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
        },
      }),
    ]);

    // Revenue growth
    const previousPeriodStart = new Date(startDate.getTime() - (endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()));
    const previousRevenue = await prisma.order.aggregate({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: previousPeriodStart, lt: startDate },
        paymentStatus: 'PAID',
      },
      _sum: { totalAmount: true },
    });

    const currentRevenue = totalRevenue._sum.totalAmount || 0;
    const prevRevenue = previousRevenue._sum.totalAmount || 0;
    const revenueGrowth = prevRevenue > 0 ? ((currentRevenue - prevRevenue) / prevRevenue) * 100 : 0;

    // Order growth
    const previousOrders = await prisma.order.count({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: previousPeriodStart, lt: startDate },
      },
    });
    const orderGrowth = previousOrders > 0 ? ((totalOrders - previousOrders) / previousOrders) * 100 : 0;

    res.json({
      overview: {
        totalUsers,
        totalProducers,
        totalProducts,
        totalOrders,
        totalRevenue: Number(currentRevenue),
        revenueGrowth: Number(revenueGrowth.toFixed(2)),
        orderGrowth: Number(orderGrowth.toFixed(2)),
        activeUsers,
        pendingOrders,
        completedOrders,
      },
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get dashboard analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics dashboard' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/products
 * Product analytics
 */
router.get('/products', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // Top products by sales
    const topProducts = await prisma.orderItem.groupBy({
      by: ['productId'],
      where: {
        order: {
          createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
      _sum: {
        quantity: true,
        price: true,
      },
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
      orderBy: {
        _sum: {
          quantity: 'desc',
        },
      },
      take: 10,
    });

    // Get product details
    const productIds = topProducts.map((p) => p.productId);
    const products = await prisma.product.findMany({
      where: { id: { in: productIds } },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        imageUrl: true,
        producer: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    const productsWithStats = topProducts.map((stat) => {
      const product = products.find((p) => p.id === stat.productId);
      return {
        product: product || { id: stat.productId, name: 'Unknown' },
        totalQuantity: stat._sum.quantity || 0,
        totalRevenue: Number(stat._sum.price || 0),
        orderCount: stat._count.id,
      };
    });

    // Product status distribution
    const statusDistribution = await prisma.product.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({
      topProducts: productsWithStats,
      statusDistribution: statusDistribution.map((s) => ({
        status: s.status,
        count: s._count.id,
      })),
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get product analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics produse' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/orders
 * Order analytics
 */
router.get('/orders', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // Order status distribution
    const statusDistribution = await prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ['status'],
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

    // Average order value
    const avgOrderValue = await prisma.order.aggregate({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
        paymentStatus: 'PAID',
      },
      _avg: {
        totalAmount: true,
      },
    });

    // Orders over time (grouped by period)
    const period = query.period || 'day';
    const ordersOverTime = await prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
      select: {
        createdAt: true,
        totalAmount: true,
        paymentStatus: true,
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'asc',
      },
    });

    res.json({
      statusDistribution: statusDistribution.map((s) => ({
        status: s.status,
        count: s._count.id,
      })),
      averageOrderValue: Number(avgOrderValue._avg.totalAmount || 0),
      ordersOverTime: ordersOverTime.map((o) => ({
        date: o.createdAt.toISOString(),
        amount: Number(o.totalAmount),
        paymentStatus: o.paymentStatus,
      })),
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
        period,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get order analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics comenzi' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/users
 * User analytics
 */
router.get('/users', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // User role distribution
    const roleDistribution = await prisma.user.groupBy({
      by: ['role'],
      _count: {
        id: true,
      },
    });

    // New users over time
    const newUsers = await prisma.user.count({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
    });

    // Active users (users with orders)
    const activeUsers = await prisma.user.count({
      where: {
        orders: {
          some: {
            createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
          },
        },
      },
    });

    res.json({
      roleDistribution: roleDistribution.map((r) => ({
        role: r.role,
        count: r._count.id,
      })),
      newUsers,
      activeUsers,
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get user analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics utilizatori' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/revenue
 * Revenue analytics
 */
router.get('/revenue', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // Total revenue
    const totalRevenue = await prisma.order.aggregate({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
        paymentStatus: 'PAID',
      },
      _sum: {
        totalAmount: true,
        totalCommission: true,
      },
    });

    // Revenue by status
    const revenueByStatus = await prisma.order.groupBy({
      by: ['paymentStatus'],
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
      _sum: {
        totalAmount: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({
      totalRevenue: Number(totalRevenue._sum.totalAmount || 0),
      totalCommission: Number(totalRevenue._sum.totalCommission || 0),
      revenueByStatus: revenueByStatus.map((r) => ({
        status: r.paymentStatus,
        revenue: Number(r._sum.totalAmount || 0),
      })),
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get revenue analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics revenue' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /analytics/trends
 * Trends analytics
 */
router.get('/trends', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.ADMIN), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const query = dateRangeSchema.parse(req.query);
    const period = query.period || 'day';
    const startDate = query.startDate ? new Date(query.startDate) : new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const endDate = query.endDate ? new Date(query.endDate) : new Date();

    // Orders trend
    const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
      select: {
        createdAt: true,
        totalAmount: true,
        paymentStatus: true,
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'asc',
      },
    });

    // Users trend
    const users = await prisma.user.findMany({
      where: {
        createdAt: { gte: startDate, lte: endDate },
      },
      select: {
        createdAt: true,
        role: true,
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'asc',
      },
    });

    res.json({
      ordersTrend: orders.map((o) => ({
        date: o.createdAt.toISOString(),
        amount: Number(o.totalAmount),
        paymentStatus: o.paymentStatus,
      })),
      usersTrend: users.map((u) => ({
        date: u.createdAt.toISOString(),
        role: u.role,
      })),
      period: {
        startDate: startDate.toISOString(),
        endDate: endDate.toISOString(),
        period,
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get trends analytics error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea analytics trends' });
  }
});

export default router;
```

```typescript
/**
 * Backend API for farme.ro marketplace
 * 
 * Structure:
 * - Express.js as HTTP framework (simple, flexible, well documented)
 * - TypeScript for type safety
 * - Prisma ORM for database interaction
 * - JWT for authentication
 * - zod for input validation
 * 
 * Organization:
 * - src/index.ts - entry point, server configuration
 * - src/routes/ - API routes
 * - src/middleware/ - middleware (auth, error handling, etc.)
 * - src/utils/ - utilities (JWT, bcrypt, validation)
 * - src/types/ - TypeScript types
 */

import express, { Router, Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { createServer } from 'http';
import { initializeSocket } from './utils/socket';
import { requestLogger } from './middleware/requestLogger';

const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO

// Middleware

app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging

// Rate limiting general

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()

// Body parsing & cookies

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Security headers
app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware);

// Performance monitoring

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// GET /health/detailed - comprehensive health check
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {

});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {

});

// Detailed health check
app.get('/health/detailed', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const health = await performHealthCheck();
    const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : health.status === 'degraded' ? 200 : 503;
    res.status(statusCode).json(health);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Health check failed', error as Error);
    res.status(503).json({
      status: 'unhealthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

    });

});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication

// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);

app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);

app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);
app.use('/notifications/push', pushNotificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);
// Reviews
app.use('/reviews', reviewRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;
```

```javascript
/**
 * Service Worker for Push Notifications
 * 
 * Handles push notifications for farme.ro PWA
 */

const CACHE_NAME = 'farme-push-v1';

// Install event - cache static assets
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW Push] Service Worker installing...');
  self.skipWaiting();
});

// Activate event - clean up old caches
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW Push] Service Worker activating...');
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys().then((cacheNames) => {
      return Promise.all(
        cacheNames
          .filter((name) => name !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map((name) => caches.delete(name))
      );
    })
  );
  return self.clients.claim();
});

// Push event - handle incoming push notifications
self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW Push] Push notification received:', event);

  let notificationData = {
    title: 'farme.ro',
    body: 'Ai o notificare nouă',
    icon: '/icon-192x192.png',
    badge: '/icon-192x192.png',
    data: {},
  };

  // Parse push data if available
  if (event.data) {
    try {
      const data = event.data.json();
      notificationData = {
        title: data.title || notificationData.title,
        body: data.body || notificationData.body,
        icon: data.icon || notificationData.icon,
        badge: data.badge || notificationData.badge,
        data: data.data || {},
      };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[SW Push] Error parsing push data:', e);
      notificationData.body = event.data.text() || notificationData.body;
    }
  }

  // Show notification
  event.waitUntil(
    self.registration.showNotification(notificationData.title, {
      body: notificationData.body,
      icon: notificationData.icon,
      badge: notificationData.badge,
      data: notificationData.data,
      tag: notificationData.data.url || 'default',
      requireInteraction: false,
      actions: notificationData.data.url
        ? [
            {
              action: 'open',
              title: 'Deschide',
            },
            {
              action: 'close',
              title: 'Închide',
            },
          ]
        : [],
    })
  );
});

// Notification click event
self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW Push] Notification clicked:', event);

  event.notification.close();

  if (event.action === 'close') {
    return;
  }

  // Open URL if available
  const urlToOpen = event.notification.data?.url || '/';

  event.waitUntil(
    clients
      .matchAll({
        type: 'window',
        includeUncontrolled: true,
      })
      .then((clientList) => {
        // Check if there's already a window/tab open with the target URL
        for (let i = 0; i < clientList.length; i++) {
          const client = clientList[i];
          if (client.url === urlToOpen && 'focus' in client) {
            return client.focus();
          }
        }
        // If not, open a new window/tab
        if (clients.openWindow) {
          return clients.openWindow(urlToOpen);
        }
      })
  );
});

// Notification close event
self.addEventListener('notificationclose', (event) => {
  console.log('[SW Push] Notification closed:', event);
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Push Notifications Service
 * 
 * Handles Web Push Notifications subscription and management
 */

import { apiFetch } from './api/client';
import { isBackendSyncEnabled } from './backend-sync/status';

const VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY || '';

interface PushSubscriptionData {
  endpoint: string;
  keys: {
    p256dh: string;
    auth: string;
  };
}

/**
 * Check if push notifications are supported
 */
export function isPushNotificationSupported(): boolean {
  return (
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    'serviceWorker' in navigator &&
    'PushManager' in window &&
    'Notification' in window
  );
}

/**
 * Check if user has granted notification permission
 */
export async function getNotificationPermission(): Promise<NotificationPermission> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    return 'denied';
  }
  return Notification.permission;
}

/**
 * Request notification permission
 */
export async function requestNotificationPermission(): Promise<NotificationPermission> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    return 'denied';
  }

  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
    return 'granted';
  }

  if (Notification.permission === 'denied') {
    return 'denied';
  }

  const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
  return permission;
}

/**
 * Convert VAPID key to Uint8Array
 */
function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String: string): Uint8Array {
  const padding = '='.repeat((4 - (base64String.length % 4)) % 4);
  const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');

  const rawData = window.atob(base64);
  const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);

  for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
    outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return outputArray;
}

/**
 * Subscribe to push notifications
 */
export async function subscribeToPushNotifications(): Promise<PushSubscriptionData | null> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    console.warn('[Push] Push notifications not supported');
    return null;
  }

  if (!isBackendSyncEnabled('notifications')) {
    console.warn('[Push] Push notifications not enabled in backend sync');
    return null;
  }

  try {
    // Request permission
    const permission = await requestNotificationPermission();
    if (permission !== 'granted') {
      console.warn('[Push] Notification permission not granted');
      return null;
    }

    // Register service worker
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;

    // Subscribe to push
    const subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
      userVisibleOnly: true,
      applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY),
    });

    // Extract subscription data
    const subscriptionData: PushSubscriptionData = {
      endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
      keys: {
        p256dh: btoa(
          String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(subscription.getKey('p256dh')!))
        ),
        auth: btoa(
          String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(subscription.getKey('auth')!))
        ),
      },
    };

    // Send subscription to backend
    try {
      await apiFetch('/notifications/push/subscribe', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(subscriptionData),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[Push] Error subscribing to backend:', error);
      // Still return subscription data even if backend call fails
    }

    return subscriptionData;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Push] Error subscribing to push notifications:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Unsubscribe from push notifications
 */
export async function unsubscribeFromPushNotifications(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();

    if (!subscription) {
      return true; // Already unsubscribed
    }

    // Unsubscribe from push manager
    await subscription.unsubscribe();

    // Notify backend
    try {
      await apiFetch('/notifications/push/unsubscribe', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
        }),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('[SW Push] Error unsubscribing from backend:', error);
    }

    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Push] Error unsubscribing from push notifications:', error);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Get push subscription status
 */
export async function getPushSubscriptionStatus(): Promise<{
  subscribed: boolean;
  publicKey?: string;
}> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    return { subscribed: false };
  }

  if (!isBackendSyncEnabled('notifications')) {
    return { subscribed: false };
  }

  try {
    const response = await apiFetch<{
      subscribed: boolean;
      subscriptions: Array<{ id: string; endpoint: string }>;
      publicKey?: string;
    }>('/notifications/push/subscription', {
      method: 'GET',
      credentials: 'include',
    });

    return {
      subscribed: response.subscribed,
      publicKey: response.publicKey,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Push] Error getting subscription status:', error);
    return { subscribed: false };
  }
}

/**
 * Check if currently subscribed
 */
export async function isSubscribedToPushNotifications(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
    const subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();
    return subscription !== null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[Push] Error checking subscription:', error);
    return false;
  }
}
```

```typescriptreact
/**
 * Push Notification Button Component
 * 
 * Button to enable/disable push notifications
 */

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@farme-ui/react';
import {
  subscribeToPushNotifications,
  unsubscribeFromPushNotifications,
  getPushSubscriptionStatus,
  isPushNotificationSupported,
  getNotificationPermission,
} from '@/lib/push-notifications';

interface PushNotificationButtonProps {
  className?: string;
}

export function PushNotificationButton({ className }: PushNotificationButtonProps) {
  const [isSupported, setIsSupported] = useState(false);
  const [isSubscribed, setIsSubscribed] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [permission, setPermission] = useState<NotificationPermission>('default');

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkSupport = async () => {
      const supported = isPushNotificationSupported();
      setIsSupported(supported);

      if (supported) {
        const perm = await getNotificationPermission();
        setPermission(perm);

        const status = await getPushSubscriptionStatus();
        setIsSubscribed(status.subscribed);
      }
    };

    checkSupport();
  }, []);

  const handleToggle = async () => {
    if (!isSupported) {
      return;
    }

    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      if (isSubscribed) {
        const success = await unsubscribeFromPushNotifications();
        if (success) {
          setIsSubscribed(false);
        }
      } else {
        const subscription = await subscribeToPushNotifications();
        if (subscription) {
          setIsSubscribed(true);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error toggling push notifications:', error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isSupported) {
    return null; // Don't show button if not supported
  }

  if (permission === 'denied') {
    return (
      <div className={className}>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
          Notificările push au fost blocate. Activează-le din setările browser-ului.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Button
      onClick={handleToggle}
      disabled={isLoading}
      variant={isSubscribed ? 'outline' : 'default'}
      className={className}
    >
      {isLoading
        ? 'Se procesează...'
        : isSubscribed
        ? 'Dezactivează notificări push'
        : 'Activează notificări push'}
    </Button>
  );
}

```
