// Promotions
import promotionRoutes from './modules/promotions/promotion.routes';
// Subscriptions Public
import subscriptionsPublicRoutes from './modules/subscriptions/subscriptions-public.routes';
// Reviews
import reviewRoutes from './modules/reviews/review.routes';
import analyticsRoutes from './modules/analytics/analytics.routes';
import configRoutes from './modules/config/config.routes';
import contactRoutes from './modules/contact/contact.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

// Setup monitoring (Sentry)
setupMonitoring();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Static files (uploads)
setupStaticFiles(app);

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Security headers
app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware);

// Performance monitoring
app.use(performanceMiddleware);

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// GET /health/detailed - comprehensive health check
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Detailed health check
app.get('/health/detailed', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const health = await performHealthCheck();
    const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : health.status === 'degraded' ? 200 : 503;
    res.status(statusCode).json(health);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Health check failed', error as Error);
    res.status(503).json({
      status: 'unhealthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      error: 'Health check failed',
    });
  }
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);
// app.use('/regions', regionRoutes); // REMOVED: Public endpoint is defined above at line 154
app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productUploadRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/producers', producerUploadRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);
app.use('/notifications/push', pushNotificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);
// Reviews
app.use('/reviews', reviewRoutes);

// Analytics
app.use('/analytics', analyticsRoutes);

// Config
app.use('/config', configRoutes);

// Contact
app.use('/contact', contactRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;


```

```typescript
/**
 * Farmero Points Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru sistemul de puncte și recompense Farmero
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /farmero-points/me - Get current client's points
 * - GET /farmero-points/transactions - Get points transaction history
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Calculate level based on points
 */
function calculateLevel(points: number): 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' {
  if (points >= 500) return 'gold';
  if (points >= 200) return 'silver';
  return 'bronze';
}

/**
 * Calculate next level points threshold
 */
function getNextLevelPoints(level: 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold'): number {
  switch (level) {
    case 'bronze':
      return 200;
    case 'silver':
      return 500;
    case 'gold':
      return Infinity;
  }
}

/**
 * Calculate level progress (0-100)
 */
function calculateLevelProgress(points: number, level: 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold'): number {
  const nextLevelPoints = getNextLevelPoints(level);
  if (nextLevelPoints === Infinity) return 100;

  const currentLevelPoints = level === 'bronze' ? 0 : level === 'silver' ? 200 : 500;
  const range = nextLevelPoints - currentLevelPoints;
  const progress = points - currentLevelPoints;

  return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (progress / range) * 100));
}

/**
 * Calculate points from orders
 * Rules:
 * - 10 points per completed order
 * - 5 points per on-time pickup
 * - 2 points per review submitted
 */
async function calculatePointsFromOrders(userId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [completedOrders, reviews] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.order.count({
      where: {
        customerId: userId,
        status: 'COMPLETED',
      },
    }),
    prisma.review.count({
      where: {
        userId,
        isApproved: true,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  // 10 points per completed order
  const orderPoints = completedOrders * 10;
  // 2 points per review
  const reviewPoints = reviews * 2;

  return orderPoints + reviewPoints;
}

/**
 * GET /farmero-points/me
 * Get current client's points
 */
router.get('/me', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.CUSTOMER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // Calculate points from orders and reviews
    const points = await calculatePointsFromOrders(req.user.userId);
    const level = calculateLevel(points);
    const nextLevelPoints = getNextLevelPoints(level);
    const levelProgress = calculateLevelProgress(points, level);

    res.json({
      clientId: req.user.userId,
      points,
      level,
      lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
      nextLevelPoints,
      levelProgress,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get farmero points error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea punctelor Farmero' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /farmero-points/transactions
 * Get points transaction history
 */
router.get('/transactions', requireAuth, requireRole(UserRole.CUSTOMER), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const { limit = '20', offset = '0' } = req.query;
    const limitNum = Math.min(parseInt(limit as string, 10), 100);
    const offsetNum = parseInt(offset as string, 10);

    // Get completed orders
    const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
      where: {
        customerId: req.user.userId,
        status: 'COMPLETED',
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        orderNumber: true,
        createdAt: true,
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
      take: limitNum,
      skip: offsetNum,
    });

    // Get reviews
    const reviews = await prisma.review.findMany({
      where: {
        userId: req.user.userId,
        isApproved: true,
      },
      select: {
        id: true,
        createdAt: true,
        product: {
          select: {
            name: true,
          },
        },
      },
      orderBy: {
        createdAt: 'desc',
      },
      take: limitNum,
      skip: offsetNum,
    });

    // Build transactions
    const transactions = [
      ...orders.map((order) => ({
        id: `order-${order.id}`,
        clientId: req.user!.userId,
        points: 10,
        type: 'earned' as const,
        description: `Comandă completată: ${order.orderNumber || order.id}`,
        createdAt: order.createdAt.toISOString(),
        orderId: order.id,
      })),
      ...reviews.map((review) => ({
        id: `review-${review.id}`,
        clientId: req.user!.userId,
        points: 2,
        type: 'earned' as const,
        description: `Review pentru: ${review.product.name}`,
        createdAt: review.createdAt.toISOString(),
      })),
    ].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());

    res.json(transactions.slice(0, limitNum));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get farmero points transactions error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea tranzacțiilor de puncte' });
  }
});

export default router;

```

```typescript
/**
 * Contracts Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru contracte între părți
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /contracts - Get current user's contracts
 * - GET /contracts/:id - Get contract by ID
 * - GET /contracts/templates - Get available contract templates
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Get party reference for current user
 */
async function getPartyRef(userId: string, role: UserRole) {
  if (role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        registrationNumber: true,
      },
    });
    if (producer) {
      return {
        id: producer.id,
        type: 'producer' as const,
        displayName: producer.name,
        vatId: producer.registrationNumber,
      };
    }
  } else if (role === UserRole.CUSTOMER) {
    const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: userId },
      select: {
        id: true,
        fullName: true,
        email: true,
      },
    });
    if (user) {
      return {
        id: user.id,
        type: 'client' as const,
        displayName: user.fullName,
        email: user.email,
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * GET /contracts
 * Get current user's contracts
 */
router.get('/', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // For MVP, return contracts based on user role
    // In production, this would query a Contracts table
    const partyRef = await getPartyRef(req.user.userId, req.user.role);

    if (!partyRef) {
      return res.json([]);
    }

    // Generate contract based on role
    const contracts = [];

    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { userId: req.user.userId },
      });

      if (producer && producer.status === 'APPROVED') {
        contracts.push({
          id: `contract-producer-${producer.id}`,
          templateId: 'producer-platform-v1',
          type: 'producer_platform' as const,
          parties: [
            {
              id: 'farmero-platform',
              type: 'farmero_platform' as const,
              displayName: 'Farmero',
              countryCode: 'RO',
            },
            partyRef,
          ],
          status: 'active' as const,
          signedAt: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
          validFrom: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
          referenceNumber: `CONTRACT-${producer.id.substring(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
          createdAt: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
          updatedAt: producer.updatedAt.toISOString(),
        });
      }
    }

    res.json(contracts);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get contracts error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea contractelor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /contracts/:id
 * Get contract by ID
 */
router.get('/:id', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const contractId = req.params.id;

    // For MVP, generate contract on the fly
    // In production, this would query a Contracts table
    const partyRef = await getPartyRef(req.user.userId, req.user.role);

    if (!partyRef) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contract negăsit' });
    }

    // Check if contract belongs to user
    if (contractId.startsWith('contract-producer-')) {
      const producerId = contractId.replace('contract-producer-', '');
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { id: producerId },
      });

      if (!producer || producer.userId !== req.user.userId) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contract negăsit' });
      }

      const contract = {
        id: contractId,
        templateId: 'producer-platform-v1',
        type: 'producer_platform' as const,
        parties: [
          {
            id: 'farmero-platform',
            type: 'farmero_platform' as const,
            displayName: 'Farmero',
            countryCode: 'RO',
          },
          partyRef,
        ],
        status: 'active' as const,
        signedAt: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
        validFrom: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
        referenceNumber: `CONTRACT-${producer.id.substring(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`,
        downloadUrl: `/api/contracts/${contractId}/download`,
        createdAt: producer.createdAt.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: producer.updatedAt.toISOString(),
      };

      return res.json(contract);
    }

    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Contract negăsit' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get contract by ID error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea contractului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /contracts/templates
 * Get available contract templates
 */
router.get('/templates', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    const { type } = req.query;

    const templates = [
      {
        id: 'producer-platform-v1',
        type: 'producer_platform' as const,
        name: 'Contract Producător - Platformă Farmero',
        version: '1.0',
        description: 'Contract standard pentru producători',
        createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        requiredFields: ['name', 'registrationNumber', 'type'],
      },
      {
        id: 'logistics-platform-v1',
        type: 'logistics_platform' as const,
        name: 'Contract Logistică - Platformă Farmero',
        version: '1.0',
        description: 'Contract standard pentru parteneri de logistică',
        createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',
        requiredFields: ['name', 'registrationNumber'],
      },
      {
        id: 'business-platform-v1',

        name: 'Contract Business - Platformă Farmero',
        version: '1.0',
        description: 'Contract standard pentru clienți business',
        createdAt: '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z',

/**
 * Parties Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru party profiles și relații
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /parties/me - Get current user's party profile
 * - GET /parties/counterparties - Get list of counterparties
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * GET /parties/me
 * Get current user's party profile
 */
router.get('/me', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { userId: req.user.userId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          name: true,
          registrationNumber: true,
        },
      });

      if (producer) {
        return res.json({
          id: producer.id,
          type: 'producer',
          displayName: producer.name,
          vatId: producer.registrationNumber,
          countryCode: 'RO',
        });
      }
    } else if (req.user.role === UserRole.CUSTOMER) {
      const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({
        where: { id: req.user.userId },
        select: {
          id: true,
          fullName: true,
          email: true,
        },
      });

      if (user) {
        return res.json({
          id: user.id,
          type: 'client',
          displayName: user.fullName,
          email: user.email,
          countryCode: 'RO',
        });
      }
    }

    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Party profile negăsit' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get party profile error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea profilului de party' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /parties/counterparties
 * Get list of counterparties (parties with relations to current user)
 */
router.get('/counterparties', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const counterparties = [];

    // Always include Farmero platform
    counterparties.push({
      id: 'farmero-platform',
      type: 'farmero_platform',
      displayName: 'Farmero',
      countryCode: 'RO',
    });

    // If producer, get related producers from orders
    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const orders = await prisma.order.findMany({
        where: {
          vendors: {
            some: {
              producer: {
                userId: req.user.userId,
              },
            },
          },
        },
        include: {
          customer: {
            select: {
              id: true,
              fullName: true,
              email: true,
            },
          },
        },
        take: 10,
      });

      const uniqueCustomers = new Map();
      orders.forEach((order) => {
        if (order.customer && !uniqueCustomers.has(order.customer.id)) {
          uniqueCustomers.set(order.customer.id, {
            id: order.customer.id,
            type: 'client',
            displayName: order.customer.fullName,
            email: order.customer.email,
            countryCode: 'RO',
          });
        }
      });

      counterparties.push(...Array.from(uniqueCustomers.values()));
    }

    res.json(counterparties);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get counterparties error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea counterparties' });
  }
});

export default router;

```typescript
/**
 * Statements Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru extrase de plată
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /statements - Get current user's statements
 * - GET /statements/:id - Get statement by ID
 * - GET /statements/current - Get current period summary
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Calculate commission for an order
 */
function calculateCommission(orderAmount: number, monthlySales: number): number {
  let rate = 0.085; // 8.5% default

  if (monthlySales >= 15000) {
    rate = 0.065; // 6.5%
  } else if (monthlySales >= 5000) {
    rate = 0.075; // 7.5%
  }

  return orderAmount * rate;
}

/**
 * Generate statement lines from orders
 */
async function generateStatementLines(
  userId: string,
  role: UserRole,
  startDate: Date,
  endDate: Date
) {
  if (role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return [];
    }

    // Get orders for this producer in the period
    const orderVendors = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: startDate,
            lte: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderNumber: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Calculate monthly sales for commission tier
    const monthlyStart = new Date(startDate);
    monthlyStart.setDate(1);
    const monthlyOrders = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: monthlyStart,
            lt: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
    });

    const monthlySales = monthlyOrders.reduce((sum, ov) => sum + Number(ov.subtotal), 0);

    return orderVendors.map((ov, index) => {
      const commission = calculateCommission(Number(ov.subtotal), monthlySales);
      return {
        id: `line-${ov.id}`,
        date: ov.order.createdAt.toISOString(),
        referenceType: 'order' as const,
        referenceId: ov.order.id,
        referenceNumber: ov.order.orderNumber || `ORD-${ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
        grossAmount: Number(ov.subtotal),
        feeAmount: commission,
        netAmount: Number(ov.subtotal) - commission,
        currency: 'RON',
        description: `Comandă ${ov.order.orderNumber || ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
      };
    });
  }

  return [];
}

/**
 * GET /statements
 * Get current user's statements
 */
router.get('/', requireAuth, requireRole([UserRole.PRODUCER, UserRole.CUSTOMER]), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // For MVP, generate statements on the fly
    // In production, this would query a Statements table
    const statements = [];

    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { userId: req.user.userId },
      });

      if (producer) {
        // Generate statement for current month
        const now = new Date();
        const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
        const monthEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59);

        const lines = await generateStatementLines(req.user.userId, req.user.role, monthStart, monthEnd);

        if (lines.length > 0) {
          const totalGross = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.grossAmount, 0);
          const totalFees = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.feeAmount, 0);
          const totalNet = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.netAmount, 0);

          statements.push({
            id: `statement-${producer.id}-${now.getFullYear()}-${now.getMonth() + 1}`,
            partyId: producer.id,
            partyType: 'producer' as const,
            periodStart: monthStart.toISOString(),
            periodEnd: monthEnd.toISOString(),
            totalGross,
            totalFees,
            totalNet,
            currency: 'RON',
            lines: [],
            status: 'draft' as const,
            createdAt: monthStart.toISOString(),
            updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
          });
        }
      }
    }

    res.json(statements);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get statements error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea extractelor' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /statements/:id
 * Get statement by ID
 */
router.get('/:id', requireAuth, requireRole([UserRole.PRODUCER, UserRole.CUSTOMER]), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const statementId = req.params.id;

    // Parse statement ID: statement-{producerId}-{year}-{month}
    const match = statementId.match(/^statement-(.+)-(\d+)-(\d+)$/);
    if (!match) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Extras negăsit' });
    }

    const [, producerId, year, month] = match;

    // Verify producer belongs to user
    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { id: producerId },
      });

      if (!producer || producer.userId !== req.user.userId) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Extras negăsit' });
      }

      const monthStart = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month) - 1, 1);
      const monthEnd = new Date(parseInt(year), parseInt(month), 0, 23, 59, 59);

      const lines = await generateStatementLines(req.user.userId, req.user.role, monthStart, monthEnd);

      const totalGross = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.grossAmount, 0);
      const totalFees = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.feeAmount, 0);
      const totalNet = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.netAmount, 0);

      const statement = {
        id: statementId,
        partyId: producer.id,
        partyType: 'producer' as const,
        periodStart: monthStart.toISOString(),
        periodEnd: monthEnd.toISOString(),
        totalGross,
        totalFees,
        totalNet,
        currency: 'RON',
        lines,
        status: 'final' as const,
        createdAt: monthStart.toISOString(),
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      return res.json(statement);
    }

    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Extras negăsit' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get statement by ID error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea extractului' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /statements/current
 * Get current period summary
 */
router.get('/current', requireAuth, requireRole([UserRole.PRODUCER, UserRole.CUSTOMER]), async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    if (req.user.role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
      const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
        where: { userId: req.user.userId },
      });

      if (producer) {
        const now = new Date();
        const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
        const monthEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59);

        const lines = await generateStatementLines(req.user.userId, req.user.role, monthStart, monthEnd);

        if (lines.length > 0) {
          const totalGross = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.grossAmount, 0);
          const totalFees = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.feeAmount, 0);
          const totalNet = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.netAmount, 0);

          return res.json({
            id: `statement-${producer.id}-${now.getFullYear()}-${now.getMonth() + 1}`,
            partyId: producer.id,
            partyType: 'producer' as const,
            periodStart: monthStart.toISOString(),
            periodEnd: monthEnd.toISOString(),
            totalGross,
            totalFees,
            totalNet,
            currency: 'RON',
            lines: [],
            status: 'draft' as const,
            createdAt: monthStart.toISOString(),
            updatedAt: now.toISOString(),
          });
        }
      }
    }

    res.status(404).json({ error: 'Nu există rezumat pentru perioada curentă' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get current period summary error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea rezumatului perioadei curente' });
  }
});

export default router;

/**
 * Donations Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru donații către platforma Farmero
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /donations/summary - Get donation summary
 * - POST /donations/intent - Create donation intent
 * - GET /donations/preferences - Get user's donation preferences
 * - PATCH /donations/preferences - Update user's donation preferences
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { requireAuth } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';

const router = Router();

// Schema pentru donation intent
const donationIntentSchema = z.object({
  amount: z.number().positive('Suma trebuie să fie pozitivă'),
  currency: z.string().default('RON'),
});

// Schema pentru donation preferences
const donationPreferencesSchema = z.object({
  showNamePublicly: z.boolean().optional(),
});

/**
 * GET /donations/summary
 * Get donation summary (aggregated amounts, donor count)
 */
router.get('/summary', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    // For MVP, return mock data
    // In production, this would aggregate from a Donations table
    const now = new Date();
    const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
    const monthEnd = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0, 23, 59, 59);

    // Count unique donors (users with donations)
    // For MVP, return default values
    res.json({
      periodStart: monthStart.toISOString(),
      periodEnd: monthEnd.toISOString(),
      totalAmount: 0,
      currency: 'RON',
      donorsCount: 0,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get donation summary error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea rezumatului donațiilor' });
  }
});

/**
 * POST /donations/intent
 * Create donation intent (for payment processing)
 */
router.post('/intent', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = donationIntentSchema.parse(req.body);

    // For MVP, create intent and return
    // In production, this would create a DonationIntent record and integrate with payment processor
    const intentId = `donation-intent-${Date.now()}-${req.user.userId.substring(0, 8)}`;

    // TODO: Integrate with payment processor (Stripe, etc.)
    // For now, return intent ID
    res.json({
      intentId,
      // paymentUrl: 'https://checkout.stripe.com/...', // Would be generated by payment processor
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(), // 30 minutes
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Date invalide',
        details: error.issues,
      });
    }

    console.error('Create donation intent error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la crearea intenției de donație' });
  }
});

/**
 * GET /donations/preferences
 * Get user's donation preferences
 */
router.get('/preferences', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    // For MVP, return default preferences
    // In production, this would query a DonationPreferences table
    res.json({
      showNamePublicly: false,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Get donation preferences error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la obținerea preferințelor de donație' });
  }
});

/**
 * PATCH /donations/preferences
 * Update user's donation preferences
 */
router.patch('/preferences', requireAuth, async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
  try {
    if (!req.user) {
      return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Neautorizat' });
    }

    const data = donationPreferencesSchema.parse(req.body);

    // For MVP, return updated preferences
    // In production, this would update a DonationPreferences table
    res.json({
      showNamePublicly: data.showNamePublicly ?? false,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Date invalide',
        details: error.issues,
      });
    }

    console.error('Update donation preferences error:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Eroare la actualizarea preferințelor de donație' });
  }
});

export default router;

import donationsRoutes from './modules/donations/donations.routes';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

// Setup monitoring (Sentry)
setupMonitoring();

const app = express();
const server = createServer(app);
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3001;

// Initialize Socket.IO
initializeSocket(server);

// Middleware
// CORS - centralized configuration
app.use(cors(corsConfig));
app.options('*', cors(corsConfig)); // For preflight requests

// Request logging
app.use(requestLogger);

// Rate limiting general
app.use(generalRateLimiter);

// IMPORTANT: Stripe webhook must receive raw body
// So we need to process the webhook before express.json()
// Webhook is NOT subject to rate limiting (Stripe sends directly)
app.use('/api/payments/webhook', express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }));

// Body parsing & cookies
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '10mb' }));
app.use(cookieParser());

// Static files (uploads)
setupStaticFiles(app);

// Root endpoint - API information
app.get('/', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'farme.ro API',
    version: '1.0.0',
    status: 'running',
    environment: process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development',
    endpoints: {
      health: '/health',
      auth: '/auth',
      cart: '/cart',
      orders: '/orders',
      products: '/products',
      producers: '/producers',
      regions: '/regions',
      commissions: '/api/commissions',
      public: '/api/public',
    },
  });
});

// OPTIONS handler este gestionat de cors(corsConfig) de mai sus

// Security headers
app.use(securityHeadersMiddleware);

// Performance monitoring
app.use(performanceMiddleware);

// Health check endpoint
// GET /health - checks if server is running
// GET /health/detailed - comprehensive health check
// HEAD /health - for health checks (Railway, Render, etc.)
app.get('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
});

app.head('/health', (_req, res) => {
  res.status(200).end();
});

// Detailed health check
app.get('/health/detailed', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const health = await performHealthCheck();
    const statusCode = health.status === 'healthy' ? 200 : health.status === 'degraded' ? 200 : 503;
    res.status(statusCode).json(health);
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Health check failed', error as Error);
    res.status(503).json({
      status: 'unhealthy',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      error: 'Health check failed',
    });
  }
});

// Public endpoint /regions (no authentication)
// GET /regions - get list of available regions (counties)
app.get('/regions', async (_req, res) => {
  try {
    const { prisma } = await import('./utils/prisma');
    const prismaClient = await import('@prisma/client');
    const RegionType = prismaClient.RegionType;
    const { type } = _req.query;

    const where: any = {};
    if (type && typeof type === 'string') {
      const validTypes = Object.values(RegionType) as string[];
      if (validTypes.includes(type)) {
        where.type = type;
      }
    }

    const regions = await prisma.region.findMany({
      where,
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
      select: {
        id: true,
        name: true,
        code: true,
        type: true,
      },
    });

    res.json({ regions });
  } catch (error) {
    const errorObj = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    logger.error('Get regions error:', errorObj);
    // Return empty array instead of error (frontend handles empty arrays gracefully)
    res.json({ regions: [] });
  }
});

// Public API routes (no authentication)
app.use('/api/public', publicRoutes);
// Alias for frontend compatibility (if frontend uses /public/products)
app.use('/public', publicRoutes);
// Direct route for /products - reuse the handler from public routes
import { getProductsHandler } from './modules/public/public.routes';
app.get('/products', getProductsHandler);

// Protected API routes
// Rate limiting for authentication
app.use('/auth', authRateLimiter, authRoutes);

app.use('/api/producers', producerRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', producerAdminRouter); // Admin routes for producers
app.use('/api/products', productRoutes);
app.use('/api/products', productUploadRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', productAdminRouter); // Admin routes for products
app.use('/cart', cartRoutes);
app.use('/api/orders', orderRoutes);
app.use('/api/admin', orderAdminRouter); // Admin routes for orders
app.use('/api/commissions', commissionRoutes);
// Rate limiting for payments (exclude webhook - webhook is processed earlier)
app.use('/api/payments/create-checkout', paymentRateLimiter);
app.use('/api/payments', paymentRoutes);

// Alias routes for frontend compatibility
app.use('/orders', orderAliasRoutes);
app.use('/producers/products', producerProductsRoutes);
app.use('/producers/orders', producerOrdersRoutes);
app.use('/producers/subscriptions', producerSubscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/producers', producerUploadRoutes);

// Client routes
app.use('/clients', clientProfileRoutes);
app.use('/clients/favorites', favoritesRoutes);
app.use('/clients/subscriptions', subscriptionsRoutes);
app.use('/clients/alert-preferences', alertsRoutes);

// Business routes
app.use('/business', businessRoutes);

// Logistics routes
app.use('/logistics', logisticsRoutes);

// Investor routes
app.use('/investor', investorRoutes);

// Notifications
app.use('/notifications', notificationRoutes);
app.use('/notifications/push', pushNotificationRoutes);

// Documents
app.use('/documents', documentRoutes);

// Promotions
app.use('/producer/promotions', promotionRoutes);
// Subscriptions Public
app.use('/subscriptions/public', subscriptionsPublicRoutes);
// Reviews
app.use('/reviews', reviewRoutes);

// Analytics
app.use('/analytics', analyticsRoutes);

// Config
app.use('/config', configRoutes);

// Contact
app.use('/contact', contactRoutes);

// Error handling middleware (must be last before 404)
app.use(errorHandler);

// 404 handler (must be last)
app.use(notFoundHandler);

// Export app for Vercel serverless functions
// If running in Vercel (serverless), export the app instead of starting a server
if (process.env.VERCEL || process.env.VERCEL_ENV) {
  // Vercel serverless mode - export the app
  // TypeScript compiles to CommonJS, so we can use module.exports
  (module as any).exports = app;
} else {
  // Traditional server mode - start the server
  // Start server
  // Listen on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) to work in Docker/cloud containers
  const HOST = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';

  server.listen(parseInt(PORT.toString()), HOST, () => {
    logger.info(`Server started on ${HOST}:${PORT}`);
    logger.info(`Health check: http://${HOST}:${PORT}/health`);
    logger.info(`Socket.IO initialized`);
    logger.info(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
    logger.info(`CORS whitelist: ${allowedCorsOrigins.join(', ')} + *.vercel.app`);
  });
  
  // Export for non-Vercel environments (ES modules compatibility)
  (module as any).exports = app;
}

// Export default for ES modules compatibility
// In CommonJS mode, this becomes module.exports.default
// But we've already set module.exports above, so this won't override it
export default app;

```typescript
/**
 * Backend Sync Status Configuration
 * 
 * Acest fișier controlează ce funcționalități sunt conectate live la backend
 * și ce funcționalități sunt încă în fallback mode.
 * 
 * Folosește acest status pentru:
 * - Afișarea fallback-urilor când endpoint-ul nu e încă live
 * - Prevenirea crash-urilor
 * - Testarea incrementală a funcționalităților
 * 
 * IMPORTANT: Setează `true` doar când endpoint-ul este complet funcțional și testat.
 */

export const BackendSyncStatus = {
  // Client Profile & Addresses
  clientProfile: true, // ✅ GET /clients/me, PATCH /clients/me - Implementat în backend
  clientAddresses: true, // ✅ GET /clients/addresses, POST/PATCH/DELETE /clients/addresses/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Cart & Checkout
  cart: true, // ✅ POST /cart/items, GET /cart, PATCH/PUT /cart/items/:id, DELETE /cart/items/:id - Implementat în backend
  checkout: true, // ✅ POST /orders/checkout - Implementat în backend

  // Client Orders
  clientOrders: true, // ✅ GET /orders, GET /orders/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Portal
  producerProducts: true, // ✅ GET /producers/products, POST/PATCH/DELETE /producers/products/:id - Implementat în backend
  producerOrders: true, // ✅ GET /producers/orders, GET /producers/orders/:id, PATCH /producers/orders/:id/status - Implementat în backend

  // Favorites
  favorites: true, // ✅ GET /clients/favorites, POST /clients/favorites, DELETE /clients/favorites/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Subscription Baskets
  subscriptions: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions, POST /clients/subscriptions, PATCH /clients/subscriptions/:id - Implementat în backend

  // Silent Alerts
  alerts: true, // ✅ GET /clients/alert-preferences, PATCH /clients/alert-preferences - Implementat în backend

  // Business Portal
  businessDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /business/* - Implementat în backend

  // Logistics Portal
  logisticsDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Portal
  investorDashboard: true, // ✅ GET /investor/* - Implementat în backend
  investorMetrics: true, // ✅ GET /investor/metrics - Implementat în backend

  // Notifications System
  notifications: true, // ✅ GET /notifications/* - Implementat în backend

  // Producer Marketing & Monetization
  producerMarketing: true, // ✅ GET /producers/featured - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Public)
  subscriptionsClient: true, // ✅ GET /subscriptions/public/plans - Implementat în backend

  // Client Subscriptions (Active)
  subscriptionsClientActive: true, // ✅ GET /clients/subscriptions - Implementat în backend (deja activat ca 'subscriptions')

  // Producer Subscriptions (Tiers)
  subscriptionsProducer: true, // ✅ GET /producers/subscriptions - Implementat în backend

  // Farmero Points & Rewards
  farmeroPoints: true, // ✅ GET /farmero-points/* - Implementat în backend

  // Parties & Contracts
  partiesAndContracts: true, // ✅ GET /contracts, GET /parties/* - Implementat în backend

  // Fees & Statements
  feesAndStatements: true, // ✅ GET /fees/*, GET /statements - Implementat în backend

  // Donations
  donations: true, // ✅ GET /donations/* - Implementat în backend

  // Documents & Contracts
  documents: true, // ✅ GET /documents/* - Implementat în backend

  // Subscriptions (Client & Producer) - deja activat ca 'subscriptions' mai sus
  // subscriptions: true, // ✅ Duplicat - deja activat mai sus

  // Promotions & Marketing
  promotions: true, // ✅ GET /producer/promotions/* - Implementat în backend

  // Investor Metrics (Anonymized) - duplicat cu investorMetrics
  // investorMetrics: false, // ⚠️ Duplicat - deja definit mai sus

  // Shipments & AWB
  shipments: true, // ✅ GET /logistics/shipments - Implementat în backend
} as const

export type BackendSyncFeature = keyof typeof BackendSyncStatus

/**
 * Check if a feature is enabled
 */
export function isBackendSyncEnabled(feature: BackendSyncFeature): boolean {
  return BackendSyncStatus[feature] === true
}

/**
 * Get all enabled features
 */
export function getEnabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === true)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

/**
 * Get all disabled features
 */
export function getDisabledFeatures(): BackendSyncFeature[] {
  return Object.entries(BackendSyncStatus)
    .filter(([_, enabled]) => enabled === false)
    .map(([feature]) => feature as BackendSyncFeature)
}

```typescript
/**
 * Statements Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru extrase de plată
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /statements - Get current user's statements
 * - GET /statements/:id - Get statement by ID
 * - GET /statements/current - Get current period summary
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Calculate commission for an order
 */
function calculateCommission(orderAmount: number, monthlySales: number): number {
  let rate = 0.085; // 8.5% default

  if (monthlySales >= 15000) {
    rate = 0.065; // 6.5%
  } else if (monthlySales >= 5000) {
    rate = 0.075; // 7.5%
  }

  return orderAmount * rate;
}

/**
 * Generate statement lines from orders
 */
async function generateStatementLines(
  userId: string,
  role: UserRole,
  startDate: Date,
  endDate: Date
) {
  if (role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return [];
    }

    // Get orders for this producer in the period
    const orderVendors = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: startDate,
            lte: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderNumber: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Calculate monthly sales for commission tier
    const monthlyStart = new Date(startDate);
    monthlyStart.setDate(1);
    const monthlyOrders = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: monthlyStart,
            lt: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
    });

    const monthlySales = monthlyOrders.reduce((sum, ov) => sum + Number(ov.subtotal), 0);

    return orderVendors.map((ov, index) => {
      const commission = calculateCommission(Number(ov.subtotal), monthlySales);
      return {
        id: `line-${ov.id}`,
        date: ov.order.createdAt.toISOString(),
        referenceType: 'order' as const,
        referenceId: ov.order.id,
        referenceNumber: ov.order.orderNumber || `ORD-${ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
        grossAmount: Number(ov.subtotal),
        feeAmount: commission,
        netAmount: Number(ov.subtotal) - commission,
        currency: 'RON',
        description: `Comandă ${ov.order.orderNumber || ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
      };
    });
  }

  return [];
}

```typescript
/**
 * Statements Routes
 * 
 * Endpoints pentru extrase de plată
 * 
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /statements - Get current user's statements
 * - GET /statements/:id - Get statement by ID
 * - GET /statements/current - Get current period summary
 */

import { Router, Request, Response } from 'express';
import { requireAuth, requireRole } from '../../middleware/auth';
import { prisma } from '../../utils/prisma';
import { UserRole } from '@prisma/client';

const router = Router();

/**
 * Calculate commission for an order
 */
function calculateCommission(orderAmount: number, monthlySales: number): number {
  let rate = 0.085; // 8.5% default

  if (monthlySales >= 15000) {
    rate = 0.065; // 6.5%
  } else if (monthlySales >= 5000) {
    rate = 0.075; // 7.5%
  }

  return orderAmount * rate;
}

/**
 * Generate statement lines from orders
 */
async function generateStatementLines(
  userId: string,
  role: UserRole,
  startDate: Date,
  endDate: Date
) {
  if (role === UserRole.PRODUCER) {
    const producer = await prisma.producer.findUnique({
      where: { userId },
    });

    if (!producer) {
      return [];
    }

    // Get orders for this producer in the period
    const orderVendors = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: startDate,
            lte: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
      include: {
        order: {
          select: {
            id: true,
            orderNumber: true,
            createdAt: true,
          },
        },
      },
    });

    // Calculate monthly sales for commission tier
    const monthlyStart = new Date(startDate);
    monthlyStart.setDate(1);
    const monthlyOrders = await prisma.orderVendor.findMany({
      where: {
        producerId: producer.id,
        order: {
          createdAt: {
            gte: monthlyStart,
            lt: endDate,
          },
          paymentStatus: 'PAID',
        },
      },
    });

    const monthlySales = monthlyOrders.reduce((sum, ov) => sum + Number(ov.subtotal), 0);

    return orderVendors.map((ov, index) => {
      const commission = calculateCommission(Number(ov.subtotal), monthlySales);
      return {
        id: `line-${ov.id}`,
        date: ov.order.createdAt.toISOString(),
        referenceType: 'order' as const,
        referenceId: ov.order.id,
        referenceNumber: ov.order.orderNumber || `ORD-${ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
        grossAmount: Number(ov.subtotal),
        feeAmount: commission,
        netAmount: Number(ov.subtotal) - commission,
        currency: 'RON',
        description: `Comandă ${ov.order.orderNumber || ov.order.id.substring(0, 8)}`,
      };
    });
  }

  return [];
}

 * GET /statements
 * Get current user's statements
 */

/**
 * Comprehensive Endpoint Testing Script - All Features
 * 
 * Testează toate endpoint-urile backend incluzând features-urile noi:
 * - Farmero Points
 * - Contracts & Parties
 * - Fees & Statements
 * - Donations
 * 
 * Usage:
 *   npm run test:all
 *   sau
 *   tsx scripts/test-all-endpoints.ts
 */

import dotenv from 'dotenv';

dotenv.config();

const BACKEND_URL = process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3001';
const TEST_EMAIL = process.env.TEST_EMAIL || 'test@example.com';
const TEST_PASSWORD = process.env.TEST_PASSWORD || 'test123';

interface TestResult {
  name: string;
  status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'skip';
  message?: string;
  duration?: number;
}

const results: TestResult[] = [];
let authToken: string | null = null;
let testUserId: string | null = null;

async function testEndpoint(
  name: string,
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' | 'PUT',
  path: string,
  options: {
    body?: any;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    expectedStatus?: number;
    skip?: boolean;
  } = {}
): Promise<TestResult> {
  if (options.skip) {
    return { name, status: 'skip', message: 'Skipped' };
  }

  const startTime = Date.now();
  const url = `${BACKEND_URL}${path}`;
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...options.headers,
  };

  if (authToken && !headers['Authorization']) {
    headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${authToken}`;
  }

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method,
      headers,
      body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
    });

    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
    const expectedStatus = options.expectedStatus || 200;
    const status = response.status;

    if (status === expectedStatus) {
      return { name, status: 'pass', duration };
    } else {
      const text = await response.text();
      return {
        name,
        status: 'fail',
        message: `Expected ${expectedStatus}, got ${status}. Response: ${text.substring(0, 100)}`,
        duration,
      };
    }
  } catch (error) {
    const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
    return {
      name,
      status: 'fail',
      message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
      duration,
    };
  }
}

async function setupAuth(): Promise<boolean> {
  console.log('🔐 Setting up authentication...\n');

  // Try to login
  const loginResult = await testEndpoint(
    'Login',
    'POST',
    '/auth/login',
    {
      body: { email: TEST_EMAIL, password: TEST_PASSWORD },
      expectedStatus: 200,
    }
  );

  if (loginResult.status === 'pass') {
    // Get token from response
    const response = await fetch(`${BACKEND_URL}/auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: TEST_EMAIL, password: TEST_PASSWORD }),
    });

    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      authToken = data.token || data.accessToken || null;
      testUserId = data.user?.id || null;
      return true;
    }
  }

  // Try to register if login fails
  console.log('  ⚠️  Login failed, trying to register...');
  const registerResult = await testEndpoint(
    'Register',
    'POST',
    '/auth/register',
    {
      body: {
        email: TEST_EMAIL,
        password: TEST_PASSWORD,
        fullName: 'Test User',
      },
      expectedStatus: 201,
    }
  );

  if (registerResult.status === 'pass') {
    const response = await fetch(`${BACKEND_URL}/auth/register`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        email: TEST_EMAIL,
        password: TEST_PASSWORD,
        fullName: 'Test User',
      }),
    });

    if (response.ok) {
      const data = await response.json();
      authToken = data.token || data.accessToken || null;
      testUserId = data.user?.id || null;
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

async function runTests() {
  console.log('🧪 Comprehensive Endpoint Testing\n');
  console.log(`Backend URL: ${BACKEND_URL}\n`);

  // Setup auth
  const authSetup = await setupAuth();
  if (!authSetup) {
    console.log('❌ Failed to setup authentication. Some tests will be skipped.\n');
  }

  // Health Check
  console.log('📋 Testing Health & Public Endpoints...\n');
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Health Check', 'GET', '/health'));
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Detailed Health', 'GET', '/health/detailed'));

  // Public API
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Get Products (Public)', 'GET', '/products?limit=5'));
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Get Producers (Public)', 'GET', '/api/public/producers?limit=5'));
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Get Regions', 'GET', '/regions'));

  // Farmero Points
  console.log('\n📋 Testing Farmero Points...\n');
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Farmero Points', 'GET', '/farmero-points/me', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Points Transactions', 'GET', '/farmero-points/transactions', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );

  // Contracts & Parties
  console.log('\n📋 Testing Contracts & Parties...\n');
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get My Contracts', 'GET', '/contracts', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Contract Templates', 'GET', '/contracts/templates', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get My Party Profile', 'GET', '/parties/me', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Counterparties', 'GET', '/parties/counterparties', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );

  // Fees & Statements
  console.log('\n📋 Testing Fees & Statements...\n');
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Fee Rules', 'GET', '/fees/rules', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get My Statements', 'GET', '/statements', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Current Period Summary', 'GET', '/statements/current', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );

  // Donations
  console.log('\n📋 Testing Donations...\n');
  results.push(await testEndpoint('Get Donation Summary', 'GET', '/donations/summary'));
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Get Donation Preferences', 'GET', '/donations/preferences', {
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );
  results.push(
    await testEndpoint('Create Donation Intent', 'POST', '/donations/intent', {
      body: { amount: 10, currency: 'RON' },
      skip: !authSetup,
    })
  );

  // Print results
  console.log('\n\n📊 Test Results:\n');
  const passed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'pass').length;
  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'fail').length;
  const skipped = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'skip').length;

  results.forEach((result) => {
    const icon = result.status === 'pass' ? '✅' : result.status === 'fail' ? '❌' : '⏭️';
    const duration = result.duration ? ` (${result.duration}ms)` : '';
    console.log(`${icon} ${result.name}${duration}`);
    if (result.message) {
      console.log(`   ${result.message}`);
    }
  });

  console.log(`\n📈 Summary: ${passed} passed, ${failed} failed, ${skipped} skipped`);

  if (failed > 0) {
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

runTests().catch((error) => {
  console.error('Fatal error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

```

# 💳 Stripe Setup Complete Guide

**Data:** 2025-01-27  
**Scop:** Ghid complet pentru configurarea Stripe în producție

---

## 📋 Overview

Stripe este deja implementat în backend. Acest ghid te ajută să configurezi Stripe pentru producție.

---

## 🔑 Step 1: Obținere Chei Stripe

### 1.1. Creează Cont Stripe

1. Mergi la [stripe.com](https://stripe.com)
2. Creează un cont (sau loghează-te dacă ai deja)
3. Completează informațiile despre business

### 1.2. Obține Cheile API

1. Mergi la **Developers** → **API keys**
2. Vei vedea două seturi de chei:
   - **Test keys** (pentru development)
   - **Live keys** (pentru producție)

3. Pentru producție, folosește **Live keys**:
   - `sk_live_...` - Secret key (pentru backend)
   - `pk_live_...` - Publishable key (pentru frontend)

---

## 🔧 Step 2: Configurare Environment Variables

### 2.1. Backend (.env)

Adaugă în `backend/.env`:

```env
# Stripe Configuration
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_live_your_secret_key_here
STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_your_publishable_key_here
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_your_webhook_secret_here
```

### 2.2. Frontend (.env.local)

Adaugă în `frontend/.env.local`:

```env
# Stripe Configuration
NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=pk_live_your_publishable_key_here
```

### 2.3. Vercel (Production)

Pentru backend:
1. Mergi la Vercel Dashboard → Proiectul backend
2. Settings → Environment Variables
3. Adaugă:
   - `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` = `sk_live_...`
   - `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` = `whsec_...`

Pentru frontend:
1. Mergi la Vercel Dashboard → Proiectul frontend
2. Settings → Environment Variables
3. Adaugă:
   - `NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` = `pk_live_...`

---

## 🔗 Step 3: Configurare Webhook

### 3.1. Creează Webhook Endpoint

1. Mergi la **Developers** → **Webhooks**
2. Click **Add endpoint**
3. Configurează:
   - **Endpoint URL**: `https://api.farme.ro/api/payments/webhook`
   - **Events to send**: Selectează:
     - `checkout.session.completed`
     - `payment_intent.succeeded`
     - `payment_intent.payment_failed`

4. Click **Add endpoint**

### 3.2. Obține Webhook Secret

1. După crearea webhook-ului, click pe el
2. Găsește **Signing secret**
3. Copiază secret-ul (începe cu `whsec_...`)
4. Adaugă-l în environment variables (vezi Step 2.3)

---

## 🧪 Step 4: Testare

### 4.1. Test Cards

Pentru testare, folosește carduri de test:

**Carduri de test:**
- **Succes**: `4242 4242 4242 4242`
- **Declinat**: `4000 0000 0000 0002`
- **3D Secure**: `4000 0025 0000 3155`

**Date:**
- **Expiry**: Orice dată viitoare (ex: `12/25`)
- **CVC**: Orice 3 cifre (ex: `123`)
- **ZIP**: Orice cod poștal (ex: `12345`)

### 4.2. Testare Local

1. Rulează backend-ul local:
   ```bash
   cd backend
   npm run dev
   ```

2. Rulează frontend-ul local:
   ```bash
   cd frontend
   npm run dev
   ```

3. Testează fluxul complet:
   - Adaugă produse în coș
   - Mergi la checkout
   - Completează formularul
   - Folosește cardul de test
   - Verifică că comanda este creată

### 4.3. Testare Webhook Local

Pentru testare locală a webhook-urilor, folosește Stripe CLI:

1. Instalează Stripe CLI:
   ```bash
   # macOS
   brew install stripe/stripe-cli/stripe
   
   # Windows
   # Download de la https://github.com/stripe/stripe-cli/releases
   ```

2. Login:
   ```bash
   stripe login
   ```

3. Forward webhook-uri către local:
   ```bash
   stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3001/api/payments/webhook
   ```

4. Folosește webhook secret-ul afișat în terminal

---

## ✅ Step 5: Verificare Finală

### Checklist:

- [ ] Chei Stripe adăugate în environment variables
- [ ] Webhook configurat în Stripe Dashboard
- [ ] Webhook secret adăugat în environment variables
- [ ] Testat cu carduri de test
- [ ] Verificat că comenzile sunt create corect
- [ ] Verificat că webhook-urile sunt primite

---

## 🚨 Troubleshooting

### Problem: Webhook nu este primit

**Soluții:**
1. Verifică că URL-ul webhook-ului este corect
2. Verifică că webhook secret-ul este corect
3. Verifică logs-urile backend-ului pentru erori
4. Folosește Stripe Dashboard → Webhooks → Events pentru a vedea ce se întâmplă

### Problem: Payment nu este procesat

**Soluții:**
1. Verifică că `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` este corect
2. Verifică că `STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` este corect în frontend
3. Verifică logs-urile pentru erori
4. Verifică că cardul de test este valid

### Problem: 3D Secure nu funcționează

**Soluții:**
1. Verifică că folosești cardul de test pentru 3D Secure
2. Verifică că frontend-ul este configurat corect pentru 3D Secure
3. Verifică logs-urile pentru erori

---

## 📚 Resurse

- [Stripe Documentation](https://stripe.com/docs)
- [Stripe Testing](https://stripe.com/docs/testing)

```typescriptreact
/**
 * Contact Page
 * 
 * Pagină de contact cu formular și informații de contact
 */

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { Card, CardContent } from 'farme-ui'
import { Button } from 'farme-ui'
import { Input } from 'farme-ui'
import { Textarea } from 'farme-ui'
import { PageContainer } from '@/components/layout/page-container'
import { useI18n } from '@/lib/i18n/context'

export default function ContactPage() {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    subject: '',
    message: '',
  })
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle')

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setIsSubmitting(true)
    setSubmitStatus('idle')

    // Submit contact form
    try {
      const { submitContactForm } = await import('@/lib/api/contact')
      await submitContactForm(formData)
      setSubmitStatus('success')
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error submitting contact form:', error)
      setSubmitStatus('error')
      return
    }
    setIsSubmitting(false)
    setFormData({ name: '', email: '', subject: '', message: '' })
  }

  return (
    <section className="py-12 md:py-16 lg:py-20 bg-background relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Animated background elements */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <motion.div
          className="absolute top-20 left-10 w-32 h-32 bg-primary/5 dark:bg-primary/10 rounded-full blur-3xl"
          animate={{
            scale: [1, 1.2],
            x: [0, 50],
            y: [0, 30],
          }}
          transition={{
            duration: 8,
            repeat: Infinity,
            repeatType: 'reverse',
            ease: 'easeInOut',
          }}
        />
        <motion.div
          className="absolute bottom-20 right-10 w-40 h-40 bg-emerald-200/20 dark:bg-emerald-800/20 rounded-full blur-3xl"
          animate={{
            scale: [1, 1.3],
            x: [0, -40],
            y: [0, -20],
          }}
          transition={{
            duration: 10,
            repeat: Infinity,
            repeatType: 'reverse',
            ease: 'easeInOut',
            delay: 1,
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <PageContainer className="relative z-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}
          className="mb-12 text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto"
        >
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground mb-4">
            Contactează-ne
          </h1>
          <div className="w-24 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-primary via-primary to-primary rounded-full mx-auto mb-6" />
          <p className="text-base md:text-lg text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
            Ai întrebări? Suntem aici să te ajutăm. Trimite-ne un mesaj și îți vom răspunde în cel mai scurt timp.
          </p>
        </motion.div>

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 lg:gap-12">
          {/* Contact Info */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -30 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: 0.1 }}
            className="space-y-6"
          >
            <Card className="border-border/60 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300">
              <CardContent className="p-8 md:p-10">
                <div className="space-y-6">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M3 8l7.89 5.26a2 2 0 002.22 0L21 8M5 19h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">Email</h3>
                    </div>
                    <a 
                      href="mailto:contact@farme.ro" 
                      className="text-primary hover:underline font-medium"
                    >
                      contact@farme.ro
                    </a>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M12 8v4l3 3m6-3a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">Program</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      Luni - Vineri: 9:00 - 18:00<br />
                      Sâmbătă - Duminică: Închis
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 flex items-center justify-center">
                        <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={1.5} d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground">Răspuns</h3>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      Răspundem la toate mesajele în maximum 24 de ore.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="border-border/60 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 bg-muted/30">
              <CardContent className="p-8 md:p-10">
                <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-foreground mb-4">Suport</h3>
                <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-4">
                  Pentru întrebări despre comenzi, produse sau contul tău, 
                  te rugăm să folosești formularul de contact.
                </p>
                <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  Pentru producători:{' '}
                  <a href="/for-producers" className="text-primary hover:underline font-medium">
                    Vezi pagina pentru producători
                  </a>
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>

          {/* Contact Form */}
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 30 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, delay: 0.2 }}
          >
            <Card className="border-border/60 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300">
              <CardContent className="p-8 md:p-10">
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-foreground mb-6">Trimite un mesaj</h2>
                <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="name" className="block text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
                      Nume complet
                    </label>
                    <Input
                      id="name"
                      type="text"
                      value={formData.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      placeholder="Ion Popescu"
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
                      Email
                    </label>
                    <Input
                      id="email"
                      type="email"
                      value={formData.email}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, email: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      placeholder="ion@example.com"
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="subject" className="block text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
                      Subiect
                    </label>
                    <Input
                      id="subject"
                      type="text"
                      value={formData.subject}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      placeholder="Despre ce este mesajul tău?"
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label htmlFor="message" className="block text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
                      Mesaj
                    </label>
                    <Textarea
                      id="message"
                      value={formData.message}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, message: e.target.value })}
                      required
                      rows={6}
                      placeholder="Scrie mesajul tău aici..."
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {submitStatus === 'success' && (
                    <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 rounded-lg text-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-200 text-sm">
                      ✓ Mesajul tău a fost trimis cu succes! Vom răspunde în cel mai scurt timp.
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {submitStatus === 'error' && (
                    <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-200 text-sm">
                      ✗ A apărut o eroare. Te rugăm să încerci din nou.
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    size="lg"
                    className="w-full"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? 'Se trimite...' : 'Trimite mesaj'}
                  </Button>
                </form>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </PageContainer>
    </section>
  )
}

                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    size="lg"
                    className="w-full"

                  </Button>
                </form>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </PageContainer>
    </section>

}

      await submitContactForm(formData)
      setSubmitStatus('success')

                  {submitStatus === 'error' && (
                    <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/20 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-800 rounded-lg text-red-800 dark:text-red-200 text-sm">
                      ✗ A apărut o eroare. Te rugăm să încerci din nou.
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <Button
                    type="submit"
                    size="lg"
                    className="w-full"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? 'Se trimite...' : 'Trimite mesaj'}
                  </Button>
                </form>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        </div>
      </PageContainer>
    </section>
  )
}

        </div>
      </PageContainer>
